articleTitle: Health Status Analysis Method for Power Distribution Network Operators Based on Intelligent Wearable Device data and Logistic Regression Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Power industry has already put forward the requirement of minimal or even no power outages for the maintenance and repair of the power system. The improvement of relevant requirements puts forward new requirements for the personal care of on-site maintenance operators in the power industry. As power operations are usually carried out in complex and dangerous environments, such as high-altitude work, proximity to high-voltage equipment, etc., exploring more scientific and stable ways to ensure the safety of operators during maintenance operations has important practical significance and research value. Current reports on power system security issues, are mostly limited to the safety of the system itself or the operation safety of power system enterprises, and rarely involve the safety care of operators. With the emergence of intelligent wearable devices, real-time monitoring of operators’ mental, physical, and other states has become possible. In this paper, a health status fusion evaluation algorithm based on swarm intelligence optimization and logistic regression based on various physiological parameters extracted by intelligent wearable devices has been proposed, which effectively classifies and identifies the health status of workers reflected by multivariate nonlinear physiological data.

articleTitle: Analysis of Shanghai's Industrial Load Forecasting Based on Grey Prediction Method
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The energy plan for Shanghai's 14th Five Year Plan predicts that Shanghai's energy demand will steadily increase. Under the "dual carbon" target, Shanghai's energy consumption structure will be more optimized, and the increase in the proportion of clean energy will enhance the uncertainty of the power system. It is necessary to use more accurate method to predict Shanghai's power load. This article uses grey prediction method to forecast and analyze the power load of the entire industries in Shanghai from 2023 to 2025, and compares it with LSTM and BP neural network methods. Appropriate suggestions for the development of energy and power in Shanghai are provided based on the results.

articleTitle: Multi-objective optimization of aluminum electrolysis based on improved SHAP value
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that many parameters affecting each other in the process of aluminum electrolysis make it difficult to improve the current efficiency and unable to reach the expected production index, the multi-objective optimization idea is proposed to optimize the current efficiency as the primary objective, and optimize the other important parameters that have a large impact on the current efficiency and affect each other as the secondary objective. Firstly, the variance threshold and the improved SHAP value method are used to extract the important features such as aluminum level and electrolyte level. Then the prediction model and MOTROA multi-objective optimization algorithm are used to establish a multi-objective optimization model for the aluminum electrolysis production process to obtain the optimal ranges of parameters such as aluminum level, electrolyte temperature, and so on, and to achieve the goal of improving the current efficiency. The experimental results show that these important parameters are located in the optimal range while the current efficiency is increased.

articleTitle: A Multi-Model Fusion Approach for Transformer Fault Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Addressing the weak generalization capability and suboptimal prediction performance of single mechanistic and data-driven models, this paper proposes a transformer fault detection method based on the fusion of mechanism and data models. Firstly, vibration and current data are collected on-site to train the SVM vibration model and the Adaboost current model. Secondly, current simulation data is obtained using laboratory simulation software. This simulation data, combined with the current data collected under the same conditions on-site, is used as input to train the GBDT error compensation model. Finally, these three models are used as inputs to the GRNN, completing the overall model design. This fusion of mechanistic and data-driven models not only addresses the parameter mismatch issue of the mechanistic model under complex working conditions but also deeply mines time-series data. Experimental results show that The mean squared error of the fusion model is 0.002 lower than that of the data model, and the coefficient of determination is improved by 5.07% compared to the mechanistic model, enhancing the overall predictive accuracy of the model.

articleTitle: Image deblurring processing model combining spatial domain and frequency domain information
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The existing image deblurring methods usually use the spatial domain or frequency domain information directly to restore the clear image, ignoring the complementarity of spatial domain information and frequency domain information. The object structure can be recovered effectively by using the spatial domain information of the image, while the texture details can be recovered effectively through the frequency domain information. In this paper, a simple and effective image deblurring framework is proposed, which can make full use of the spatial domain and frequency domain information of the image to produce high quality clear images. First, two independent networks with the same structure are used to learn the mapping relationship between fuzzy image and clear image from spatial domain and frequency domain respectively. Then, a single fusion network is used to fully integrate the image information of the spatial domain and the frequency domain to further improve the quality of the clear image. The three networks are linked to form an end-to-end, learnable large network, and different networks influence each other and finally obtain high-quality clear images through joint optimization. Experimental results indicate the efficacy of the proposed image deblurring method, which fuses spatial domain and frequency domain information.

articleTitle: RegiLaneNet: Advanced Lane Detection through Regularization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: To make driverless cars and helper systems for drivers better, it's super important to be able to spot the lanes on the road really well. This means guessing where the lanes are going to be in all kinds of different places and weather. Sure, deep learning models have gotten way smarter, but it's still super tricky to mix together the big picture of what's happening on the road with the teeny-tiny details you need to figure out exactly where the lanes are. We made this cool new deep learning model called RegiLaneNet that's really good at spotting lanes. It uses a special rule to make fewer mistakes and looks at info in a smart way. This helps it understand pictures better because it pays attention to the shapes and sizes of things. When we tested it on some tricky lane-spotting problems, it scored 79.72% on one test and an even cooler 86.35% on another. This shows it's awesome at handling different kinds of roads.

articleTitle: Multi-Scale Feature Integrated Double Aggregation Network for Enhanced Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Over 90% of colorectal cancers gradually develop from colorectal polyps. Accurate polyp segmentation offers crucial information for the early detection of colorectal cancer. Nevertheless, the existing research on polyp segmentation in colonoscopy images encounters two major difficulties: the aggregation of polyp boundaries is challenging and the segmentation of small objects is difficult. To handle these problems and strike a fine balance between the quality of image segmentation and network parameters, this paper presents a novel polyp segmentation framework to address these two challenges. Specifically, a transformer encoder is employed, which is capable of learning a more potent and robust representation. Two standard modules are introduced, including the boundary aggregation module (BA) and the Deep secondary fusion module (GLRA). Among them, BA is utilized to aggregate the boundary features of low-level features and the semantic information of high-level features to better preserve boundary details and locate recalibrated targets. GLRA is adopted to collect the semantic and location information of polyps from high-level features, which possesses the ability to aggregate and represent global and local spatial features, which is beneficial for locating large and small targets respectively. Our proposed MFDA has carried out extensive experimental studies on Kvasir, ColonDB, and ETIS datasets. Experiments indicate that our network architecture outperforms the majority of the state-of-the-art methods under different evaluation metrics.

articleTitle: Mechanical Analysis of Semi-rigidly Connecting Curtain Wall Keel Frame
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Connection between bolts and corners is an important jointing connection for the curtain wall keel frame. Usually, the rigid joints are adopted in simulation computation of curtain wall keel frame structures without consideration of the influence of semi-rigid connection of bolts and corners. The initial rotational stiffness of connection between corners and bolts is calculated, the semi-rigidity of joints is simulated by using two-way spring elements with variable rigidity and zero length. The finite element model of semi-rigidly connected curtain wall keel frame is established, and the comparisons between the rigidly connected and semi-rigidly connected curtain wall keel frames with the same boundary conditions are carried out. The numerical results indicate that the semi-rigid connection reduces the stiffness and stability of the curtain wall keel frame, but it reduces the impact of stress on the curtain keel frame.

articleTitle: Real-time target detection and tracking in underwater environments based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: To solve the problems of low precision, insufficient real-time and weak robustness of traditional detection and tracking methods in complex underwater environment, the underwater real-time target detection and tracking based on deep learning is proposed. In this paper, the passive detection model of underwater unmanned submersible is constructed by using the aerial passive sonar buoy array. The adaptive correlation cross location technology of multiple passive sonar buoys is adopted to achieve data pre-processing before concealment detection. The dual threshold random Hough transform tracking before detection algorithm is used to meet the requirement of low detectability of multiple targets under the condition of high underwater noise density. Experimental results show that the detection probability of our method is higher than that of DP-TBD. At the same time, the average running time of the three methods decreases with the increase of SNR. Due to the use of random Hough transform, the timeliness of the method in this paper is obviously better than that of DPTBD and HT-TBD methods.

articleTitle: Practical Parameters Identification Method for Wind Turbine Frequency Control System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The primary frequency control parameters of a wind turbine determine its frequency regulation capability, playing a crucial role in grid dispatch. It is necessary to correctly identify the primary frequency control parameters of wind turbines. To address the above problem, we propose a method for recognizing the droop coefficients of wind turbines. Using the test results from the actual wind farm, the droop coefficients for the frequency modulation were calculated. Simulation results show that the calculated parameters are realistic.

articleTitle: Optimization and empirical study on demonstration of smart city administrative system driven by big data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Big data has become an important way to promote social development and achieve modernization of urban governance. Smart cities, as an important component of informatization and urban management, have significant implications for improving urban management efficiency, enhancing public service quality, and promoting sustainable economic development. In the context of deepening information technology and urban management, the wide application of big data technology brings unprecedented opportunities for the optimisation of the smart city governance system. In this study, the concepts of ‘ big data’ and ‘ smart city’ are firstly sorted out, and then the practical application of big data in the construction of smart city is discussed, and the core role of big data in the smart city governance system is further analysed. Based on the in-depth analysis of big data, this study aims to construct a scientific, refined and intelligent big data-driven urban governance system, in order to provide more effective solutions for urban governance.

articleTitle: Development and Design of a Service Robot System using Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper aims to develop an advanced and intelligent home service robot utilizing machine vision technology, with a focus on optimizing both the chassis movement system and the gripping mechanism. The design incorporates an omni-wheel chassis for stable omnidirectional movement and a multi-degree-of-freedom robotic arm to enhance the gripping capabilities. A novel lightweight target detection method is introduced, significantly improving detection efficiency by leveraging spatial information for path guidance. Through advanced path planning technology and SLAM (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping) algorithms, the robot ensures safe and efficient navigation within a home environment. Experimental results showcase exceptional performance in map construction, human silhouette recognition, and object identification, offering a cutting-edge technological solution for the advancement of home service robotics.

articleTitle: Data Analysis of Mechanical Properties of Steel Specimens Under Four-point Bending Load
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to investigate the bending resistance of a newly developed steel and to obtain comprehensive data characterizing its mechanical properties, this study proposes a solution that employs modeling and numerical calculations. Specifically, the solution consists of three parts. First, tensile specimens are prepared, and a universal mechanical testing machine is utilized to obtain stress-strain data. Second, a four-point bending loading model is established, and load parameters are defined. Finally, in conjunction with the simulation results, an in-depth analysis of the bending resistance of the steel is conducted. The findings indicate that the newly developed steel exhibits excellent bending resistance, deforming by 3 mm under an external load of 1308 N (single pressure head). Compared to traditional four-point bending tests, the research approach presented in this paper yields more extensive data. Furthermore, it reduces experimental costs and shortens testing time. This methodology has significant potential for application in the mechanical bending performance testing of newly developed materials.

articleTitle: 5G Base Station Atmospheric Duct Interference: Predictions Using the Mesoscale WRF Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Atmospheric ducting is a unique layering structure in the lower troposphere where the gradient of atmospheric refractive index differs from the norm, allowing radio signals to bend and travel along the Earth’s surface. In China’s coastal areas, particularly along the Bohai Sea, Yellow Sea, and East China Sea during the summer, these ducts are closely tied to the monsoon climate. On the North China Plain, the interaction between land high pressure and the subtropical high often results in evaporation ducts forming after rainfall. Low-level atmospheric ducts usually affect frequencies between 30 MHz and 5 GHz, with notable impacts on L, S, and C band radio systems. The TDD (Time Division Duplex) format used by 5G systems is especially vulnerable to such interference.To tackle this issue, this study has developed an atmospheric duct interference prediction model using the mesoscale WRF (Weather Research and Forecasting) model and conducted simulation tests in Pingdu City, Qingdao. The model aims to explore the temporal and spatial variations of atmospheric ducts in the area. By analyzing interference data from all China Mobile base stations in Pingdu City between July 2 and July 13, the study found that the model’s predictions matched the actual interference conditions at the base stations with about 84% accuracy, demonstrating the model’s validity.

articleTitle: Deep Seal Matching: Unleashing the Power of ViT-Triplet and Text Background Removal
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In Chinese society, seals are widely used to ensure the authority and validity of critical situations, holding significant importance. Therefore, seal authentication is crucial. Current authentication method relies on manual comparison, which is subjective and requires additional time and labor costs to train authentication personnel. To address these challenges, we propose a novel and highly effective seal matching algorithm. Our algorithm integrates the LAA data augmentation method with the advanced ViT-Triplet architecture, incorporating the ViT model and hard triplet loss. This approach achieves impressive results with CMC top-1, CMC top-5, mAP top-5, and mAP top-10 scores of 96.11%, 99.86%, 96.42%, and 96.01%, respectively. On this basis, the algorithm introduces text background removal during the inference stage, further improving overall performance with accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score of 98.47%, 98.61%, 98.33%, and 98.47%, respectively.

articleTitle: Locally Linear Embedding Based on Neiderreit Sequence Initialized Ali Baba and The Forty Thieves Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Manifold learning is a nonlinear dimensionality reduction technique that reveals the essential features and structure of data through dimensionality reduction. This technique has enormous theoretical research and industry application value in fields such as data visualization, denoising, and anomaly detection. Locally linear embedding (LLE) is a classic algorithm in manifold learning, which projects high-dimensional data into a low-dimensional space while maintaining the same algebraic structure. However, the optimization objective function of LLE uses L2 norm to measure linear approximation error, which can easily amplify and reduce the error. Therefore, in this paper, L1 norm is used instead of L2 norm to overcome this deficiency, but it also brings about the problem of non-smoothness in the optimization objective function. To address this issue, in this paper, a derivative-free optimization method called Neiderreit sequence initialize Ali Baba and the forty thieves (NSAFT) algorithm has been proposed, and demonstrates its effectiveness in finding the optimal solution for the objective function of LLE through numerical experiments.

Author Keywords: Ali Baba and the forty thieves algorithm

articleTitle: Pneumonia Image Recognition Based On Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This article introduces a comprehensive method for diagnosing pneumonia using chest X-ray (CXR) images. By using deep learning models for feature extraction and machine learning methods for classification, the effectiveness of feature extraction has been evaluated using CNN, ResNet.50, and ViT models. The performance of random forest and logistic regression classifiers based on these models were compared, conducting a comprehensive evaluation of accuracy and F1 score to determine the most effective model. This study addresses the challenges of diagnosing artificial pneumonia and emphasizes the urgency of automated solutions. In the end, the combination of ResNet.50 and logistic regression achieved higher accuracy (78.68%), higher precision (99.99%), and more ideal F1 score (0.6239). These results demonstrate that the application of deep learning in clinical diagnosis can improve the clinical efficiency and accuracy of pneumonia detection, which is beneficial for the subsequent treatment of patients.

articleTitle: A backdoor attack defense scheme in federated learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Federated learning allows for the effective flow of data value without leaving the local environment. It is considered an effective method for balancing data sharing and privacy protection in the context of the Internet of Things. However, federated learning systems are susceptible to Byzantine attacks and inference attacks, resulting in compromised system robustness and data privacy. A secure federated learning algorithm DP-FLABA based on gradient local density is proposed to address the Byzantine attack problem in the federated learning framework. This algorithm calculates the local density of each client gradient to determine whether the client is a Byzantine client, and then designs corresponding weights for weighted aggregation based on the local density of the secure gradient. At the same time, in response to privacy leakage issues, adaptive pruning and denoising techniques are adopted to protect model parameters. We have ensured data privacy while considering model robustness and accuracy, and theoretically analyzed the privacy of the protocol. The simulation results show that this scheme can effectively resist Byzantine attacks and inference attacks.

articleTitle: Anonymous Network Transmission Method Based on Identity Mapping
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Privacy issues are prevalent in network communications, where attackers can track and analyze sensitive information exchanged between communication parties, posing a threat to network communication security. On one hand, anonymous transmission mechanisms with multi-layer encryption can effectively protect user privacy. On the other hand, the concept of overlay networks can enhance security without modifying the existing network structure. In this paper, we designate the Identifier Network System as an internal network and design an anonymous network transmission method for inter-network communication. By designing nodes, the sending and receiving processes, data packet formats, tunnel transmission, distributed storage, and timely updates, we enhance the security of the transmission.

articleTitle: Multi-energy Complementary Optimization Scheduling Considering Oilfield Load Characteristics and Associated Resources
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: At present, oilfield production is facing the national requirements of "carbon peak and carbon neutrality". The oilfield distribution network has the characteristics of relatively fixed structure and difficult to reduce active power loss. Based on this, this study focuses on the efficient use of renewable energy in the oilfield power grid while considering load characteristics and associated resources, aiming to achieve a clean and low-carbon energy supply mode by building a multi-energy complementary system. Through an in-depth analysis of the source-load operation characteristics of the oilfield power grid, the corresponding system structure is proposed, and the energy flow model is established using a standardized modeling method. On this basis, the optimization goals of reducing the comprehensive operating cost and improving the renewable energy absorption capacity are set. Through MATLAB modeling and simulation, the effectiveness of the established multi-energy complementary system optimization and control model was successfully verified, providing strong support for the efficient operation of the oilfield power grid. This achievement not only helps to improve the oilfield power grid's ability to absorb renewable energy, but also effectively reduces operating costs and promotes the development of oilfields in a more environmentally friendly and economical direction.

articleTitle: Ambiguity Resolution in Vision-and-Language Navigation with Large Language Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) represents a novel approach that integrates visual perception and language understanding, thereby enabling autonomous agents to navigate complex environments based on natural language instructions. While traditional methods have enhanced navigation success rates, they continue to encounter obstacles in cross-modal alignment, generalization, and real-time decision-making. In order to address these issues, in this paper, we propose a VLN approach based on large language models (LLMs), utilising LLMs as planners. By vectorising both predefined and generated commands and employing k-nearest neighbours algorithm to identify the optimal match, the method resolves command mismatches and enhances system performance. The results of the experimental study demonstrate that our method significantly improves navigation success rates and efficiency in dynamic environments.

articleTitle: CPLD Implementation of Data Demultiplexing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Modern communication technology focuses on the development of digitalization, and digital multiplexing and demultiplexing technology is an important technology in communication technology. By combining multiple low-speed signals into one high-speed signal, it can improve bandwidth utilization and data transmission efficiency. The paper presents an eight channel tap of a complete 512KHz frame data. By setting up a frame synchronization module, a data counting module, a serial to parallel caching module, a parallel to serial caching module, and an output module, the eight low-speed signals are merged into one high-speed signal. Finally, the code is written using Quartus_II software, and the results are verified through Modelsim simulation and hardware download verification.

articleTitle: Research on Global Performance Evaluation and Optimization Technology for Energy Metering Devices of Distributed Generation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: As economic construction and social development continue to advance, the challenges facing energy resources are becoming increasingly severe. Distributed power generation, as a clean and renewable method of electricity supply, stands out for its environmental friendliness and flexibility, making it an important supplement to conventional power generation methods. This paper focuses on the operational characteristics of distributed power sources and conducts research on their metering systems. By analyzing the specific features and existing issues of current metering systems in handling distributed power, the paper proposes effective solutions to address situations where these systems fail to meet requirements.

articleTitle: Research on Power Security Control Technology Based on Multimode Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Power grid operation, equipment maintenance, construction and other power grid field operations, the task is heavy, many points and wide. There are many dangerous factors in the process of power grid operation, including human factors, environmental factors, equipment factors, management factors and other influencing factors. Aiming at the problems of single mode and complex factor, a multi-mode fusion method is proposed. Based on the operation ticket mechanism in the "two votes and three systems" of the power system, under the supervision of the original traditional IP layout and control ball, various influencing factors on the site are collected as comprehensively as possible combined with sensors such as blood oxygen, gas concentration, tension, pressure and inclination Angle, and the information characteristics feedback from these factors are utilized across modes. Multi-level fusion method is adopted to fuse the text features extracted by BERT and the image features extracted by Faster R-CNN at an early stage, which improves the normalization of the operation process. By making decision fusion of image features and sensor features extracted by LSTM, the alarm of potential hazards is advanced. Under the multi-mode integration, the average level of overall risk prevention and control on the job site has been improved.

articleTitle: A Reconnaissance Technology of UAV Up/Down-Link Based on ADRV9009 RF Transceiver
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Low-cost commercial UAV has become a serious threat to airports, seaports and other important positions. It has the advantages of low observability, stealth in approaching and detection difficulty by radar and electro-optical sensors etc. The paper proposes a reconnaissance technique of UAV up/down-link communication signal based on AD9009 RF transceiver. Signal is received by 4-channel ADRV9009 RF transceiver and signal detection is conducted through delay self-correlation algorithm. 4-channel interferometer algorithm based on FFT phase solving-ambiguity is employed to achieve accurate DF of up/down-link. According to practical test, the proposal in this paper can achieve accurate DF to UAV targets within 4km.

articleTitle: AI Model Training Data Privacy Protection Scheme Based on Local Differential Privacy
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In this paper, we present a novel AI model training data privacy protection scheme based on local differential privacy (LDP), aimed at safeguarding sensitive data in distributed environments. The method introduces dynamic noise adjustment to balance privacy and accuracy, optimizing model performance without compromising privacy. During the data preprocessing phase, the scheme applies standardization, handles missing values, and ensures format consistency. Noise is added dynamically to both the data and model gradients during training to further enhance privacy. The proposed method's scalability and computational efficiency were validated in large-scale, real-time AI applications, demonstrating significant reductions in overhead compared to centralized differential privacy techniques. Our results show that the dynamic adjustment of noise helps maintain high model accuracy while offering robust privacy guarantees, making the scheme ideal for use in distributed AI systems.

articleTitle: Carrier communication system based on secure encryption AD hoc network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: HPLC is a high-speed power line carrier, also known as broadband power line carrier, is a broadband power line carrier technology for data Broadband power line carrier communication network is a communication network with power line as the communication medium, which realizes the convergence, transmission and interaction of low-voltage power lines. Broadband power line carrier communication network is a communication network with power line as the communication medium, which realizes the convergence, transmission and interaction of low-voltage power users' electricity information. A carrier A carrier communication system based on security encryption and adaptive is proposed in this paper. The hardware circuit system of this system includes HPLC and HRF main control chip, RF channel and power line communication system. The hardware circuit system of this system includes HPLC and HRF main control chip, RF channel, PLC channel, zero crossing detection, power supply, clock and encryption. At the same time, the carrier communication system of secure encryption AD hoc network is included, such as wireless MESH network. At the same time, the carrier communication system of secure encryption AD hoc network is included, such as wireless MESH AD hoc network and HPLC network.

articleTitle: MemMat-YOLOX: An Intelligent Detection Method for Weld defects for DR Video Images
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: DR digital real-time imaging technology can generate continuous video data and has become an important method for detecting large diameter spiral pipe welds. However, the existing manual viewing of DR video data recognition defects can easily lead to poor consistency and low efficiency in the results. Meanwhile, current defect detection models lack the ability to integrate temporal information, which can easily lead to the lost of small scale defects information in DR video. To solve the above problems, a defect detection method based on MemMat YOLOX for DR video data of pipe welds has been proposed. First, the existing multi-scale convolution structure is improved by building matrix network module (MatrixNets), and the detection ability of large aspect ratio features of defects is improved. Then, a diversity perception feature memory aggregation module (DP-FMAM) is introduced, which is able to store and update diversity feature information in the video data. Finally, for the problem of weak feature expression of single-frame DR image, multi-head attention mechanism is integrated to improve the ability of detecting the model. Through the verification on the actual enterprise data set, the results show that the proposed method improves the video defects precision and reduces the lost.

articleTitle: Research and Analysis of General Aviation Controlled Flight Into Terrain Accidents Based on HFACS Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: We use the Human Factors Analysis and Classification System (HFACS) framework to classify and statistically analyze 63 controlled flight into terrain (CFIT) accidents that have occurred in the Chinese general aviation field since 2000. It reveals the human factor causes behind the accidents and provides practical guidance and suggestions for safety management and accident prevention in general aviation enterprises.

articleTitle: Structured Component Welding Automation Intelligent Production Control System Pattern Research
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper primarily constructs a modular and flexible production management and control system aimed at the automated welding requirements of different enterprises. It forms a customized welding automation production control system model, relying on the existing welding work environment of the enterprise. By combining the requirements of welding automation with the characteristics of the enterprise's structured components, it provides an intelligent production management and control approach according to the production process that matches the enterprise's requirements. This serves as an example for the systematic management of intelligent welding systems in enterprises.

articleTitle: DEAH-Net: A Dual-Modal 3D-CNN Framework for sEMG and Acceleration-Based HMI
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Recent advancements in human-machine interaction (HMI) have significantly enhanced applications in bionic robotics, intelligent prosthetics, augmented reality (AR), and virtual reality (VR). To address these challenges, we propose DEAH-Net, a dual-modal 3D convolutional neural network (3D-CNN) integrating sEMG and triaxial acceleration data. Data is acquired via a high-resolution ADS1298 analog-to-digital converter and MPU6050 sensors, managed by an NRF52832 microcontroller for preprocessing. DEAH-Net features a two-branch architecture combining Dense-Net with an Acceleration Information Enhancement Branch (AIEB), significantly improving gesture and force classification accuracy. Experiments demonstrate that DEAH-Net achieves 99.9951% accuracy in gesture recognition tasks, showing strong generality and robustness across various environments. DEAH-Net presents an efficient and practical solution for multimodal gesture recognition in HMI applications.

articleTitle: The effects of power structure and government intervention on green dual-channel supply chain
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper considers one manufacturer-two retailers dual-channel supply chain that the manufacturer sells same products to two retailers and an environmentally conscious government working with the manufacturer to improve the green level of products. A new concept is carried out called different power structures between two retailers in the green supply chain, which consists balanced power structure and dominant power retailer structure in the market. Then four scenarios are proposed based on different power structures among retailers and cooperation between government and manufacturer. The optimal analytical solutions under four scenarios are derived through backward derivation in Stackelberg game. The influence of power imbalance of retailers on manufacturer’s environmental activities, pricing and profits is explained. Finally, the effects of government decision and power structure on profits are proposed.

articleTitle: Wildfire risk assessment using multi-source remote sensing data and GIS
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This study estimated the spatiotemporal pattern changes of wildfire risk by timely remote sensing and in-situ data. The evaluation index system was constructed based on 14 wildfire-influencing factors (categorized into four classes: human activities, topography, meteorology, and vegetation), the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP), and the Entropy Weight Method. The results indicate that wildfires mainly occur in winter and spring in the study area, and the spatial differences in monthly wildfire risk are primarily influenced by the vegetation Leaf Area Index (LAI) and meteorological conditions, followed by human activities and topographical factors. High wildfire risk values in Beijing are distributed near the urban built-up areas in the southeast and east, while high-risk areas are located in the mountainous regions of the west and north. The higher static wildfire risk indicates the temperature has more impact on wildfire risk than that of the LAI. Spatially, the wildfire risk is relatively high in Shunyi District, Tongzhou District, Daxing District, and Fangshan District of the study area, while it is lower in Miyun District, Huairou District, and Changping District. This paper leveraged the latest remote sensing and meteorological observation data to conduct a spatiotemporal pattern assessment of wildfire risk, which can provide a scientific basis for wildfire prevention and management in the study area.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Artificial Intelligence Generated Content (AIGC) on Virtual Community Marketing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: As an important branch of the field of artificial intelligence, the technology of Artificial Intelligence Generated Content (AIGC) has developed rapidly in recent years. With the popularity of the Internet and the development of social media, virtual community marketing has become one of the important means of enterprise marketing. More and more enterprises begin to try to apply AIGC technology to virtual community marketing, which has brought new opportunities and challenges for virtual community marketing. This study builds a conceptual model to explain the influence of AIGC on virtual community marketing. This model is tested on the survey data from some virtual communities in China. The empirical results show that the influence of AIGC (content multimodality and content interactivity) on virtual community marketing (forwarding intention and brand attitudes) are mediated by users’ perceived interestingness and perceived usefulness.

articleTitle: Research on Ship Crew Scheduling Algorithm Based on Improved Grey Wolf Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Crew scheduling in civilian ships is a combinatorial optimization problem with various constraints. Traditional methods struggle with large-scale scheduling, while classic algorithms often fail to balance performance and practicality. This paper presents an Improved Grey Wolf Optimization (IGWO) algorithm. We establish a mixed-integer programming model that considers hard and soft constraints to maximize crew-position matching. The IGWO algorithm enhances the standard Grey Wolf Optimization (GWO) framework by integrating strategies like heuristic initialization, adaptive encirclement search, elite leader selection, and constraint violation repair. Simulation on random and real-world datasets show that IGWO outperforms manual methods, rule-based heuristics, and the standard GWO algorithm in objective function value, constraint satisfaction, and employee satisfaction. This research advances heuristic optimization in combinatorial problems.

articleTitle: Study on Bidding Mechanism Design and Clearing Mode under Safety Regulation Mode
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the access of large-scale new energy, the external cost of new power system security has increased significantly, and the situation of power grid security and supply is increasingly severe. In this context, this paper draws lessons from the balanced market trading model in Europe, proposes the balance regulation service, improves the transaction and clearing mechanism of the current day-ahead market, establishes the joint operation mechanism of new energy participating in electric energy-balance regulation service, and realizes the internalization of security external costs., Based on the probability of balance principle, establish electric energy and balance regulation service joint clearing model, soft electric energy trading curve, avoid high proportion of new energy access system down the problem of insufficient ability, at the same time through the market, accurately meet the demand of each time balance regulation service, greatly improve the security and economy of the overall clearing results, meet the new energy access under the power system security for demand.

articleTitle: Research on Electric Vehicle V2G Charging and Discharging Strategies Based on Market Supply and Demand Relationship
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the rapid development of the electric vehicle industry and the increasing contradiction between electric vehicle charging load and grid supply, optimizing electric vehicle charging and discharging strategies has become urgent. The interaction between electric vehicles (EV) and the grid is gradually becoming an important component of the energy system. Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) technology allows electric vehicles to return stored energy to the grid during peak power demand, thereby playing a role in 'peak shaving and valley filling' and improving grid reliability. This paper explores the optimization methods for V2G charging and discharging strategies based on the relationship between market supply and demand. An optimization model for electric vehicle charging and discharging is established, considering the game relationship between supply and demand, to determine the optimal electricity pricing strategy and electric vehicle charging and discharging strategy. Simulation results show that the proposed strategy can significantly stabilize the variance of the base load curve, greatly reduce the peak-to-valley difference in grid supply, reduce electric vehicle users' charging and discharging costs by more than 36%, and significantly increase the revenue of aggregators.

articleTitle: Research On Typical Network Access Control Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the expansion of the network scale and the increase of the number of users, network security issues are becoming increasingly prominent and the digitalization process is accelerating. Users' demands for the network are increasingly diversified, so it is very important to accurately control the access behavior of network users. As one of the core devices of the network, BRAS has strong security protection capability. In-depth study of BRAS network access control technology will not only help to improve the overall security level of the network, optimize network performance, improve data transmission speed, reduce delay, provide users with a smoother and more stable network physical examination, but also promote the innovation and development of network technology.

articleTitle: Flow measurement device based on self feedback system
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The velocity measurement of gas-liquid two-phase flow has a wide range of applications in many industrial production and trade settlements. The complex flow state of two-phase flow makes its measurement difficult. At the same time, China's traceability of two-phase flow is also in its infancy, and there is no effective traceability system, which makes the measurement of two-phase flow velocity very difficult. This article studies the velocity measurement of gas-liquid two-phase flow by building a gas-liquid two-phase flow control system and device with PLC control as the core. The device utilizes self feedback to achieve overall control, data acquisition, and regulation functions of the system process. The diameter of the manifold is DN25, achieving two-phase convergence within a flow range of (0.5-10) m3/h. Pressure tracking is used to ensure consistent pressure during the two-phase control process.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Permission Management Method Based on RBAC Model in Collaborative Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Spacecraft multi-disciplinary collaborative design requires a complex collaborative design platform. During the process of multi-disciplinary collaborative design, there are complex management relationships among projects, tasks, data, roles, users, and permissions. Permission management of the collaborative design platform has become the core content of the system, In situations where there are no permissions or improper management of permissions, issues such as unreasonable resource allocation, important data leakage, role-permission conflicts, and system security threats can arise. In the Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) model, the complexity of role inheritance relationships may lead to multiple judgments regarding permissions, This will increase system expenditure and trigger conflicts, leading to a significant drop in user experience. This paper, based on practical applications, describes a flexible and secure role management method for permission management designed within the RBAC model for a large collaborative design platform in the aerospace field. It achieves collaborative project management with considerable practicality.

articleTitle: A method for measuring network channel delay for virtual power plant aggregation control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Virtual power plants aggregate different distributed energy sources, combine them into a whole, participate in the operation of the electricity market, and become the development direction of the future power grid. This article proposes a critical node protection strategy for virtual power plant CPS networks under three architectures: decentralized architecture, centralized architecture, and fully decentralized architecture, which cannot effectively resist intentional attacks. Firstly, introduce the construction and feature analysis of the virtual power plant's cyber physical network topology, as well as their coupling relationships; Then, the cascading failure process was explained in detail, and the cascading failure processes of the three architectures were shown separately with pictures; Secondly, the reliability analysis of the virtual power plant information physical system is introduced, including the reliability evaluation model, key node protection strategy, and two reliability indicators; Finally, the reliability indicators of the three architecture networks under critical node protection were tested separately, verifying that the critical node protection strategy can effectively resist intentional attacks and improve the reliability of the network.

articleTitle: Design of a Finger Vein Recognition Algorithm Based on Improved ResNet
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper presents an improved ResNet-18-based algorithm for finger vein recognition to address the challenges posed by insufficient data and difficult recognition tasks. By leveraging a pre-trained ResNet-18 model from the large-scale ImageNet dataset, the model benefits from the pre-learned complex features and patterns. Transfer learning was applied to fine-tune the entire model on a 106-class finger vein image dataset, optimizing both runtime and recognition accuracy. The experimental results demonstrate that the improved model achieves a recognition accuracy of 97.525%, outperforming the original ResNet-18 by 2.9%. This improvement highlights the model’s effectiveness in finger vein image classification.

articleTitle: Research on Environmental Perception Based on YOLOv8 and LiDAR Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: To enhance the sensing capability of driverless cars in complex dynamic scenarios, a fusion method of radar and depth camera is emphasized and a technical framework for integrating multi-source sensors is proposed. A YOLOv8 neural network detection model combined with a self-attention network structure is first used to achieve correct recognition and depth estimation of vehicles and pedestrians, then further distance data of dynamic environment is acquired by M10P LiDAR, and finally information from D435i camera and radar information are fused by matrix projection. In the experiments, the conventional YOLOv8 model was compared to the YOLOv8 model enhanced with self-attention, the camera and LIDAR measurements were evaluated against the fusion results. The experimental results demonstrate that the new model significantly improves the confidence and stability of target detection, while the fused distance measurements are more accurate than those from individual sensors.

articleTitle: Damage Efficiency Analysis of Continuous Metal Jet Based on Shaped Charge Effect
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The high-velocity metal jet generated by the energy gathering effect has a strong destructive effect on the target. The basic properties of metal jet generated by the explosion of shaped charge is described and the damage mechanism of metal jet on target is exposited. Besides, the theoretical model of continuous metal jet penetration into the target is established. The penetration results of metal jets under different conditions are simulated with the theoretical model. It is found that the speed gradient, shape, and explosion height of the metal jet have a significant impact on penetration depth and diameter. The greater the velocity gradient of the metal jet, the greater the penetration depth and the smaller the penetration diameter. The cylindrical metal jet brings a larger penetration diameter on the target surface, but the penetration diameter decreases significantly as the penetration depth increases. The conical metal jet with a diameter difference between the head and tail brings a smaller difference in penetration diameter on the target surface. The difference in the penetration volume of the target penetrated by the two different kinds of metal jets is relatively small. The penetration depth and diameter under different explosion height are simulated theoretically. The results show that explosion height effects penetration depth and diameter significantly, which is consistent with previous research.

articleTitle: Target State Estimation Based on the Combination of Deep Learning and Unscented Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This article studies a target state estimation method based on Unmanned Aerial Vehicle(UAV) observation images, focusing on the problem of unknown target motion models and observation noise interference. We propose a DeepUKF algorithm that combines Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) and Unscented Kalman Filter (UKF). The algorithm uses the LSTM network to learn the target state transition model and system observation noise and then uses them as inputs for the UKF algorithm. This method effectively combines the feature learning ability of deep learning with the interpretability and robustness of the Kalman filter. Through simulation experiments on tracking maneuvering targets, the DeepUKF algorithm has shown excellent performance in the accuracy and stability of target state estimation.

articleTitle: Design of a Simulation System for Quadruped Robot based on Gazebo
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: As a highly flexible and adaptable type of robot, quadruped robots have broad application prospects in military, rescue, industrial and other fields. Simulation technology plays a crucial role in the design, development, and testing of quadruped robots, which can greatly reduce research and development costs and risks, and improve research and development efficiency. This article first introduces the development history and research status of quadruped robots. Then, the advantages of simulating quadruped robots based on Gazebo were elaborated, and the design process of the Gazebo based quadruped robot simulation system and the design points of related modules were discussed in detail. Finally, the simulation system underwent simple testing, and the test results showed that the simulation system can achieve simulation of quadruped robot motion control. The test results show that the designed Gazebo based quadruped robot simulation system can achieve simulation of robot motion control, making it convenient for relevant R&D personnel to test various motion control algorithms without real robots.

articleTitle: Design of Data lineage Analysis Framework Based on Multivariate Attribute Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the advent of the digital age, it has become a consensus that data is an important asset, and it has become a common means to use data platform to manage and analyze data. However, in the process of enterprise data modeling or application, there are often a large number of chain reference relationships (data lineage) between data, which play an important role in data mining. How to construct more abundant data lineage and effectively carry out data lineage analysis has become one of the main challenges in data application and analysis. Therefore, this paper proposes a framework design of data lineage analysis framework based on multivariate attribute fusion. By supplementing the scope of data lineage, three-layer data lineage graphs are constructed to express different levels relationship, and various graph analysis algorithms are used to predict data lineage and reason to complete data lineage graphs, which can effectively support richer and more accurate data consanguinity applications.

articleTitle: Research on multi-physics coupling calculation and fast computation method of power equipment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The application of artificial intelligence and digital twin technology in intelligent decision-making and control of power grid has attracted much attention, which raises the demand for panoramic state perception and dynamic and flexible regulation of power equipment. Transformers are widely used in power grid, but the transformer equipment is prone to high local temperature, which seriously affects the safe and stable operation of power system. Therefore, in order to ensure safe and stable operation, it is necessary to analyze the temperature distribution of the transformer. This paper firstly obtains the temperature distribution under different working conditions through the multi-physical field coupling calculation of the transformer, and then obtains sample data on this basis, and then builds a proxy model to realize the rapid calculation results of the temperature field of the transformer winding.

articleTitle: Attention-Based Feature Fusion Network for Comic Character Personality Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: As a popular form of entertainment and art, comics provide readers with rich stories and visual enjoyment. The types of characters in comics are rich and diverse with unique charm. The appearance, lines and actions of comic characters are all part of the role shaping. In order to better analyze comic characters' personalities through comic images and lines, and further obtain information between comic text and image data, this paper proposes an attention-based fusion neural network, which consists of three parts: feature extraction, cross-modal feature learning, and personality prediction. The effectiveness of this network is validated through experiments based on the Manga109 and Manga109Dialog datasets.

articleTitle: Construction and Performance Analysis of Two-Dimensional Variable-Weight Optical MOLS/VWFRS Code
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: A new MOLS/VWFRS code, characterized by a two-dimensional variable-weight optical code that utilizes mutually orthogonal latin square (MOLS) for wavelength hopping and variable weight fixed right shift (VWFRS) code for time spreading, is proposed. The code can support multiple Quality of Service (QoS) requirements, and the wavelength hopping sequence can reach the maximum code capacity of the wavelength hopping code. The construction method of MOLS/VWFRS is presented, and the performance was analytically studied for the proposed techniques in terms of bit error rate (BER), autocorrelation, cross-correlation and the number of users. The error characteristics of different parameters are analyzed. The obtained results, when the wavelength hopping sequence is the same, increasing the code weight can effectively reduce the BER. The BER of MOLS/VWFRS is reduced by 5 ~ 9 orders of magnitude compared to reported techniques such OOC/SVWOOC and N-QCHC/SVWOOC in the same time spreading sequence. MOLS/VWFRS code can effectively improve the BER performance and has a higher capacity.

articleTitle: Two-dimensional Transient electromagnetic data based on U-NET
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Transient electromagnetic method is an active source time-domain electromagnetic method that achieves geological exploration by observing the decay process of the secondary electromagnetic field generated by an ungrounded closed loop or a grounded long straight conductor. In recent years, machine learning has achieved good results in various fields, and this paper applies the U-NET network in machine learning to the two-dimensional inversion of transient electromagnetic method, developing a U-NET-based two-dimensional inversion algorithm for transient electromagnetic method. Different models are designed for verification, validating and discussing the feasibility of convolutional neural networks in geophysical exploration.

articleTitle: Research on digital transformation of spacecraft development
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the increase of the complexity, cost and development cycle of satellite development, document design intensively under baseline management pattern with PLM system has been difficult to meet the needs of efficient and real-time collaborative design. There are some problems in this pattern such as discrete data sources, discontinuous data flow, and low efficiency of inter-specialty collaborative iteration, which restrict the overall efficiency and level of satellite development. In this paper, a digital development mode based on model penetration is proposed to comprehensively optimize and sort out the collaborative business process of the whole life cycle of spacecraft development, and adopt advanced information technology to form a new and complete R & D capability system. Based on the model, digital collaborative design and simulation verification are carried out to achieve rapid verification and iteration of scheme design, greatly reduce physical tests, and improve the efficiency of R & D design. Through the digital main line, the whole life cycle data will be gathered together and linked to form a complete global and unique truth source, evolutionary traceability chain and comprehensive data view, and promote the integration of the physical form and digital form of the satellite to achieve digital delivery.

articleTitle: Substation defect detection model based on self-supervised learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: To enhance the accuracy of substation equipment defect detection with a small number of labeled samples, an improved defect detection algorithm based on self-supervised model SimSiam was proposed. Different from the original SimSiam, the improved algorithm does not need to use iconic images, but directly uses non-iconic images for contrast learning. The performance of the supervised method is comparable to that of the downstream defect detection task. By using full convolutional network and spatial attention module instead of MLP in projection head and prediction head, the spatial structure and local information of high dimensional features are preserved. At the same time, before calculating the similarity, the eigenvector is obtained by means pooling of the feature graph, and the eigenvector is normalized to calculate the Euclidean distance, thus improving the loss function of self-supervised contrast learning. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can make full use of non-iconic images for contrast learning and improve the accuracy of substation equipment defect detection when only a few samples are marked.

articleTitle: A Learning Muti-Sources Weight Algorithm of Electromagnetic spectrum Cooperative Cognition
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With more and more smart devices have been used in many fields, there are many complex electromagnetic behaviors or dangerous signals through these devices. In this paper, a novel framework to learning multi-sources weight algorithm(LMSW) is presented to electromagnetic spectrum signal cooperative cognition to recognize these signals. These signals of the target from different sensors are fused by a learning weight matrix through the whole train network. Different signals from different received sensors are assigned different contributions to the cognition or some other mission. Features of the fused signals are extracted by deep learning network automatically. The experiment results show that the more accuracy is got through the LMSW algorithm than other methods.

articleTitle: A Campus Network Traffic Prediction Method Based on the ARIMA-CNN-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: A secure, stable, and efficient campus network environment is the foundation of information-based teaching and research in schools. An efficient and accurate campus network traffic prediction model will help in timely forecasting of network trends and identifying potential issues. In this paper, we construct a combined model to achieve accurate predictions based on the real historical traffic data of the campus network. Firstly, we use the ARIMA model to fit the linear part of the data and extract the residuals to obtain their temporal dependencies and trends. Subsequently, the CNN-LSTM model is employed to correct the residuals, aiming to rectify errors in future ARIMA model predictions and thereby achieve more accurate network traffic prediction. The proposed model was tested in a real-world scenario using school data, achieving an R2 value of 0.9884. Additionally, we compared our model with seven widely used models under the same environment. The experimental results demonstrate that the model proposed in this paper outperforms the comparison models in terms of Root Mean Square Error (RMSE), Mean Absolute Error (MAE), and Coefficient of Determination (R2).

articleTitle: Algorithm for interference-free tool orientation planning in multi-axis CNC machining
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The introduction of multi axis CNC machining tool orientations improve the flexibility of motion, but also brings problems such as tool interference and nonlinear errors. A tool orientation planning method for multi axis CNC machining is proposed. In this method, the Gaussian sphere is introduced to solve the reachable region, and is expressed in a reachable matrix. A tool orientation planning method based on the reachable matrix is proposed. Results show that tool interference free path can be achieved while ensuring higher machining accuracy and efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on quotation strategy and clearing model of energy storage participating in power market
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: As the proportion of renewable energy increases, the demand for efficient energy storage systems on the grid continues to grow. In this paper, a comprehensive market clearing and pricing model of energy storage is proposed by combining the bidding strategy of energy storage and the clearing and pricing method of energy storage right. The model includes the trading of power rights and capacity rights to meet the diverse needs of users, and introduces a bidding strategy based on the charge and discharge price difference to optimize the market participation of energy storage users. We have established a unified clearing model and designed a fair pricing method to ensure that the interests of all market players are protected under various market conditions. Through theoretical analysis and numerical simulation, this model not only maximizes the economic value of energy storage and improves the benefits of energy storage users, but also improves social welfare and ensures the reasonable benefits of power generation, load and energy storage parties. Compared with the traditional market clearing mechanism, this model more effectively ADAPTS to the needs of energy storage users and reduces the risk of price fluctuations.

articleTitle: Impact of Deep Generative Models on College English Classroom Interaction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the development of information technology, teaching reforms have been innovated, and the quality of university programs has become higher and higher. However, the emergence and widespread application of deep generative models have brought more challenges and opportunities to classroom teaching. With the continuous development of educational technology and the updating of teaching concepts, the depth generation model, as an emerging teaching mode, is gradually receiving attention from the educational community. In order to verify the effectiveness of the depth generation model, this study selected a certain number of college English classes as experimental subjects, and conducted in-depth data analysis and discussion by comparing the differences between the experimental group and the control group in terms of the frequency of interactions, the quality of interactions, the degree of student participation and learning effects. By comparing the classroom effects of using a deep generative modelling classroom with a traditional classroom, the study found that students’ overall grades in English classrooms using deep generative modelling improved by approximately 31 points, and that the average completion rate of assignments in deep generative modelling classrooms was 94.8%, which was much higher than that of traditional classrooms.

articleTitle: AGV Path Planning Algorithm Based on Improved DQN
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the context of rapid growth in the logistics and e-commerce industries, improving the efficiency of automated warehousing systems, particularly in sorting and throughput, has become crucial. Automated guided vehicles (AGVs) have increasingly replaced human workers in handling and sorting tasks, leading to significant improvements in efficiency and accuracy. Path planning, a core AGV technology, plays a vital role in optimizing logistics operations and reducing transportation costs. Common path planning algorithms, such as Dijkstra and A*, each have strengths and limitations. While Dijkstra’s algorithm guarantees finding the shortest path by exploring all possible nodes, it suffers from high time and space complexity. A*, though more efficient, sometimes compromises optimality by neglecting certain nodes. Current algorithms overlook the impact of excessive turns, which increases travel time. Deep reinforcement learning (DRL), by combining deep learning and reinforcement learning, offers a promising solution to path planning in dynamic, complex environments. DRL can make intelligent decisions without pre-constructed maps, adapting to the environment through training. In this paper, an improved DQN-based algorithm for AGV path planning is proposed, introducing the concepts of a turning factor and a smoothness factor to address the time cost of turns. By enhancing DQN’s state and reward design, the algorithm minimizes the number of turns while maintaining the shortest possible path. Experimental results demonstrate that this approach outperforms traditional A*, modified A*, and standard DQN algorithms, reducing transport time by approximately 21.3% compared to the best-performing baseline, the improved A* algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Benefit evaluation model of University Education Informatization based on data Mining Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: At present, the assessment of the benefits of education informatization has gradually become one of the hot issues in the field of education informatization research in China. In this paper, we try to put forward a benefit assessment model of education informatization, trying to examine the benefits of education informatization at the university level from a new perspective. The application of benefit assessment in university education is mainly to assess the benefits of talent cultivation, organizational management, etc., to ensure that the investment in education can bring the expected social and economic benefits. It can understand the development capacity and operational efficiency of universities, help universities to optimize the allocation of resources and improve economic efficiency and service quality.

articleTitle: A Novel Image Restoration Approach Based on Model for Fresnel Zone Plate Imaging System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Fresnel zone plate (FZP) is predominant diffraction optics element for space-based telescope with large diameter. However, the imaging quality of FZP is insufficient to meet the requirement of space imaging owing to the multiple orders diffraction characteristics of FZP, and wavefront aberrations. In this paper an approach based-on imaging model and cuckoo searching is given to acquire the optimum point spread function (PSF), and to improve image quality. The initial values of PSF and diffraction efficiency in cuckoo searching are obtained, when the lab system of FZP imaging is set up. The image restoration experiments are completed according to imaging model with the optimum parameters. The result shows that the values of four kind metrics, standard error, image gradient, image contrast, and natural quality evaluator are improved. The imaging quality of FZP imaging system is evidently prompt, especially in image details and gray contrast. Therefore, the image restoration method is applicable in FZP imaging system with low complexity and real time, especially for the prepossessing for on-line imaging system with wavefront sensor-less adaptive optics.

articleTitle: Soil Moisture Prediction Based on Spatiotemporal Graph Convolution Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Soil moisture(SM) content is a key factor in agriculture, ecosystem and environmental management. Aiming at the difficulty of obtaining high-quality spatiotemporal continuous soil moisture information, Oklahoma region was selected as our test area. Temporal Graph Convolutional Network (TGCN) deep learning method based on spatiotemporal fusion was used to predict spatiotemporal continuous deep soil moisture information in Oklahoma region, and multiple indicators were used to evaluate this method. The results demonstrate that the soil moisture predicted by TGCN method at four depths in Oklahoma is extremely close to the measured data, and the fitting degree R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> of TGCN model is 0.99, which is 0.02 and 0.05 higher than that of GRU model and GCN model, respectively. According to the results, the method of soil moisture prediction based on deep learning is feasible, which provides a potentially prediction method for obtaining multi-level and high-precision soil moisture in Oklahoma, and also provides another new thinking for soil moisture prediction in other areas.

articleTitle: Multi-scale Fusion Dehazing Algorithm based on Generative Adversarial Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In haze weather, visible light is scattered and absorbed when it passes through the atmosphere, causing significant degradation in image quality. To address this issue, we propose a multi-scale fusion dehazing algorithm based on an improved Generative Adversarial Network (GAN). In the generator part, we design a multi-scale fusion attention network (Grid-G) with a three rows, multi-column structure.
