The network first extracts and strengthens local and global features in the image through a feature enhancement module, effectively solving the problem that traditional dehazing methods cannot fully capture image details and global semantic information. Then, channel attention and coordinate attention are introduced to process the dense fog area and high-frequency area of the image from different angles. Finally, a multi-scale fusion module is designed to replace the original ordinary feature splicing operation and enhance the detail fidelity of the image.In the discriminator part, a fusion discriminator (FDG-D) is constructed to enhance the ability to distinguish the source of the image by introducing the high-frequency and low-frequency information of the image as additional priors. The experimental results show that the algorithm proposed in this paper not only has natural colors and clear details subjectively, but also outperforms the existing mainstream algorithms in objective indicators.

articleTitle: Study on VSC-HVDC Active and Reactive Decoupling Control Based on MATLAB/Simulink
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Compared with AC transmission, DC transmission has many unique advantages. Active and reactive power in VSC-HVDC system can be independently controlled by d-axis current component and q-axis current component in dq0 coordinate system. In this paper, the general dynamic mathematical model of the VSC-HVDC system based on voltage source converter is established under the synchronous rotating coordinate system, and then the VSC-HVDC decoupling control principle is derived. According to the existing control scheme, the voltage current double loop control method is designed. The VSC-HVDC system is established by using MATLAB/Simulink software. The simulation experiment of this control method proves that it really realizes decoupling control, and the control effect is good. It has fast response speed and good stability for various disturbances and has high stability accuracy at different working points.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of ECG classification based on heart rate variability analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Heart rate variability (HRV) analysis is a non-invasive method derived from electrocardiogram (ECG) data that reflects the activity of both the sympathetic and vagus nerves. To conduct HRV analysis, this study first presents an R-peak detection algorithm which consists of digital filtering, Shannon energy envelope and Hilbert transform. Next, heart rate variability analysis including time domain analysis, frequency domain analysis and nonlinear analysis is calculated. After that, the features are fed into a LightGBM classifier for multi-class classification. The MIT-BIH arrhythmia database is used for evaluation. The R-peak detection algorithm achieves average detection accuracy of 99.78%, precision of 99.93%, recall of 99.84%. Significance tests demonstrate that heart rate variability analysis indicates a significant difference between the normal group and the arrhythmia group. The multi-class arrhythmia classification achieves average precision of 98.18%, recall of 98.17% and accuracy of 96.43%.

articleTitle: Discussion on the Evolution Route and Development Evaluation Method of High-Energy-Level Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: As an important part of the new power system, the construction and development of the high-energy-level distribution network is of great significance to realize the energy transformation and upgrade the city energy level. First, the connotation of the high-energy distribution network is defined and the characteristics of the high-energy-level distribution network are analyzed. Next, the framework of the high-energy-level distribution network is constructed to form the indicators of each level. Then, the key objectives of the construction of the high-energy-level distribution network are illustrated. The scoring model and the weights of indicators at all levels are established. Finally, the index system is used to calculate and evaluate the construction level of the high-energy-level distribution network in different stages. The effectiveness and adaptability of the proposed method are verified by a provincial power grid.

articleTitle: SmartTD: A Web Platform for Tie-Dye Pattern Generation and Digital Innovation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Today, the utilization of modern technological means to advance traditional tie-dye techniques has emerged as a critical issue that requires immediate attention. To address this, we propose an approach that integrates information technology with traditional craftsmanship through a web platform known as SmartTD. SmartTD efficiently extracts and analyzes existing tie-dye patterns to generate new and creative tie-dye artworks. This tie-dye pattern generation not only significantly expands users’ creative options but also infuses new vitality into traditional handicrafts. In addition, SmartTD retraces the historical background of tie-dye and its unique development trajectories in different regions of China, providing abundant technical documentation and details. Users can simulate the actual tie-dye process through virtual experiences offered on SmartTD, thereby gaining a more comprehensive understanding of the cultural value of this ancient craft. The integrated application of these methodologies provides a novel practical solution for the digital preservation of traditional handicrafts while simultaneously opening up broader avenues for cultural education and dissemination.

articleTitle: Data-driven wind turbine simulation model and interpretability analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The wind turbine simulation model is the core component of the optimal control of wind farms and farm groups. However, due to the complex and changeable operating environment and working conditions, the current simulation model cannot accurately simulate the operating characteristics of the unit. In this regard, this paper proposes a data-driven wind turbine simulation model modeling method, and uses the SHAP method to perform model interpretive analysis. First, based on the measured data, a data-driven method was applied to establish a wind turbine simulation model that takes environmental factors into account. The accuracy of the model reached 96.4%. Compared with the measured data regression power curve and factory power curve, NRMSE, NMAE and MAE were all reduced by more than 60%. The simulation accuracy of the wind turbine power output is significantly improved. In addition, the interpretability analysis of the model is performed through the SHAP method, which enhances the interpretability of the model. It not only proves the effectiveness of the model, but also provides important theoretical support for accurate simulation and further optimization of wind turbines.

articleTitle: Design of an Industrial Wireless Sensor Network Security Defense Scheme Based on the Uniqueness of Clock Slope
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper proposes a security defense scheme for industrial wireless sensor networks that utilizes the uniqueness and stability of clock slope characteristics to address the security defense challenges faced by industrial wireless sensor networks (IWSNs) under the constraints of low power consumption and low cost. By combining key elements of time synchronization technology, this scheme fully leverages the physical characteristics of the clock slope without the need to introduce additional protocols or algorithm designs, ensuring compatibility with existing time synchronization technology and providing an effective method for node identity recognition in large-scale IWSN environments.

articleTitle: A wireless sensor network routing scheme based on data collected by UAV
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to reduce the overall energy consumption of UAV-assisted wireless sensor networks and extend the network life cycle, this paper proposes a wireless sensor network routing scheme based on data collected by UAV. Firstly, the optimal cluster number expression is determined using an objective function based on the network model, channel model, and energy model of UAV-assisted wireless sensor network. Since the number of cluster heads and the hovering position of UVA are strongly correlated, the optimal cluster heads and hovering positions are obtained through simulation. Then according to the number of clusters the area is divided and after division the cluster head selection is done in each zone according to the location and energy of the nodes, thus reducing the energy consumption of the ground nodes. Finally, according to the selected cluster head position, the artificial rabbit algorithm is used to plan the flight trajectory of UAV to reduce the energy consumption of UAV.Simulation results show that the proposed scheme is better than the SHM-FCM scheme.

articleTitle: Study on the Analysis and Suppression Methods of Inrush Current in Power Capacitor Switching
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The inrush current and over voltage of shunt reactive compensation capacitor bank are generated when the capacitor is switched on, and the inrush current mainly occurs in the process of capacitor closing. The value of inrush current at closing affects the service life of breaker contacts and endangers the safety of power equipment and the stability of power system. Based on ATP/EMTP electromagnetic simulation software, a three-phase equivalent simulation circuit model of 10kV capacitor circuit with series reactor and synchronous closing switch is built, and the problems of capacitor insurge current and over voltage under synchronous closing strategy are analyzed. The simulation analysis of several factors, such as the connection mode of shunt capacitor bank and the reactance rate of series reactor, is carried out to obtain the transient process of inrush current after closing under different conditions. After the analysis and comparison of the simulation results, the inrush current suppression measures based on the research results in this paper are proposed.

articleTitle: A Low-Noise Dual-Photodiode Receiver for Optical Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper presents a low-noise dual-photodiode (PD) optical receiver to support gigabit-per-second optical wireless communication (OWC). To improve the photodetection area and sensitivity, a dual-PD fully-differential receiver architecture is employed. In the receiver, a shunt-feedback transimpedance amplifier (SF-TIA) with active feedback is proposed to achieve low noise while maintaining high bandwidth. In addition, an inverter-based limiting amplifier (LA) is employed to increase signal swing. To drive 50 Ω loading, a two-stage output driver (OD) with negative capacitance compensation is designed. The whole receiver is implemented with a 180 nm standard CMOS process. Simulation results indicate that the proposed TIA achieves a transimpedance gain of 86.4 άΒΩ, a −3 dB bandwidth of 1.28 GHz, and an input-referred noise (IRN) of 0.24 μA<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rms</inf>, while the receiver supports data rates beyond 2 Gb/s with an IRN of 0.22 μΑ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rms</inf>.

articleTitle: Video Matting Tamper Detection Based on Compressed Tracking
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the digital era, the authenticity of video content has become a significant concern, especially given the rapid advancements in video technology and the increasing potential for tampering. This poses risks to information reliability and impacts areas like legal proceedings, media integrity, and personal privacy. This paper introduces a novel video matting tamper detection method that employs compressed tracking to ascertain the authenticity of video subjects. The method involves several precise steps: initially, edge detection highlights potential tampering by outlining object boundaries. Feature analysis then examines elements like color and texture for anomalies, and target tracking monitors object movements over time to identify inconsistencies. A final comparison of these results with known authentic characteristics helps pinpoint tampering signs. Extensive testing has proven the method’s effectiveness in detecting various tampering types accurately, offering a reliable tool for verifying video authenticity and contributing valuable insights to the field of information security.

articleTitle: Research on the Product Design Process of Lighting Systems Based on the N-F-R-P Model of Systems Engineering
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: An important design method used in the product design process of lighting systems is the N-F-R-P process model based on systems engineering. This model employs a positive design implementation mechanism composed of four interrelated activities: stakeholder needs capture, function analysis, requirement analysis, and design physics. It aims to start from "stakeholder needs capture" to gather the needs and expectations of stakeholders; then, through "function analysis" and "requirement analysis", it transforms the abstract needs of stakeholders into the functional structure of the product and technically feasible requirements; finally, in the "design physics" process, it maps the functional domain to the physical domain, and allocates requirements to the physical structure, and derives the optimal solution through trade-off analysis of the physical structure.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Prediction Method of Underwater Acoustic Field Based on Parabolic Equation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the field of hydroacoustic field prediction, numerical simulation methods and machine learning techniques are two commonly used methods. However, numerical simulation methods need to be meshed and are computationally intensive in the case of complex models; machine learning methods are difficult to analyze the physical significance of the model. Aiming at the above problems, combined with the parabolic equation theory, this paper explores the feasibility of two new neural network models for physical processes for acoustic field prediction. Using the physical information neural network (PINN) and Fourier neural operator (FNO), the coordinates of each point of the hydroacoustic field and the corresponding sound pressure are taken as inputs, and the predicted value of the sound pressure at the requested location is output. The RAMv1.5 model is utilized to generate sample data, and the training and testing are carried out using data from different sound sources, and the simulation results conclude that both models are effective in predicting the distribution of the underwater sound field.

articleTitle: Dynamic Environmental Target Detection and Ranging Based on Improved Yolov5s
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to improve the detection effect of vehicles in dynamic environment and further obtain accurate distance information, this paper proposes an improved target vehicle detection algorithm with YOLOv5s and ranging of the vehicle in front with binocular depth camera. Based on the YOLOv5s detection network, firstly, the CA attention module is introduced into the Backbone network to effectively extract the contour features of the detection target, secondly, the PANet network in Neck is replaced with BiFPN to improve the fusion ability of the features, and then the Head detection layer is replaced with the decoupled head method to accelerate the convergence speed of the network, and then the loss function is optimized using the SIoU to enhance the accuracy of the vehicle detection accuracy. The improved YOLOv5s network model is used to constrain the feature matching points to obtain the optimal parallax value, and finally the distance information of the front vehicle is obtained through the principle of binocular vision ranging. Tests show that the vehicle recognition rate accuracy is 79.50% with an improvement of 1.50% and the average error rate of ranging is 2.552% in a distance range of 14m.

articleTitle: Realization of hand-eye calibration in hole pin alignment system
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the hole and pin alignment system, it is necessary to align the pin hole with the cylinder filling hole to complete the filling work of the pin. In this experiment, a camera is placed above the pin hole to shoot the opposite side of the loading hole, and the pose relationship between the loading hole and the camera can be solved. In order to finally get the pose relationship between the filling hole and the lower pin hole, the pose relationship between the camera and the pin hole needs to be obtained. The eye-hand calibration method based on the robotic arm is commonly used to calibrate the pose relationship between the two, but the hand-eye calibration method cannot be completed by the robotic arm in this experimental environment. Therefore, this paper proposed a monocular vision system hand-eye calibration method to replace the traditional method. In this method, the calibration process is divided into two steps: calibration plate pose calibration and hand-eye relationship calibration, and the hand-eye calibration relationship can be calculated by controlling several translation and rotation movements between the base camera and the calibration plate.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Fault Diagnosis Method and Model for Power Acquisition Equipment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: As the application of power consumption information collection system continues to deepen, the business scope continues to expand, and the functional applications continue to increase, the number of metering and collection equipment accessed by State Grid Corporation's power consumption information collection system is increasing in scale, the operating environment is complex, and the types of faults are varied, which leads to more and more pressure on troubleshooting work. As the requirements of grid operation on the stability and reliability of metering and collection equipment continue to improve, the frequency of data collection and data quality requirements have been further strengthened. The existing abnormality monitoring and diagnostic model can no longer meet the data analysis application requirements of metering device condition detection, collection system efficient operation and maintenance, and equipment quality evaluation. This paper is based on the main station of the power consumption information collection system collection data and anomaly diagnosis function, through further collection of collection anomaly impact factor, combined with remote fault intelligent diagnosis and manual diagnosis, comprehensive collection fault intelligent diagnosis methodology modeling research, to achieve the collection of anomalies intelligent perception, collection fault precision research and judgment, qualitative analysis of equipment faults and early warning and other expected goals, to provide guidance for the first-line staff on-site operation and maintenance, to achieve Reduce the difficulty of operation and maintenance, and improve the quality

articleTitle: Offline High-speed Continuous Digital Speech Recognition System based on WFST
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In this paper, aiming at the scenario of soldiers' fast continuous digital speaking in the field of military communication, the acoustic model and language model for fast continuous digital speech recognition are constructed based on the framework of weighted finite state machine decoder design system, which is the mainstream in the field of speech recognition at present. Then, more than 2000 hours of corpus are collected by special collector. Finally, kaldi open source development tool is used to design and implement an off-line high-speed continuous digital speech recognition system with word accuracy of more than 98%.

articleTitle: Accurate Fault Location in Active Distribution Network Based on Continuous Wavelet Transform and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Some existing traditional traveling wave distribution network fault location methods are overly dependent on the local wave head information of time domain or frequency domain signals, and the access of distributed power sources will affect the fault traveling wave. This paper describes the difficulty of extracting single-phase grounding fault features in distribution networks, analyzes the problem of low accuracy of existing fault location methods, and proposes a method for accurately locating fault points based on continuous wavelet transform and LSTM. This method obtains the fault voltage of each feeder, first decouples the fault voltage waveform, obtains the line mode component, and then uses continuous wavelet transform to obtain the corresponding CWT coefficient matrix, and then generates an RGB image from the coefficient matrix, uses the LSTM layer to extract the corresponding relationship between the time-frequency features of the mapped RGB image and the fault distance, and finally outputs the fault distance through the SoftMax layer mapping.

articleTitle: Research on Coopertive Scheduling of Vehicle Detection Equipment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to improve the measurement capability of space targets, this paper conducts research on the task planning problem of a certain type of space target measurement equipment. Based on the measurement task process and equipment working characteristics, the collaborative scheduling problem of multiple types of space target measurement equipment was modeled, and multi-objective genetic algorithm was used to solve it, thus obtaining the optimal measurement scheme. The paper was finally validated through simulation examples, and the relevant research results have certain reference value for certain types of space target measurement equipment to better complete measurement tasks.

articleTitle: Large-scale fault recovery method of power communication network under typhoon disaster
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The scale and structure of the power communication network are becoming larger and more complex, and large-scale natural disasters such as typhoons pose a serious threat to the modern power communication network, so it is particularly important to quickly restore the normal communication of each substation after the failure. In this paper, the wind field model model is carried out to model the typhoon, and the failure probability of the communication link is calculated according to the maximum wind speed radius of the typhoon and the distance of the communication link from the center of the typhoon. Secondly, with the goal of minimizing recovery resources, a mathematical model of rapid recovery algorithm is established. Thirdly, an approximation algorithm based on the cost-effectiveness of fault links is proposed to solve the mathematical model. Finally, combined with the specific network topology, the recovery resource consumption of different fault recovery methods under the same fault scale is analyzed, and the experimental results show that the proposed method consumes less recovery resources than other methods when recovering the same number of faults.

articleTitle: Study on Cyber-Physical power System fault recovery under collaborative information
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to recover fault services quickly and effectively, a collaborative recovery model of power communication network after fault is first established in this paper. Based on the two-layer programming method, the objective functions of the upper and lower models are designed to select the optimal link recovery scheme. Then the model is solved based on the Q algorithm of reinforcement learning, and the optimal link recovery strategy is obtained under the condition of limited resources, so as to achieve the goal of quickly recovering the most power services. The simulation of the information physical network based on IEEE39-node 10-machine New England system shows that in fault recovery, all power faults can be recovered at a faster speed, and the overall load recovery level is higher than that without considering the synergistic information.

articleTitle: Advances in Full-Link Stress Testing Technology for Cloud-Native Information System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Amidst the ongoing digital transformation, enterprises are progressively adopting microservice architectures to achieve greater flexibility and resilience. Nevertheless, this shift introduces considerable complexity to system testing. This paper presents a comprehensive review of full-link stress testing, a methodology designed to evaluate system performance boundaries within production environments, utilizing production-grade business data and realistic traffic simulations. We begin by discussing the major limitations of traditional stress testing methods, particularly regarding environmental discrepancies, cost efficiency, and risk management. Following this, we examine a typical implementation framework for full-link stress testing, detailing phases from initial planning and monitoring to post-test analysis, ensuring rigorous and accurate evaluation. Key technical challenges, such as test environment adaptation, automated link management, and data preprocessing, are analyzed, with tailored solutions summarized for each. Finally, we explore the growing role of full-link stress testing in enhancing enterprise performance optimization and business continuity, underscoring its significance in supporting scalable and resilient architectures amid digital transformation.

articleTitle: Application of Gap Technology in the Secure Cross-Network Transmission of Civil Aviation Meteorological Data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: To improve the efficiency and security of data flow, the Civil Aviation Meteorological Center employs Gap technology to ensure the secure cross-network transmission of critical operational data. This paper provides a detailed exploration of the basic principles and architectural design of Gap technology, along with its application in cross-network transmission of civil aviation meteorological data with varying security levels. Practical solutions with reference value are proposed, offering theoretical support for enhancing the overall security of the civil aviation meteorological information system.

articleTitle: Research on coordinated trading of electric carbon under charge and storage in source network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Under the background of dual-carbon, the coordination of carbon market is an essential part of achieving high-quality development of power system. First, the trading mechanism of power market and carbon market is analyzed. According to the classification of trading subjects, how each entity of source network, charge and storage participates in the coordination of electric carbon is discussed respectively. Then, the multi-objective optimization model of the source network's charge and storage participating in the coordinated trading of electric carbon is established with the two objectives of the minimum annual electricity cost and the minimum carbon emission. Finally, according to the actual situation, reasonable values are set for thermal power units, centralized photovoltaic and energy storage, and simulation calculations are carried out.

articleTitle: Research on the Evaluation Method of Reference free Clarity for Aerospace Optical Images
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aerospace optical systems play a crucial role in key fields such as Earth observation and deep space exploration. As a key indicator for measuring the performance of aerospace optical systems, image quality directly affects the success rate of measurement and control tasks and the availability of data. This article aims to compare and analyze different methods for evaluating the clarity of non reference images, mainly including five function methods based on gradient information, two transformation methods based on frequency domain, and a method based on information entropy. Then, the algorithms are simulated and compared using real optical sequence images of the International Space Station. Through the analysis of the evaluation values and curves, it is concluded that: 1) The EOG function, Tenengrad function, and Brenner function based on gradients are basically consistent with human perception, and the clarity evaluation effect is good; 2) The evaluation value data obtained from the Variance variance function, Laplace function, and frequency domain based method are relatively similar and cannot accurately evaluate the clarity of the image; 3) The evaluation method based on information entropy is not suitable for the clarity evaluation of such images.

articleTitle: Research on TOC Sensor Based on Lock-in Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Total organic carbon (TOC) is the crucial metric for representing the total organic matter content in water, and its detection provides a comprehensive assessment of organic pollution levels in aquatic bodies. The TOC sensor designed in this paper leverages Beer-Lambert Law and Lock-in amplifier (LIA) technology, utilizing 254nm ultraviolet optical as the detection source and green light as compensation to eliminate the impact of turbidity, extracting the ultraviolet signal to achieving accurate TOC concentration measurements. Additionally, thermoelectric cooler (TEC) temperature control addresses temperature drift caused by heat accumulation during prolonged operation in enclosed environments. The test results show that the absolute error is less than 2%FS, and the linearity is 0.1%, which meet the technical requirements for TOC online monitoring in complex environments

articleTitle: Analysis of the Influence of UHV AC Access on Power Transmission and Receiving Capability of Provincial Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the increasing scale of UHV DC infeed and the large-scale development of renewable energy in the province, the AC-DC hybrid characteristics of the power grid are more complex. After the ultra-high voltage DC bipolar blocking and transferred to the inter-regional connecting line, the power shortage is reduced, and the coupling characteristics between the 500kV regional interconnection line are weakened. The maximum inter-regional power flow and the receiving power of the ultra-high voltage DC are increased after the ultra-high voltage AC network is built. The existing problems of the actual provincial power grid are analyzed. Then, based on the UHV AC drop point, the power flow change of the main 500kV transmission line in the provincial power grid is analyzed under the access system scheme and different operation modes. Finally, from the aspect of improving the overall external power-receiving capability of the power grid, the improvement level of the power-receiving capability of the provincial power grid after UHV AC operation under different schemes is compared and analyzed.

articleTitle: Monitoring of Adverse Working Conditions in Distribution Station Area based on RPA
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The traditional monitoring and fault diagnosis methods for poor working conditions in distribution stations often rely on manual labor, and their efficiency and accuracy are affected by personnel status, making it difficult to achieve rapid and accurate analysis. At present, the application of automation technology in the field of power has become one of the important means to improve efficiency, reduce costs, and provide reliable power supply. RPA (robotic process automation) technology has the ability to solve complex, time-consuming, and laborious repetitive tasks, forming a systematic monitoring and prediction system, helping grassroots personnel reduce their burden and improve work efficiency. To improve the quality of power supply services, it is particularly important to address poor working conditions in the distribution station area. Through real-time monitoring of low voltage, heavy overload distribution transformers, and other situations, a warning mechanism is formed to improve the rectification cycle of abnormal distribution transformers and ensure the quality of power supply in the distribution station area. Through RPA technology, automatic collection of equipment data can be achieved through regular inspection and maintenance tasks, and alerts can be triggered in a timely manner to remind key maintenance when problems are detected. Meanwhile, the application of RPA technology has also increased the frequency of power equipment status monitoring. This article aims to explore in depth the application of RPA robots in monitoring poor working conditions in the distribution station area.

articleTitle: Study on the Impact of IPSec on Rate Limiting Strategies in Satellite Communications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: When ocean-going cargo ships sail for cargo transport, due to the limited bandwidth of satellite communications, it is impossible to meet all services' bandwidth demands without limit. Therefore, it is necessary to configure priority and throttling strategies for different services based on their priority levels, ensuring that when the sum of the rates of all services exceeds the total bandwidth, high-priority services can be allocated appropriate bandwidth, thereby guaranteeing the normal communication of critical business systems. Ocean-going cargo ships use IPSec on routers to encrypt and decrypt business traffic and employ QoS technology to set throttling and priority levels for various services. This paper studies the changes and impacts of general throttling strategies after passing through routers, thus providing reference for reasonably setting throttling strategies to ensure the normal operation of services.

articleTitle: Optimizing Roll Motion Forecasting for Unmanned Surface Vessels Using PSO-Enhanced LSTM Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Unmanned surface vessels (USVs) navigating at sea experience severe roll motion due to waves, which can compromise their operational safety and efficiency. Accurate short-term prediction of roll motion is critical for decision-making in USV operations. The Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) neural network model, with its capability to handle nonlinear problems, offers a potential solution for predicting the nonlinear roll motion of USVs. For the task of USV roll motion forecasting, determining the appropriate dimensionality of the input vector and the number of hidden layer neurons are points that need to be considered, especially when dealing with varying prediction horizons. Typically, these parameters are selected by exhaustively searching within a predefined range based on empirical experience. This approach, however, is computationally expensive and lacks adaptability in finding the optimal input vector dimensionality and number of hidden neurons. To address this issue, this paper introduces the Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm to optimize both the input vector dimensionality and the number of hidden layer neurons. The results show that using PSO to optimize the LSTM model parameters for predicting USV roll motion is effective, providing a certain degree of model optimization and improving prediction performance. Moreover, the PSO-LSTM prediction model demonstrates generalization ability, making it not only suitable for roll motion prediction at specific forecast steps but also adaptable to different prediction horizons.

articleTitle: SFPL: Improving CRS via Prompt Learning based Semantic Fusion Module
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the popularity of the Internet and the massive increase of content production, users are faced with massive information and content, and it is often difficult to accurately and efficiently find the content that meets their needs. This information overload motivates the emergence of recommendation systems that help users filter and recommend relevant content. Dialogue recommendation systems (CRS) aim to dynamically recommend high-quality items to users while eliciting user preferences by means of dialogue. CRS mainly consists of two parts, namely, the dialogue module and the recommendation module. An efficient CRS is to solve the problems existing in the two sub-tasks of dialogue and recommendation, namely, generating appropriate responses in dialogue and predicting user favorite items in recommendation. In addition, it is necessary to adopt a suitable method to integrate these two modules to ensure the accuracy of CRS recommendation. This paper proposes an efficient way of semantic fusion module to solve the integration problem of two modules, and proves the effectiveness of our method through experiments

articleTitle: Research on rail surface defect detection algorithm based on improved YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low detection accuracy and high error detection rate of small target defects under complex background, a rail surface defect detection algorithm based on YOLOv8 was proposed. First, the model's focus on small and medium targets is enhanced by replacing the original convolution with SPD-Conv building blocks in YOLOv8's backbone network, while preserving the original network structure. Secondly, the integration of the EMA attention mechanism module into the neck component enables the model to utilize information from different layer features and improve feature representation capabilities. The mAP@0.5 of this model can reach 97.4%, 4.2% higher than that of YOLOv8. In addition, the frame rate, parameter number, computation and model volume of model detection are better than most mainstream target detection algorithms. The experimental results show that this model can effectively improve the accuracy of rail defect detection.

articleTitle: Research on inland waterway navigation congestion analysis technology based on Beidou
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper proposes a Beidou-based inland navigation congestion status analysis method, which includes obtaining the number of ships in the waterway and the location information of each ship through the Beidou navigation system; calculating the congestion density of the waterway according to the number of ships and the location information; obtaining the ship flow and average speed of the ship in the waterway, and training the waterway state model of the waterway where the ship is located in combination with the congestion density; setting the waterway state threshold, comparing the waterway state model generation result with the state threshold, and determining the navigation state. The present invention can judge in real time whether the waterway is in a congested state and conduct effective regulation. This method can support the development of technologies such as intelligent ship lock passing and intelligent scheduling.

articleTitle: Design of Precise Alignment and Orthogonal Magnetic Coupler with for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Wireless Charging
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The challenge of flight duration limitation of Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV) restricts their utility in long-distance power line inspections. Therefore, this paper proposes an efficient UAV charging system utilizing wireless charging technology. The relay wireless charging stations are strategically positioned along the inspection route to ensure continuous energy supply for autonomous long-range power line surveillance. Taking into account the unique structure and payload constraints of UAVs, this paper designs an orthogonal magnetic coupler which consists of Aruco markers for first step landing and limiting guide grooves for second step landing and precise Alignment. Compared to existing couplers, the proposed orthogonal magnetic coupler has a low Magnetic through UAV, high adaptability and higher degree of lateral misalignment.

articleTitle: Continuous Pre-training of TAPAS Model with E-commerce Structured Data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Currently, large models perform extremely well in natural language processing (NLP). Pre-trained large-scale language models (such as GPT-4, BERT, T5, etc.) have achieved significant performance improvements in a variety of NLP tasks. However, applying these models to specific domains still faces significant challenges, such as lack of domain-specific knowledge and insufficient adaptation to domain-specific structured data. In this article, we take the e-commerce field as an example, clean and convert various collected e-commerce structured data into specific formats, and conduct continuous pre-training of the TAPAS model. During the pre-training process, parameters are gradually adjusted through backpropagation to minimize the loss function to improve the accuracy of the model. By comparing various indicators with other models. Experimental results show that the TAPAS model after continuous pre-training shows better performance in processing structured data tasks in the e-commerce field, significantly improving its accuracy in tasks such as question answering and information extraction in this field.

articleTitle: Deep Reinforcement Learning Based Approach for Balanced Data Deduplication in Mobile Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Mobile edge computing (MEC) migrates computing, storage, and network resources to the network edge, providing users with low-latency data access. As a crucial part of MEC, edge storage systems (ESS) offer storage capabilities near data sources or users. However, the limited server storage resources present challenges for ESS in optimizing storage utilization efficiency. This paper investigates a balanced data deduplication problem in ESS involving multiple collaborative servers and different tasks while comprehensively considering deduplication rate, storage balance, and data storage efficiency. To maximize overall system performance and overcome the limitations of traditional methods that rely on static rules, we formulate the problem as a Markov decision process (MDP) and propose a deep deterministic policy gradient (DDPG)-based approach to find the optimal deduplication solution. We employ a dual-network structure combined with a learning rate scheduler and implement prioritized experience replay to enhance training stability. Simulation results demonstrate that our approach outperforms the baselines across various parameter settings.

articleTitle: HiCASCADE: Hierarchical Multi-scale Transformer with CASCADE for Medical Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Various hierarchical CNN networks have proven their effectiveness in the field of medical image segmentation, however, due to the inherent shortcomings of CNNs, it is difficult for a single CNN network to fully utilize the long-range dependent information. Transformer has excellent ability to capture long-range features, which can make up for the shortcomings of CNN in this respect. However, previous work ignored the intrinsic structure unique to the medical image segmentation task, and could not adequately capture the local and long-range feature information of medical images, and there are limitations in the use of fusion of multi-scale features and it can't identify organ border areas very well. In this paper, we propose a new hierarchical network architecture, HiCASCADE, which combines the advantages of CNN and Trasformer to extract multi-stage features and enhance them by cascading attention modules. Specifically, we use hybrid CNN-Transformer modules to extract multiscale features, enhance the feature representation by efficiently fusing features at different scales using attention gate (AG), and then enhance the fused long-range and local contextual features in both the channel and spatial dimensions by a convolutional attention module (CAM) and suppress irrelevant background information. We train the model on the synapse multi-organ segmentation dataset and achieve an excellent score of dice 81.2, which outperforms medical image segmentation models such as Attention UNet, TransUnet, SwinUnet, and PVT-CASCADE.

Author Keywords: multi scale feature extract and fusion

articleTitle: Time Series hybrid Prediction Model Based on Deep Learning ARIMA-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This study investigates a prediction model for time series data based upon deep learning techniques, addressing the challenges of efficient processing and precise prediction of time series data in practical applications. It presents a hybrid deep learning model that integrates the Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average Model (ARIMA) with the Long Short-Term Memory Model (LSTM) to enhance the predictive capability for time series data. Through comprehensive experiments, this study evaluates the effectiveness of the proposed ARIMA-LSTM hybrid model for time series prediction. The results demonstrate that, compared to traditional forecasting methods, this deep learning hybrid model effectively addresses the limitations of Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) in processing long sequences. Furthermore, it enhances the ability to capture long-term dependencies in time series data, thereby significantly improving prediction accuracy. The results presented in this study offers novel insights and methodologies for accurate time series prediction, contributing significantly to the practical application of deep learning technologies.

articleTitle: Exploring The Consistency of Positive and Negative Images In Classification Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: After converting the original sample pictures (positive pictures) to negative images, the retained objects' critical category information can be classified by humans. Still, the general neural network models are weak in recognizing negative images. In artificial intelligence, researchers are more interested in the performance of the models on the original images, and there is little research on negative image samples. To explore the effect of negative image features on model learning, using the visualization of feature maps and comparison of recognition ability in different scenes, three models trained by positive samples set, negative samples set, and mixed samples set are investigated for three image datasets: MNIST, CIFAR10, and ImageNet. The positive and negative samples were found to be consistent in the feature space of the model, enabling the network to fit both positive and negative images. From the accuracy point of view, the addition of negative samples adjusts the deep feature space of the network, resulting in uniform confidence output of positive and negative images for each class and a more compact distribution of samples within categories. From the perspective of adversarial robustness, models that learn positive and negative picture features also show symmetry in adversarial perturbations; moreover, models trained with negative samples can resist transfer attacks of general models to a certain extent.

articleTitle: A Review of Data Leakage Tracing Models Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper discusses in detail the data leakage tracing model based on big data, covering its technical support, application status, future research directions and policy recommendations. The technical support system section analyzes big data technology, deep learning and data tracing technology, and explains how to use these technologies to achieve real-time monitoring of data flows and rapid identification of abnormal behaviors. In the application direction analysis, the article evaluates the application of the model in different industries, points out the successful cases and challenges of existing implementations. In the future research direction section, the need for further development of reinforcement learning algorithms, cross-platform data management, and privacy protection technologies is proposed, aiming to respond to the increasingly complex threats of data leakage through technological innovation. Finally, the paper puts forward specific policy recommendations, emphasizing the importance of formulating flexible and forward-looking data protection policies.

articleTitle: Based On AHP-Entropy Weight Method Used In Pesticide Chemical Enterprise Safety Risk Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Safety is crucial for pesticide chemical enterprises. This article will combine the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) and Entropy Weight Method (EWM) to analyze the six factors of personnel risk, machine risk, material risk, method risk, environmental risk, and management risk. Based on the characteristics of pesticide chemical safety, and combined with the improved AHP and EWM, a qualitative analysis and safety risk analysis will be conducted on the quantitative treatment of production safety factors in pesticide chemical enterprises. The purpose is to improve the safety level of the construction site during the production process of pesticide chemical enterprises, ensuring the safety and efficiency of the construction process. It is of great significance to ensure the safety production of pesticide chemical enterprises.

articleTitle: Stepping into socialization from a single entity: Research on the socialized cooperative working system of "digital living entity" of electric power transportation and inspection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the optimization and adjustment of energy structure and the deepening of the reform of the power system, the intelligent upgrade of the transportation and inspection work has also been given a new historical mission. Based on the domestic substation digital platform, the research and application of the intelligent operation and maintenance management platform for Saudi substations expands the application scope and the application scenarios for the intelligent upgrade of transportation and inspection work. In the wave of demand for intelligent upgrade of Electric power transportation and inspection, the digital living entity of Electric power transportation and inspection with cross-regional data perception and autonomous cognitive reasoning ability came into being. This paper explores the social evolution trend of digital living entity, focusing on the problems such as insufficient information fusion, low precision decision efficiency and long iteration upgrade cycle. This paper expounds and researches the social collaborative work system from the aspects of external multi-source information fusion, internal cluster knowledge sharing mechanism, diversified symbiosis development model and the construction of socialization closed-loop system. Based on that, this paper explores the self-driven construction, adaptive adjustment and iterative upgrading mechanism of digital living entity intelligent expert group. Applying the new group decision-making model based on the social collaborative work system, it is committed to improving the efficiency of lean and digital control of power grid equipment.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Wearable Device for Health Monitoring of Power Distribution Network Operators
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The operational status of power distribution network maintenance operator might be influenced by many factors, such as the hazardous working environment and complex electromagnetic environment, as well as the health status, mood, and psychological pressure of maintenance operators themselves. Developing intelligent wearable devices specifically designed for maintenance operators in power distribution network system, monitoring their work status in real-time, ensuring their safety, and providing early warning for abnormal conditions, is of great significance for power distribution network enterprises to practice the "people-oriented" management concept, and provide effective humanistic care for operators. In this paper, an intelligent wearable device is designed for real-time monitoring of the health status of maintenance operators in power distribution network systems. The design fully considers the collection of various parameters that can reflect the health status of maintenance operators, including heart rate, blood oxygen, EEG data, etc., and considers wearing comfort. By integrating the supporting embedded software design and communication module, it can effectively analyze the real-time health status of workers and achieve timely warning of abnormal states.

articleTitle: A Lightweight Object Detection Algorithm for UAV Power Inspection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Deep learning algorithms have shown excellent performance in many fields, leading to their application in tasks such as fault detection, fault recognition, and operational safety monitoring in the power industry. With the advancement of technology, more and more edge embedded devices are deployed in power scenarios to handle data collection and processing. However, these devices typically have limited computing resources and storage capacity. The large number of parameters, computational requirements, and memory usage of most neural network models severely hinder their deployment on edge devices. This article proposes a lightweight drone detection algorithm based on YOLOv8. We (1) introduce a decoder module during the training process to improve detection accuracy through additional supervision information, which can be removed during the model inference process to avoid increasing inference workload; (2) Combining attention mechanisms to help the network focus on key regions and features, thereby improving performance with minimal additional computation. Our lightweight model can be effectively deployed on resource constrained embedded devices, providing robust detection results.

articleTitle: A Method of Multi-dimensional Track Correlation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In aerospace measurement and control missions, the end station of the pulse radar measurement chain usually encounters key node events such as star-arrow separation and rocket attitude adjustment, corresponding to the special situation of reflected signal splitting and reflected signal crossing the response signal during tracking. In this type of special case, the tracking equipment has a high probability of misalignment with the target. Through the specific analysis of the tracking process, a track-related method when the target is separated is proposed, and Matlab is used for simulation to verify the feasibility of the method.

articleTitle: Reputation and Clustering based Fault Tolerant Algorithm for Cognitive Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of swirling clusters in Cognitive Radio Sensor Network (CRSN), which cannot guarantee the data reliability due to the lack of fault tolerance, this paper proposes a fault-tolerant clustering algorithm based on reputation and clustering, which organizes the nodes in the network into multiple clusters or clusters by using k-means clustering method, and reduces the overall communication distance and energy consumption. Reduce the overall communication distance and energy consumption and improve the data transmission efficiency. The algorithm optimizes the energy usage of each node, especially the energy allocation in the cluster centers, aiming to extend the overall life cycle of the network. By dynamically updating the reputation value mechanism to select reliable nodes as clustering centers, the network is able to effectively cope with node failures, energy variations, and environmental disturbances and enhance the network's security and resistance to attacks, resulting in a significant improvement in communication performance.

articleTitle: Based on the distributed lag model, the study of the impact of Urban Residents' household income on consumption-This article takes the example of Henan Province
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper uses the distributed lag model to empirically test the impact of per capita disposable income of urban households on consumption in Henan Province from 1993to2023. In the short term, the change of household income of urban residents has a large positive causing effect on urban residents' consumption expenditure, and the impact is the most significant. In the long run, volatility adjusts accordingly due to substitution effects. However, on the whole, the change of household income of urban residents in Henan Province has a significant impact on residents' consumption. Therefore, in order to fully implement the strategy of expanding domestic demand, give full play to the basic role of consumption in economic development, and continuously enhance the lasting power of high-quality development, the article puts forward policy suggestions from three aspects:the government, enterprises and residents themselves.

articleTitle: Radar Location Optimization based on ISAR Imaging
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Inverse synthetic aperture radar (ISAR) can be used for high-resolution imaging of air targets and ship targets on the sea. At present, it has been widely used in military and civil, and plays its great advantages. As an important part of radar imaging technology, the ISAR is applied to the Yangtze River Bridge to monitor the ship targets in the bridge area, which can be used as the key basis for the safe operation of the Yangtze River Bridge. This paper uses FEKO software to model the Yangtze River Bridge and ships, introduces RCS and equivalent source to simulate and analyze the bridge body and piers of the Yangtze River Bridge, explores the influence of radar signal occlusion on the navigation of ships in the bridge area, and obtains the approximate radar blind area near the bridge area. The index suitable for ISAR image evaluation is selected, the index weight is determined by entropy method, and the comprehensive evaluation is obtained by weighted summation to optimize the location of radar station.

articleTitle: Social-Risk Dual-Cost Based Optimal Strategies in Open or Invited Bidding
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper constructs a dynamic game between the tenderee and bidders as well as two static games between two bidders to examine the optimal bidding strategies with consideration of the open and invited biddings, three types of bidders (i.e. integrity, speculation, and abstention), and social-risk dual cost. The results indicate that reducing the risk costs in an open bidding or increasing the risk costs in an invited bidding can raise the probability of the integrity bidders winning the bid. Moreover, whether in an open or invited bidding, the probability of winning the bid at a low price can be increased by decreasing the social and risk costs of bidders as well as increasing the loss of the bidders failing to the bid. This paper contributes a new theoretical perspective for investigating the optimal bidding strategy.

articleTitle: Big Data Feature Mining Method for Energy Storage System of Photovoltaic Power Station in Typical Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The energy storage system can effectively solve the challenges brought by the high proportion of renewable energy access to the power grid. In this paper, a big data feature mining method based on double-layer intelligent optimization algorithm is proposed. Considering the differences in operating conditions of energy storage systems in photovoltaic power stations caused by different seasonal scenarios and different weather scenarios, the improved bird swarm algorithm is proposed to mine the big data features of energy storage systems in photovoltaic power stations under typical weather scenarios. The inherent operation law of the energy storage system in the actual photovoltaic power station is revealed, and the charging and discharging characteristics of the actual energy storage system are reflected.

articleTitle: Research on the Cloud-Based Scalable Geometric Kernel
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: As a fundamental technological component at the foundational layer of industrial software, the geometric kernel assumes a pivotal role in industrial product manufacturing, architectural design, simulation, and various other domains. In response to the trends of intelligence, connectivity, and specialization within geometric kernels, this paper introduces a Cloud-based Scalable Geometric Kernel (CSGK). Drawing upon the analysis of the open-source geometric kernel OpenCASCADE, the primary functional modules, application paradigms, and customizable extension methodologies for data structures and modeling algorithms within the CSGK were examined. Utilizing the creation of geometric models within the railway tunnel engineering industry as an experimental context, and via delving into the algorithm for adjusting moving frames, the Sweep surface modeling approach was enhanced, thereby validating the scalability of the CSGK. The functionality of the CSGK was further substantiated through the development of an application module designed to generate generalized tunnel models for railways.

articleTitle: An Automatic Test Technology Based on Information System Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This study introduces Information System Architecture (ISA) to address interoperability, efficiency, and data sharing challenges in automatic testing systems. It outlines ISA’s integration into automatic testing, covering system construction from demand analysis through to verification, with a focus on a simulator as the Unit Under Test (UUT). The application of ISA demonstrates enhanced test system construction speed, resource management, and operational efficiency. This approach provides a novel solution to prevailing issues in automatic testing, suggesting significant improvements in system interoperability and resource utilization.

articleTitle: Compression of Ultra High Definition Image based on K-means Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Image compression plays a key role in contemporary digital environments given the escalating influx of visual data on the Internet. In this study, the K-means clustering algorithm is adopted for Ultra High Definition (UHD) image compression. The procedures are introduced in detail, and a numerical example is provided to demonstrate the applicability of the proposed approach. The results indicate that with an appropriately assigned K value, that is, the number of clusters, the K-means can strike a good balance between the visual quality loss and file size reduction, achieving a compression ratio of 60.37. This study not only proposes an approach for UHD image compression, but also exhibits the promising potential of clustering algorithms in the field of image processing.

articleTitle: Sequential Path Planning of Multi Food Delivery Robot to Avoid Collision
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The path planning for multiple food delivery robots aims to design collision-free paths, ensuring that each delivery robot can reach its target point without colliding with others. In a dynamic environment where delivery robots with different speeds move simultaneously, the risk of collisions significantly increases. This paper presents a new path planning method for a group of delivery robots moving at different speeds. By predefining the priorities between robots, the method allows different delivery robots to make optimal choices when faced with path conflicts, determining whether to continue with their tasks. This enables distributed path planning while minimizing time costs and avoiding collisions. The proposed method is compared with the existing Ant Colony-Particle Swarm Optimization (ACO-PSO) algorithm, and software simulations validate its performance advantages across various practical scenarios.

articleTitle: Image Dehazing Method Based on Dark Channel Prior and Histogram Equalization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to improve the dehazing effect of images, an improved dehazing method based on dark channel prior and histogram equalization combining with the wavelet fusion is proposed in this paper. The dehazing images are obtained utilizing the dark channel image dehazing algorithm and histogram equalization algorithm from the original images. The dehazing images are decomposed into low-frequency and high-frequency coefficients using a four layer wavelet transform, and different fusion criterion are used to fuse the low-frequency and high-frequency coefficients to obtain the final dehazing images. The experimental simulation shows that the proposed method can obtain high-quality dehazing images.

articleTitle: YOLOv8-WBE: A Fabric Defect Detection Algorithm Integrating Frequency Domain Features
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Due to the small size of fabric defects and the possibility that the detected features may resemble the background characteristics of the fabric, models often struggle to correctly distinguish between the target and the background. To address this issue, we propose a fabric defect detection algorithm integrating frequency domain features—YOLOv8-WBE. First, in the feature extraction stage, a frequency domain downsampling module (WaveDown) is incorporated. By using wavelet transformation to improve the downsampling operation within the deep neural network, this module helps suppress aliasing issues commonly encountered in fabric detection. Second, in the Neck part, a Bidirectional Feature Pyramid Network (BiFPN) structure is adopted to achieve cross-scale spatial fusion, enhancing the model’s ability to learn detailed and multi-scale features of fabric defects. Lastly, an Efficient Multi-scale Attention mechanism (EMA) is introduced for multi-scale feature learning and cross-spatial interaction, further improving the detection accuracy of fabric defects. Experimental results show that the improved model achieves a mAP of 96.3%, a 2.3% increase compared to the original YOLOv8n, meeting the detection requirements of textile enterprises.

articleTitle: Analysis And Preventive Measures of Abnormal Wire Loss Caused By Wrong Measurement Information
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper is based on an instance happened in a 10kV on-grid hydropower station, the file information was not corrected in the marketing business system in time after the staff replaced the CT on site, resulting in the inconsistency of CT transformation ratio and measurement magnification between the site and the system, leading to an abnormal on-grid electricity and 10kV wire loss. This paper analyzes the change regularity of the measurement data before and after replacing the CT, combines the error theory, uses the correction coefficient method and the relative error method, calculates the refunded and replenished electricity respectively, analyzes the abnormal wire loss caused by the inconsistent measurement magnification, and puts forward detailed preventive measures to prevent various risks effectively.

articleTitle: Graph Neural Networks with Category Embedding for Session-based Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Session-based recommendation plays an important role in e-commerce to recommend items of interest for users. However, existing session-based recommendation algorithms only use the item ids in the data without using other information, which makes their recommendations less effective. To solve the problem, this paper proposes a Graph neural networks with category embedding for session-based recommendation. First, the model embedded the item category into the item id to get the item representation. Then the graph neural network is used to learn the transfer relationship between items, and the final representation of the current session is obtained through the attention mechanism, which is used to complete the prediction, solving the above problem. Extensive experimental results on two public datasets, UserBehavior and Tmall, show that the model is better than existing methods.

articleTitle: Research on flocking behavior of multi-perturbation Cucker-Smale model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The Cucker-Smale model is a classic model used in the research of multi-agents flocking behavior. In practical applications, the multi-agents system is often affected by multi-perturbation. Considering the above situation, a multi-perturbation Cucker-Smale model is proposed. By constructing and analyzing the Lyapunov function of the model, the initial conditions and the constraints of the position and velocity perturbations in the multi-perturbation Cucker-Smale model are obtained, which enable multi-agents to form asymptotic flocking and collision avoidance. Finally, two numerical examples of the same and different position and velocity perturbations were studied. The results indicate that multi-agents in the multi-perturbation Cucker-Smale model can form asymptotic flocking and collision avoidance under identical position and velocity perturbations. Different position and velocity perturbations will affect the time when the velocity tends to be consistent in multi-agents flocking. However, the multi-agents can still form asymptotic flocking and collision avoidance when the constraints of position and velocity perturbations are satisfied. This further validates the effectiveness of the obtained conclusions.

articleTitle: Smart Clothing for Elderly Patients with Dementia
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at the current increase in the number of demented elderly people, which brings about the problem of increased pressure on medical care, this paper designs a smart nursing garment with fecal incontinence detection for demented elderly patients. The intelligent garment is functionally divided into control module, temperature and humidity detection module, wireless communication monitor and power module, etc., and the APP detection function is realized on the cell phone terminal. At the same time, this paper enhances the comfort and ease of wearing and taking off of the smart clothing, as well as the acceptance of dementia elderly patients through the style design, structure design and color design of the clothing, and the virtual effect of the smart clothing is demonstrated. Through the smart clothing function test, when the dementia elderly patients are incontinent, the cell phone APP has temperature and humidity display, prompting the caregiver to change clothes in time to realize the intelligent nursing function.

articleTitle: Research on Performance Improvement of 3D Gaussian Splatting Model Driven by Optimizing Point Cloud Data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The use of scenes captured from multiple photos or videos for 3D reconstruction is a hot topic in the fields of image and vision. At present, 3D Gaussian Splatting(3D-GS) [1] represents scenes as explicit 3D Gaussian ellipsoids with specific properties for 3D reconstruction, and the reconstruction results demonstrate advanced visual quality and real-time rendering effects in the industry. 3D-GS uses the sparse point cloud generated by SfM as input, and through adaptive density control, densifies the sparse point cloud into a million level Gaussian ellipsoid to achieve scene reconstruction. However, during this process, the point cloud data derived from 3D-GS was not fully utilized. This article proposes an optimized point cloud data derived from 3D-GS to improve the rendering quality of 3D-GS. Firstly, the point cloud generated by SfM is input into 3D-GS for reconstruction. During the reconstruction process, the color of the ellipsoid center point is extracted from the spherical harmonic feature coefficients of the Gaussian ellipsoid. Then, the color attributes and the coordinates of the Gaussian ellipsoid center position are stored as new point cloud data. The radius filtering method is used to denoise the obtained point cloud data. Finally, the denoised point cloud set is re inputted into 3D-GS as new data for reconstruction, resulting in an optimized rendering effect. The experiment was compared with the original 3D-GS method on three publicly available datasets. Compared with the original 3D-GS method, SSIM increased by 0.013, PSNR increased by 0.379, and LPIPS decreased by 0.037; At the same time, qualitative comparisons were made in the rendered scenes, and the comparison results proved that the proposed method improved the rendering quality of 3D-GS. The method proposed in this article is to optimize the point cloud data derived from 3D-GS and re input it into 3D-GS for reconstruction, in order to obtain higher quality rendering results. Good results can be achieved on all three publicly available datasets. Optimize the point cloud data derived from 3D-GS to achieve iterative optimization of 3D-GS rendering quality.

articleTitle: A Centralized MIMO Radar Signals Under-determined Separation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The source signal separation problem of the centralized multi-input multi-output (MIMO) radar is studied in this paper and an under-determined blind source separation algorithm with more source signals than mixed signals is proposed.
