Firstly, this paper introduces the reconnaissance model of centralized MIMO radar. Secondly, the linear clustering variables are constructed by using the short-time Fourier transform results of different mixed signals. Then, the number of source signals and clustering variables are obtained by the clustering algorithm. Finally, all the source signals are separated by constructing an appropriate model and using the complex independent component analysis algorithm. Both formula derivation and simulation analysis prove that the proposed algorithm can estimate source signals of the centralized MIMO radar well under the condition of under-determination.

articleTitle: Research on Operation Organization Scheme for Urban Rail Transit Based on Virtual Coupling
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Virtual marshalling technology provides convenience for the efficient use of resources and the accurate allocation of passenger and vehicle flow in the urban rail transit line network, which is of great significance for improving the operation of urban rail transit. This paper introduces the principle characteristics of virtual marshalling and the organization mode of urban rail transit based on this technology, compares and analyzes the operation status and efficiency of urban rail transit line network vehicles under the application of virtual marshalling technology and the current traditional operation, and takes a section of Tianjin Metro Line 5 as an example for case analysis. The results show that the virtual marshalling technology can effectively reduce the empty load of the vehicle, greatly improve the transportation efficiency, improve the punctuality and reliability of the train, and make the train operation plan more flexible under the condition of overflight. Under the condition of no crossing, the virtual marshalling technology increases the waiting time of some passengers and slightly reduces the service level, but shortens the travel time of most passengers and reduces the average travel time, which effectively improves the transportation efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on the Prediction of Academic Performance Based on ANN-BiLSTM Hybrid Neural Network Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the popularity of online courses and e-learning, a large amount of data on online learning behaviour has been accumulated. How to use these data to predict early students' performance so as to improve teaching effectiveness and learning experience has become an important issue in educational research. Based on this, this paper constructs a hybrid ANN-BiLSTM neural network model by taking advantage of the feature extraction of Artificial Neural Network (ANN) and the advantages of Bi-directional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) in temporal feature processing. In order to verify the effectiveness of this model, this paper compares it with the Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) model, the Gate Recurrent Unit (GRU), and the ANN-LSTM hybrid neural network (ANN-LSTM) model. Experiments on the UK Open University Learning Analytics dataset showed that the ANN-BiLSTM model had significantly better prediction accuracy and the best predictive performance.

articleTitle: Time–Frequency Analysis of Phase Encoding in Spiking Neural Networks Using Polar Coordinates
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper presents the time–frequency analysis of impulse trains and delayed impulse signal in polar coordinates for neural encoding and signal reconstruction using Spiking Neural Network (SNN). The frequency of the impulse train is encoded by phase in frequency domain polar coordinates. The time delay of impulse signal is encoded by phase in time domain polar coordinates. The SNN architecture is inspired by the Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT). The proposed SNN leverages complex exponential spiking neurons to represent the frequency components of the DFT spectrum. This approach encodes the temporal delay of an impulse through phase increments of the DFT frequency coefficients, allowing for the reconstruction of the original impulse signal using the SNN. The primary research objective is to simplify the SNN architecture and improve the computational efficiency of the SNN training process.

articleTitle: FPGA-based Improved Canny Edge Detection System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to address the issues associated with the classic Canny operator, such as high computational load, incomplete edge information capture, and poor real-time performance, an improved multi-directional Canny edge detection method is proposed for using in service robot navigation systems. This method collects image information through the OV5640 camera, preprocesses the image after grayscale processing combined with mixed multiple filtering, and then performs eight directional adaptive threshold edge detection based on the classical Canny operator. After image enhancement, it runs on the FPGA chip. It can be seen from the experimental results that compared with the classic edge detection algorithm, the improved Canny operator has significantly improved the detection effect and can efficiently process the edges of various complex images in real time, providing a feasible solution for real-time image processing in the FPGA field.

articleTitle: Atmospheric Refraction Error Correction based on Iterative Integral for Low Latitudes
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Due to the layered surface and non-uniform horizontal characteristics of the actual atmosphere, the radar wave propagation in the atmosphere is easy to cause the curvature of the radio wave trajectory and the change of the radio wave propagation speed, which seriously affects the detection and positioning performance of each radio system. Aiming at the meteorological characteristics of low-dimensional areas and the timeliness requirements of correction in practical applications, the calculation formula of atmospheric refractive index was improved for the southern sea area, and a fast correction method of atmospheric refraction error based on iterative integral was proposed. The altitude error was converted to the distance for iterative correction, and then the approximate optimal solution was quickly and accurately found. The feasibility of the proposed method is verified.

articleTitle: Research and Analysis of the Wireless Architecture of Civil Aircraft Emergency Lighting
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the field of civil aviation, the emergency lighting system of aircraft is a key component to ensure the safety of passengers and crew. In the face of an emergency, such as an emergency landing or evacuation, an efficient and reliable emergency lighting system is essential. In view of the limitations of traditional wired emergency lighting systems, such as complex cabling, high maintenance costs and slow response time, this paper explores the potential of wireless technology to enhance the performance of emergency lighting systems. This paper presents an architecture design of emergency lighting based on wireless communication technology, which aims to improve the flexibility of the system flexibility, reduced maintenance costs, and faster response times. This paper further analyzes the wireless communication technology suitable for emergency lighting, and compares the advantages of different technologies. Through the integration of wireless sensor networks, a new type of wireless emergency lighting system architecture is designed.

articleTitle: Research on Mechanical Polishing System Based on Visual Recognition Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This article aims to explore the design and implementation of a mechanical polishing system based on visual recognition technology. With the rapid development of industrial automation and intelligent manufacturing, the application of robot technology in the field of mechanical polishing is becoming increasingly widespread. This article proposes a polishing system that combines computer vision and robotics technology, which can achieve efficient and precise polishing of workpieces, improve production efficiency and product quality. Through visual recognition technology, the system can automatically detect the position, shape, and surface defects of the workpiece, and adjust the polishing path and parameters accordingly, achieving intelligent polishing.

articleTitle: Remote Sensing Assessment of Combustible Load in Mountainous Power Transmission Corridors: A Beijing Case Study
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This study proposes a quantitative estimation and risk assessment method for combustible material loads in Beijing’s power transmission corridors using remote sensing data and machine learning techniques. Ground plot surveys provided biomass data, including tree species, diameter at breast height, tree height, understory biomass, and total plot biomass. These data were combined with remote sensing, meteorological data, and digital elevation models (DEM) to train and validate a random forest model for estimating the spatial distribution of biomass and generating combustible material load maps across Beijing. Reclassification and kernel density analysis were then used to systematically assess fire risk. Results. The results show that there are significant spatial distribution differences in the combustible material load in Changping District and Mentougou District of Beijing, showing a gradient change trend from low to high. High-load areas are concentrated in the mountainous and hilly areas of the north and west, while low-load areas are mainly distributed in the central and plain areas. This spatial analysis and risk assessment offer valuable tools for power grid operators to manage vegetation growth and combustible material accumulation, enhancing grid safety and reliability.

articleTitle: Study on Plant Leaf Recognition Method Based on Multi-feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that a single feature cannot accurately describe plant leaves, a plant leaf recognition method based on multi-feature fusion is proposed in this paper. In view of the local binary pattern feature extraction method and two improved algorithms, considering implications of multi-neighborhood pixels toward middle pixel, a new mixed weighted neighboring local binary pattern texture descriptor is constructed, and the histogram of oriented gradient feature is fused to gain a more detailed leaf feature description vector. Finally, the experimental results on the open Flavia data set show that the proposed method can obtain good experimental results.

articleTitle: Research on the Digitalization of Miao Ethnic Costume Patterns Based on Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Miao ethnic clothing patterns, as one of the important carriers for recording and inheriting the history and culture of the Miao people, have unique ethnic characteristics and profound ethnic cultural connotations. However, with the rapid advancement of modernization, traditional lifestyles and handicrafts are encountering unprecedented challenges. Many traditional skills are gradually being lost due to a lack of successors, and the inheritance and protection of Miao ethnic clothing patterns are facing a similar crisis. Against this backdrop, the digital research and practice of Miao ethnic clothing patterns are particularly urgent and significant. This article is based on Processing programming technology, which first extracts and transforms the typical colors in the patterns of Miao ethnic clothing, and then makes innovative applications on this basis. Afterwards, edge detection technology is used to extract the structure features of the patterns in Miao ethnic clothing. Through these digital methods, the details and distinctive features of Miao ethnic clothing patterns can be studied more precisely, which also provides a reference for the digital research and innovative application of Miao ethnic clothing patterns.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Controller System for SRv6 Network with Congestion Control Capability
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: As the scale of telecommunications operators’ networks expands, the requirements for intelligent traffic scheduling and end-to-end Service Level Agreement (SLA) assurance for user services in the backbone network are gradually increasing. This paper introduces the design and implementation of an intelligent controller system based on the Segment Routing IPv6 (SRv6) network, focusing on the overall architecture of the intelligent controller based on the SRv6 network and its congestion control algorithm with priority assurance. The algorithm achieves rapid resolution of link congestion according to the steps of relay link matching, traffic matching, and path re-optimization, effectively addressing path optimization issues in the backbone network when facing traffic congestion alarms, and meeting the flexible scheduling needs of the backbone network.

articleTitle: Ground-Based Radar Imaging for Space Debris Based on Generalized Radon Fourier Transform
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: To solve the issue of space debris detection and imaging, a ground-based radar (GBR) imaging method for space debris based on the generalized radon fourier transform (GRFT) is proposed in this paper. First, the geometric model and signal model are established by using the prior information of high-speed spin of space debris. Subsequently, an improved GRFT method was proposed and successfully applied to space debris imaging. This method fully exploits the amplitude and phase information of the radar-received signal and belongs to coherent integration. Compared with traditional generalized radon transform (GRT) methods, this method can effectively reduce sidelobes and improve noise resistance. Finally, the simulation experiments verified the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on improved handwriting robot based on Python algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Traditional algorithms for writing robots typically rely on pre-defined path planning and precise trajectory control. Due to the reliance on pre-defined paths, the robotic arm may not perform well when dealing with irregular shapes. In contrast, the core of our team's handwriting robot algorithm lies in real-time sampling of trajectories on the screen and converting them into sequences of actions that can be executed by the robotic arm. Firstly, build the hardware part of the handwriting robot, such as the driver and control motherboard, as well as the software part of the robotic arm Python program framework, mainly including communication service module, message processing module, trajectory analysis module, robotic arm inverse solution module, etc. On this basis, geometric analysis of the robotic arm mechanism is carried out, and the program operation is determined by observing the angles of each joint, followed by trajectory planning. This method not only improves real-time performance and accuracy, but also enables the writing robot to adapt to display devices of different resolutions and screen sizes. In daily life, it can be applied to automatic writing and drawing, such as automatic signature or drawing of fine art works.

articleTitle: Fault Riding Through Control Strategy of Two-Level Photovoltaic Converters Based on SMC
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: To optimize the control performance of fault riding through of photovoltaic converters, on the basis of the topology of two-level photovoltaic converter systems, and a model of photovoltaic converter systems is established in this paper. The technology of decoupled double synchronous reference frame - phase locked loop (DDSRF-PLL) is designed to detect the phase of dropped voltage. A fault riding through control strategy of two-level photovoltaic converters based on sliding mode controller (SMC) is proposed, which can quickly reduce active power and increase reactive power during low-voltage riding through (LVRT). Meantime, the transient response speed and performance of the converter is improved. Finally, a simulation model of LVRT control system of the converter is constructed using Matlab software. Through simulation analyses, it can be concluded that the proposed strategy takes approximately a hundred ms to complete the instruction response.

articleTitle: Three-Dimensional Coordinate-Based Detection of PCO Using the Rotating Antenna Method
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Considering the non-perpendicularity of the antenna rotation axis, a three-dimensional coordinate-based method for detecting the antenna phase center is proposed. This method involves fitting a spatial plane to the three-dimensional coordinate points, projecting them onto the plane, and then rotating the plane to achieve a horizontal orientation. The rotation points are then fitted with a least squares circle to evaluate the deviation of the antenna rotation center and the phase center. Experimental validation demonstrated that when only the horizontal coordinates are considered, the fitted phase center deviation was 1.3 mm. In contrast, using the method described in this article, the fitted phase center deviation was determined to be 3.0 mm.

articleTitle: Research on Firmware Upgrade Method of PCIE Board Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This design is based on the PCIE IP core and Master SPI configuration mode of PANGO Logos2 series FPGA. A method of remotely upgrading FPGA firmware through PCIE interface is designed, and the method is applied to PCIE board card based on PANGO Logos2 series FPGA. The PCIE DMA controller and SPI FLASH controller are designed, and the stability of remote upgrade of board firmware is improved by multi-bit stream startup, and the application of the product is improved. It can be applied to communication equipment, network interface card, storage system, password card and other fields.

articleTitle: Research on Support Selection of Photovoltaic Power Station in Complex Environment based on SVM Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper mainly studies the support selection of photovoltaic system. In view of the characteristics of the scaffold foundation in the complex environment of land and shallow water, we consider the influencing factors such as engineering geological conditions, hydrological conditions, type of upper scaffold structure, load conditions, construction technology, construction period requirements and local experience. In combination with the construction conditions, support selection in the complex environment of land and shallow water is carried out, and the actual situation of the site is also considered, and the calculation model is determined according to the actual stress state of the support foundation. SVM machine learning is applied to the support selection research of photovoltaic power stations in the complex environment.

articleTitle: Research on Path Planning of Intelligent Warehouse Mobile Robot based on Meta-heuristic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In multi-dimensional space, the sample-based motion planning method, that is, the rapid expansion of random tree RRT, has the advantages of probabilistic integrity, fast exploration speed, and no need to map obstacles from the task space to the configuration space. However, the traditional RRT algorithm has some shortcomings, such as low convergence speed in the process of random tree search, unstable orientation, slow tracking speed in complex environments, too many unnecessary nodes, and obstacle constraints, so that the path generated by random sampling contains many unnecessary breakpoints, which leads to the path is not smooth and discontinuous. Therefore, we need to develop an improved RRT algorithm to achieve the purpose of improving the convergence speed of the algorithm while avoiding falling into the local minimum and finally plan an efficient path.

articleTitle: Prediction of Myocardial Ischaemia Based on Spectral Analysis of ECG
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Disease and death due to myocardial ischemia affect human health and longevity. The electrocardiogram is the cheapest and most readily available diagnostic method for myocardial ischemia. Intelligent diagnosis based on ECG is interesting to study. In this paper, spectral analysis of ECG is performed, from which spectral features related to myocardial ischemia are extracted and a decision tree classifier is constructed to identify the risk of myocardial ischemia. The performance of the model is evaluated based on the predictions on the test set with an accuracy of 94.2%, positive predictive value of 92.7%, sensitivity of 97.9% and specificity of 88.7%.

articleTitle: Research on Health Parameter Estimation and Thrust Predictive Control of Aeroengine
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to realize the safe and accurate control of aero-engine under high temperature and pressure, especially the effective control of steady state and transition state under the condition of no molting and molting, the research of aero engine health parameter estimation and direct thrust model predictive control was carried out. A nonlinear mathematical model considering aero-engine health parameters was established by using the data-driven modeling method of parameter identification and symbolic regression, and the health parameters that could not be measured directly in the model were estimated by Kalman filter (CKF) algorithm. The nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC) is designed according to the nonlinear mathematical model, control target and safety constraint of aero engine, and the objective function is optimized. The simulation results show that the Kalman filter can estimate the thrust accurately, and the adjustment time and overshoot of NMPC direct thrust controller are better than PID controller. The results show that the proposed direct thrust control system combined with CKF and NMPC and its design method can achieve rapid, accurate and safe thrust control, and provide a new idea for the design of direct thrust control system in the case of aircraft engine degradation.

articleTitle: Research on equipment portrait technology of aluminum electrolyzer with improved spectral clustering
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Electrolyzer is an important equipment to produce aluminum in the aluminum electrolysis industry. The change of production index in the process of electrolysis will affect the current efficiency to different degrees. By constructing the portrait of the electrolytic cell, it can provide research ideas for analyzing the state of the electrolytic cell and mining the relationship between production indicators. This paper takes the electrolytic cell as the research object, uses the production data in the electrolysis process, combines the portrait technology, clustering and other methods, extracts the label information, and constructs the portrait of the electrolytic cell to facilitate the analysis and decision-making of the staff. Aiming at the difficulty of selecting the optimal scale parameter in spectral clustering algorithm, an improved adaptive spectral clustering algorithm based on local coefficient of variation was proposed to improve the clustering performance. Experiments are carried out through actual production data to generate portraits of electrolyzer equipment, which provides reference for practical applications.

articleTitle: An optimized Tikhonov regularization algorithm for EIT image reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the electrical impedance imaging (EIT) problem, aiming at the problem that the traditional Tikhonov regularization algorithm uses a single L2 norm as the regularization term, which leads to the over-smoothing of the solution and the unclear reconstruction of the image, this paper proposes an iterative Tikhonov algorithm (MLTR) with multiple regularization as the penalty term and logarithmic weight factor solving. At the same time, the regularization matrix is modified to improve the lack of prior information caused by the traditional use of the identity matrix as the regularization matrix. Finally, in order to reduce the corresponding time and computational complexity, the dimensionality of MLTR algorithm reconstruction is reduced. Compared with traditional Tikhonov algorithm and iterative algorithms such as Land Weber and conjugate gradient (CG), MLTR algorithm has obvious improvement in imaging clarity and boundary artifacts. The relative error RIE of reconstructed images is as low as 0.0564, and the imaging time is significantly shortened after dimensionality reduction.

articleTitle: Research on optical character recognition based on MLP
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Character recognition in images has become an important research direction in machine vision. With the development of deep learning technology, the accuracy of optical character recognition is constantly improving. In this paper, the principle and processing method of character recognition technology are deeply studied, and the key technologies in the process of character recognition such as image preprocessing, character segmentation and character recognition are discussed. Based on Otsu threshold method, a weighted threshold method is proposed, which is very useful for character segmentation of the overall darkening image. The accuracy of character segmentation is further improved by combining connected region detection and morphology. A classifier model based on multi-layer perceptron (MLP) is adopted to realize the effective recognition of RMB prefix numbers. The experimental results show that the character recognition method in this paper has high accuracy and robustness, and can adapt to the needs of real-time systems.

articleTitle: GeoSep-PointNet++: A 3D Point Cloud Semantic Segmentation Algorithm Based on Geometric Information Enhancement and Feature Separation Encoding
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: To enhance the information encoding of point cloud geometry and multi-feature utilization, thereby further improving the accuracy of 3D point cloud semantic segmentation, this paper proposes a GeoSep-PointNet++ network based on geometric information enhancement and feature separation encoding. The GEO module is used to enhance the geometric information encoding of the local space, introducing the coordinates of the sampling points in the local space, their own coordinates, and Euclidean distances, which increases the information of each point in the space by 7 dimensions. The SEP module is used to achieve independent encoding of point cloud additional features and geometric features, separating geometric features from additional features and processing them separately with MLP. Experiments on the semantic segmentation of the S3DIS public dataset show that the proposed network's OA and mIoU are 82.4% and 51.96%, respectively, which are 1.3% and 2.57% higher than PointNet++; compared with the segmentation results of other models, the performance of the proposed model has been improved to varying degrees.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Digital Intelligence Evaluation System Based on AB Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the wave of digitalization, AB testing is a tool to evaluate the iterative effect of products and technologies, promoting continuous innovation of products and technologies, so that each adjustment can more accurately hit user needs. Currently, AB testing has been widely used in major Internet companies. Based on this, in order to realize the evaluation of the application effect of first-level tool functions before and after being launched, this paper studies the application effect of construction functions based on tool usage link analysis, AB evaluation rule management and real-time analysis of evaluation data. By building system architectural capabilities such as front-end AB test SDK and back-end AB test interfaces, AB evaluation scenarios for agent front-end pages and backend services are supported.

articleTitle: A Wideband Filtering DDPA Based on Embedded Dielectric and Loaded Metal Patch
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: By loading the metal patches on the bottom of a dense dielectric patch (DDP) and embedding high-dielectric constant dielectric blocks at both ends, this paper designs a novel wideband filtering dense dielectric patch antenna (DDPA). Thanks to the loading of metal patches and embedded dielectric, the TM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</inf>, TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</inf>, and TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">23</inf> working modes belonging to DDP are effectively excited. The four resonant frequencies corresponding to these resonant modes form the working passband of the antenna. At the same time, the introduction of the metal patch and the transverse branch of the microstrip line generate two radiation nulls. Thus realizing the filtering function. In HFSS, the suggested wideband filtering DDPA is designed and simulated. The simulation results show that the relative impedance bandwidth is 23.15% (4.01-5.06 GHz). The simulation average realized gain is 8.16 dBi. The filtering DDPA has good edge-selectivity and wideband.

articleTitle: Design of Lychee Picking Robot Based on SAT Path Planning Algorithm and Fuzzy Obstacle Avoidance Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: A robot with autonomous path planning ability, automatic recognition of fruit maturity, and automatic picking capability has been designed to address the low efficiency of manual lychee picking in Hainan. This article mainly uses the SAT path planning algorithm to transform the path planning problem into a satisfiable problem and uses the MiniSat solver to solve the robot motion sequence. Design an obstacle avoidance system for a picking robot using fuzzy control principles and ultrasonic ranging sensors. At the same time, the Object Detection algorithm is introduced into the maturity recognition of lychee fruits. Experimental tests have shown that the picking robot can complete fruit recognition, path planning, obstacle avoidance, and picking testing on the constructed grid map.

articleTitle: Research on Solving Damped Oscillation Systems using Physics-Informed Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In recent years, physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have gained significant attention for solving data-driven solvers for ordinary and partial differential equations (ODEs/PDEs). Traditional numerical methods often face limitations when dealing with complex boundary conditions and high-dimensional problems. PINNs address these challenges by embedding the constraints of physical equations directly into the loss function of the neural network, offering a more effective solution. The damped oscillation system, a physical system where internal resistance gradually diminishes the vibration, has widespread applications in engineering, physics, and many other fields. Traditional numerical methods for solving these equations typically require mesh discretization and complex boundary condition handling. In contrast, PINNs effectively solve these issues by incorporating physical equation constraints directly into the loss function. This paper uses the motion equation of a damped oscillation system as an example to first introduce the mathematical model of the system, including the motion equation, initial conditions, and boundary conditions. Then, it explains in detail how to apply PINNs using the DeepXDE library to accurately predict the system's dynamic behavior. Finally, a comparison between the predicted results and the analytical solution is conducted to validate the effectiveness and reliability of the model.

articleTitle: Application of Gauss Fitting Method in Quality Assessment of Afterloader System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Spot center detection is an important detection method in optical measurement. In this paper, according to the characteristics of Gaussian fitting method, which can adjust the parameters of Gaussian function by analyzing the distribution characteristics of data points, so as to minimize the error between data points and fitting function, it is used in the quality assessment process of Afterloader System, a kind of instrument used to treat malignant tumors. By using OpenCV and Gaussian fitting method to process and analyze the film images generated during the quality assessment process, the central position of the dark spot formed by the radiation source can be detected, and then the accuracy of the radiation source in place during the treatment process of the Afterloader System can be accurately obtained.

articleTitle: Industrial Video Surveillance Image Denoising based on Non-subsampled Contourlet Transform
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of industrial video scale, visualization technology has become an indispensable technical means. However, during the collection and transmission of images, they may be affected by factors such as the device itself and environmental factors, which can lead to noise pollution and a decrease in image quality, which is not conducive to image post-processing. Therefore, industrial video surveillance image denoising has become an important research topic, and using various methods to improve image quality has become an important research direction. In order to address the ringing effect caused by hard threshold denoising, this paper proposes an adaptive smooth non-subsampled contourlet transform (NSCT) denoising algorithm. The proposed method utilizes the correlation of each sub-band to improve the denoising function, making it adaptive. The simulation results show that the algorithm proposed in this paper improves subjective perception such as contrast and detail clarity of remote sensing images, as well as objective evaluation indicators such as peak signal-to-noise ratio, information entropy, and correlation coefficient

articleTitle: Dual-Flow Feature Coupling GAN for Image Inpainting
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Image inpainting is an significant task in the field of computer vision, which can generate exquisite images from incomplete input images. However, insufficient consideration of the relationship between global and local features during the inpainting process can result in poor consistency or even blurring on the generated image contents. In view of this, a dual-flow feature coupling GAN (DFC-GAN) is proposed, which consists of two encoding and decoding subnetworks, namely the main stream and Transformer stream. The main stream is designed to adopt the fully convolutional network for better capturing features. The Transformer stream is presented to use stacked fast Fourier Transformers (FFTr) to expand the receptive fields effectively. Besides, a space and channel aggregation (SCA) module is introduced to fuse local features extracted by the main stream and global features captured by the Transformer stream to avoid potential domain conflicts. A global feature transfer (GFT) module is designed to couple global features generated by the Transformer stream and features from the main stream layer by layer, which can guide the generation of main stream features. Extensive experiments on two public datasets, including Paris StreetView and CelebA-HQ, demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms the state-of-the-art methods both quantitatively and qualitatively.

articleTitle: Diversified Generation and Evaluation of English Cultural Communication Materials Based on Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs)
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: English has become the most widely used language in the world. In the fields of English education and cultural dissemination, traditional teaching methods and materials are no longer able to meet the growing demand for cultural understanding and communication. This study constructed a Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) model, which generates highly realistic and diverse cultural communication materials by training generators and discriminators. The generator generates data from random noise, while the discriminator distinguishes between generated data and real data. The experimental results show that the Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) value of the material generated by GANs is much lower than that of Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Recurrent Neural Network (RNN), exhibiting higher image realism; its Mode Coverage (MC) value is also higher than other methods, averaging 90.428%. In addition, the audience showed high click through rates and engagement with the materials generated by GANs, verifying their effectiveness in cultural communication and confirming the potential of GANs in generating diverse English cultural communication materials.

articleTitle: Optimization Study of Breaker Failure and Dead zone Protection in Two-thirds Wiring Mode
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that 450ms is needed to isolate the AC system breaker failure and dead zone fault in the extra-high voltage AC/DC hybrid system, which may lead to the multiple consecutive commutation failure in the multi-circuit DC system and thus seriously threaten the stability of the system, the composition of the isolation time of the AC system breaker failure and dead zone fault in the existing 3/2 breaker is analyzed, and the distributed fast breaker failure and dead zone protection system integrated by string is proposed. By optimizing the breaker failure and dead zone protection logic, simplifying the circuit, shortening the transmission time of the remote trip command and improving the logic of the remote trip protection, and reasonably reducing the redundancy delay of multiple links, the resection time of breaker failure and dead zone faults is shortened from 450ms to 200ms under the premise of guaranteeing the reliability. The simulation and test results show the correctness of the theoretical analysis and the effectiveness of the optimization strategy.

Author Keywords: breaker failure and dead zone protection

articleTitle: Edge Detection Method for Infrared Image of Porcelain Insulators based on Modified Generative Adversarial Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The infrared thermography technology has during recent years played an increasingly important role in periodic inspections on tens of millions of porcelain insulators on overhead transmission lines. Edge detection is among others an important prerequisite for the completion of object recognition, semantic segmentation and feature extraction, laying a solid foundation for the accuracy of comprehensive diagnosis on porcelain insulators. A new edge detection method based on modified Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) is proposed in this paper, in order to further improve the anti-noise performance and detection effect of common edge detection methods dedicated for infrared image of insulators. A comparative evaluation including PSNR, IoU and FPR indexes is carried out, and the results reveal that the new method outperforms other common edge detectors to a considerable degree.

articleTitle: Integrated Management Method for Satellite Product Design and Analysis Models Based on Extended Product Breakdown Structure
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: To meet the urgent demand for integrated management of design and analysis models in satellite product development, we developed an extended product breakdown structure (EPBS)-based integrated model management system. The system breaks through the mapping method of design and analysis models based on EPBS, establishes correlation mapping between satellite product design and analysis models, and enables information sharing and transmission between product design and analysis models. It also performs unified coordination and management of model data and breaks the digital barriers between the design and analysis links in satellite product development.

articleTitle: A Study on the Application of an Improved Fine-tuning Method based on LoRA with Transition Matrix for Efficient Parameter Fine-tuning of Large Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the rapid development of large language models (LLMs), efficient parameter fine-tuning has become increasingly important, enabling ordinary researchers to utilize the functions of LLMs in personalized and specialized tasks. The latest progress has proven that various efficient parameter tuning methods can achieve the effect of full parameter training. These methods have significantly reduced the resource consumption of model training. However, how to maintain the generalization ability of large models while improving the fine-tuning effect still remains a challenge. Addressing this issue, this paper thoroughly investigates various mainstream fine-tuning methods, such as LoRA and Ptuning v2, and analyzes their shortcomings from a model mechanism perspective. Then, an improved fine-tuning method based on LoRA is proposed. Our method ensures that the input feature dimension is gradually reduced by adding an intermediate matrix, so that the model can capture key information effectively. Comparative analysis on the public dataset ceval shows that the effectiveness of the proposed method is confirmed.

articleTitle: Improving Spam Detection with a Multi-Agent Debate Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Spam detection is a critical area within information security, where machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) have significantly advanced the state-of-the-art. This paper presents an advanced multi-agent debate framework designed to enhance the accuracy and practicality of spam detection within the realm of information security. By integrating multiple Large Language Models (LLMs), the framework employs innovative discussion strategies and tailored algorithms to simulate complex human evaluation processes. The multi-agent system assigns distinct roles to individual agents, each contributing uniquely to the discussion dynamics, which facilitates a multifaceted evaluation akin to human judgment. The framework’s collaborative approach not only bolsters the authenticity of responses but also strengthens the system’s capacity to handle complex tasks. Through rigorous experimentation, we demonstrate that our multi-agent debate framework significantly outperforms traditional single-agent methods in terms of precision and robustness. The framework’s ability to adapt to the evolving tactics of spammers and its potential to be optimized for various datasets and tasks make it a promising tool for enhancing automated text evaluations.

articleTitle: Research on Optical Simulation of Cockpit Lighting in Civil Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the aviation field, the lighting conditions in the cockpit are crucial for pilots' flight operations. Research has found that reasonable light levels and color temperature settings can effectively enhance pilots' visual recognition ability and reaction time, effectively alleviate visual fatigue, and thereby reduce the possibility of operational errors. This will further improve flight safety and reduce the rate of flight accidents caused by lighting environments. This article focuses on the design of cockpit lighting through optical simulation technology, which allows for an initial preview and verification of optical performance and visual effects in the early stages of design. Using SPEOS for optical simulation, changes can be made to the cabin light sources, cockpit layout, and interior material, color, and structure. By comparing and evaluating the brightness, illuminance, color, and contrast with relevant international standards, the design scheme of the aircraft cockpit can be optimized.

articleTitle: Calculation of Dynamic Ion Flow Field in DC GIL Based on Hermite Interpolation Basis Functions
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Inside the DC GIL cavity, due to the existence of insulators, a dielectric interface is generated, resulting in the accumulation of insulator surface charges, which distorts the electric field distribution along the insulator surface, reduces the surface flashover voltage, and affects the stable operation of DC GIL. Therefore, the study of DC ion flow field during the accumulation of DC GIL insulator surface charge is of great significance to inhibit the accumulation of insulator surface charge and improve the insulation performance of DC GIL. In this paper, Hermite upflow finite element method is used to simulate and calculate the influence of insulator surface charge on DC GIL dynamic ion flow field and the distortion characteristics of insulator surface electric field, which provides a basis for the study of insulator morphology and surface modification.

articleTitle: 3D Human Pose Estimation in Spatio-Temporal Based on Graph Convolutional Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In recent years, 3D human pose estimation has seen rapid development and plays a key role in fields such as human-computer interaction. Currently, the most widely used methods include monocular-based pose estimation and multi-camera-based pose estimation, with study on monocular methods being more extensive. Despite significant progress in 3D pose estimation from single-view images or videos, the accuracy and performance of 3D human pose estimation can be significantly reduced due to depth ambiguity and severe self-occlusion issues, making it still a challenging task. Considering that spatial dependency and temporal consistency can effectively alleviate these issues, this paper proposes a method based on graph structure to estimate 3D human poses from short sequences of 2D joint detection results. Specifically, the domain knowledge about human body structure is explicitly incorporated into the graph convolution operation to meet the specific needs of 3D pose estimation. The proposed method has been evaluated on the challenging benchmark dataset Human3.6M for 3D human pose estimation. Experimental results show that our method outperforms the traditional method using GCNs by 5%, achieving excellent results. This method shows potential applications in fields such as behavior recognition and human-computer interaction.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a New Energy Power Generation Forecasting Model Based on Federated Learning Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Accurate power generation forecasting helps grid operators balance supply and demand effectively. This reduces the risks associated with the volatility of new energy power generation. It also provides decision support for market participants, enhancing the efficiency of new energy utilization. In this paper, a new energy power generation forecasting model based on federated learning technology is proposed. In this model, power generation groups act as participants, and the forecasting model is collaboratively trained through federated learning while data privacy is protected. The model’s prediction accuracy has been validated through experiments conducted on a simulation platform.

articleTitle: Mining Financial Data using Mixtures of Mirrored Weibull Distributions
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Risk management is an important part of financial practice, essential for protecting assets and investments in modern-day volatile markets. This paper proposes a mixture of mirrored Weibull (MMW) distribution for modelling stock returns and estimating risk measures. Unlike common practices which are typically based on the normal distribution, the MMW model can flexibly accommodate non-normal features frequently exhibited in financial data. It also enjoys appealing properties such as having a simple density expression and fast parameter estimation. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our model by assessing its performance in Value-at-Risk (VaR) estimation of three S&P500 stocks. The MMW model compares favourably to Gaussian mixture model and t-mixture model, with significant improvements in VaR estimation and prediction.

articleTitle: Critical link identification algorithm based on multistate flow network reliability
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In electric power communication networks, the effectiveness of link optimization and modification directly affects the improvement of the network reliability and transmission performance. How to effectively identify critical links is particularly important. Traditional algorithms are difficult to accurately reflect the impact of link optimization or modification on the network reliability and transmission performance when facing complex power communication networks. A critical link identification algorithm based on the reliability of multistate flow networks is proposed, which calculates the change of multistate flow transmission reliability by changing the state and corresponding probability of the network links, and then obtains the link importance to identify the critical links. Simulation results show that the algorithm has higher accuracy than the comparation algorithms. The proposed algorithm has significance for guiding how to improve the reliability and optimize the structure of electric power communication networks.

articleTitle: Cloud Edge Collaborative Interaction Technology Based On Compzxutility Boards
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The cloud-edge collaborative interaction technology, leveraging computing power boards, comprises cloud application management services, edge application management clients, and computing power boards. This technology and system serve as a bridge for application and data interaction between cloud and edge systems. The application management service is hosted in the cloud, while the application management client resides on the edge, and the computing power board is integrated into the physical server on the edge. The application management service encompasses modules like application management and edge management. The computing power board facilitates the subscription and deployment of lightweight AI large model applications at the edge. This technology enables the publication, subscription, downloading, and deployment of applications, standardizes application management, facilitates seamless upgrades, enables remote operation and maintenance, and enriches the application ecosystem.

articleTitle: Tire Surface Defect Recognition Based on Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: To ensure that the quality of tires meets the requirements and improve production efficiency, it is of great value to use image processing technology to identify defects on the surface of tires. Different types of defects have different recognition algorithms, so we will study dent, crack, slit recognition algorithms, and wear recognition algorithms separately. For dent, crack, and slit defects, defect segmentation and background interference removal are performed to obtain defect areas. Defect recognition is achieved by extracting feature parameters of defects and setting judgment thresholds. For wear defects, the characteristic parameters of wear are calculated through gray level co-occurrence matrix and gray level histogram, and a judgment threshold is set for defect recognition. The experiment shows that the algorithm has a high recognition accuracy for tire defects, with an average accuracy of 96.15%, a fast recognition speed, and a comprehensive average recognition time of about 2.2 seconds. The algorithm has high recognition efficiency.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of a Material Handling System Based on Industrial Robot
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper presents a detailed design of a material handling system based on industrial robots. The system, comprising key components such as industrial robots, conveyor belts, touch screens, vision systems, placement tables, and material storage systems, constructs a comprehensive and efficient automated material handling and transmission system, achieving automated and intelligent material handling and transmission. The various components of the material handling system described in this paper can work together to achieve fast and accurate material handling and transmission. Among them, industrial robots are responsible for material picking and placing, conveyor belts are used for material transportation, touch screens provide an intuitive human-machine interface, vision systems enable precise material recognition and positioning, placement tables are used for temporary storage of workpieces and materials, and the material storage system is responsible for temporary material storage. Experimental verification demonstrates that this system exhibits significant advantages in improving material handling efficiency and reducing labor costs, providing strong support for enterprises to achieve production automation.

articleTitle: Research on Network Virus Log Data Analysis and Processing Based on Pandas
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Network virus protection is an essential part of network security. Enterprises with a certain level of security awareness always deploy corresponding network antivirus systems. At the same time, China is fully promoting the application innovation of information technology to achieve self-controlled IT. To address this issue, this paper uses Python as the development language and Pandas as the data analysis tool to design and implement software capable of efficiently processing network security protection data on domestic operating systems. This software can rapidly load network protection data packets, handle data with a single click, and provide sorting and querying functionalities. Security maintenance personnel can use the software to conduct a comprehensive review and timely processing of the working data of network systems amidst complex and changeable network security events, bringing convenience to the handling of security issues and improving the efficiency of network security analysis.

articleTitle: Big Data-Driven Genetic Algorithms for Dynamic Multi-Drone Route Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper explores a novel approach to optimizing multi-drone delivery routes by integrating genetic algorithms (GA) with big data analytics. By leveraging real-time data, such as traffic, weather, and terrain information, the system dynamically adjusts routes, overcoming the limitations of static route planning. Simulations across various scenarios, including high-demand peaks and challenging terrains, demonstrate that the GA significantly improves both delivery efficiency and energy usage. Notably, the system shows strong scalability and adaptability to complex environments. Looking ahead, future research will focus on refining predictive capabilities and extending the system’s application to diverse terrains and evolving regulatory frameworks.

articleTitle: Research on Evolutionary Game Theory of Logistics Information Platform Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the booming development of logistics information platforms, the fourth logistics emerged accordingly. Compared with third-party logistics enterprises, fourth-party logistics enterprises have significant advantages. They provide logistics services to logistics demanders by integrating logistics resources and capabilities. Not only do they simplify the purchasing process for logistics demanders and reduce the complexity of logistics, but they also quickly respond to market needs and provide integrated supply chain solutions. This paper analyzes the influence of big data services on the information sharing coordination of logistics information platforms based on evolutionary game theory. By analyzing the saddle point of the model, it proves that big data services have the ability to improve the coordination of logistics information platforms.

articleTitle: Research on Kalman Filter Tracking Algorithm Based on Singer Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In this paper, the tracking performance debugging of the shipboard servo system and the working principle of the target simulator are studied, and a method to test the performance of the shipboard servo on the basis of the target simulator adding the function of simulating the geodetic target is presented. Finally, experiments verify the correctness and effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor System For Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) is a typical non-linear control system. In order to verify the influence of the non-linear motor model on the vehicle, this paper builts a motor system model. When the system is running under US06 drive cycle, the torque will jitter in the high-speed area. After the introduction of PI dynamic adjustment, this problem was solved.

articleTitle: Research on Precise Control Method of High Torque Hydraulic Motor Stator Based on Optimized PID Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In response to the current situation in China's mining, shipbuilding, military, engineering machinery and other fields where hydraulic motors with good low-speed stability, high starting torque, and high power density mainly rely on imports, we have independently developed an internal curve radial piston hydraulic motor. We have studied the structural characteristics of basic components such as stator guide rail curve and motor rollers, mastered key design and manufacturing technologies such as high wear-resistant stator, low impact, and high power ratio, analyzed the working principle and control accuracy requirements of hydraulic motor stator for different operating conditions, and proposed a precise control method and control strategy using optimized PID algorithm. The PID parameter adjustment obtained by defuzzification is applied to the PID controller to control the system. Taking the transmission system of a certain motor used in heavy engineering machinery as an example, which requires high torque output and stable operation, this study adopts the PID algorithm for adjustment and optimization. After optimization, the response curves of displacement error and velocity error are smooth, and the stabilization time is only 4.768 seconds. At this time, the amplitude of displacement error decays to less than 10% of the peak value. The experiment shows that this control method is stable and reliable, and can achieve precise control of hydraulic motors.

articleTitle: Image Registration Algorithm for Scene Matching Auxiliary Navigation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: At this stage,various military equipment is gradually becoming intelligent,and the important reason for automation isto make full use of electronic information technology to dig into information,the scene matching assisted inertial navigation system,as a common integrated navigation system,has guiding and auxiliary value for assisted navigation technology.In this paper ,an image registration algorithm based on B-spline and mutual information is used,Improved the problem that the registration algorithm based on feature matching is difficult to extract the feature space.

articleTitle: Research on Enhancing Vehicle Roll Stability with Optimizaton of Lateral Stability Bar
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The chassis design of the car needs to provide enough roll stability to ensure that the vehicle has good handling performance. However, the roll stability of the car is affected by many factors. This paper compares and analyses the influence of various factors on the roll stability of vehicles, and focuses on analyzing the lateral stabilizer bar to enhance the role of vehicle roll stability and methods by giving a example, which can provide effective reference for the study of the design of vehicle roll stability.

articleTitle: Innovative Applications of 5G in Petrochemical Industry: Challenges and Opportunities
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Petrochemical industry is an important pillar industry in the national economy. It has industry characteristics such as high-value equipment, complex processes, long industrial chains, high risks, and great environmental protection pressure. It also faces industry pain points such as non-transparent equipment management, difficult inheritance of process knowledge, low-level collaboration in the upstream and downstream of the supply chain, and high pressure on safe production. The petrochemical industry has an urgent need for digital transformation and needs to comprehensively improve the digital levels of equipment management, knowledge management, supply chain management, and safety management. Currently, in petrochemical parks, wired access still dominates the network, with wireless networks such as 4G and Wi-Fi as supplements. The existing network capabilities can hardly support the ever-expanding business scale, and there are pain points such as insufficient scalability, low intelligence level, and data sharing. As a new-generation mobile communication network, 5G has made positive progress in vertical industry application fields, which is of great significance for the petrochemical industry to improve its intrinsic safety and clean production levels and realize digital, networked, and intelligent transformation and upgrading.

articleTitle: Intelligent administrative decision support system construction and efficiency evaluation based on big data analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, big data has become an important force to promote social progress and governance innovation. In the field of administrative management, the application of big data has brought unprecedented changes to the decision-making process, and promoted the scientific, intelligent and accurate decision-making. This paper aims to discuss the construction framework, key technology, implementation path and efficiency evaluation method of the intelligent administrative decision support system based on big data analysis, in order to provide theoretical support and practical guidance for improving the government decision-making efficiency, optimizing resource allocation and enhancing the public service ability.

articleTitle: Reliability Study of Landing Light System for Civil Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The landing light system of civil transport aircraft is mainly used to provide ground reference information during final approach, landing, rolling, taxiing, turning, and takeoff, and to illuminate any major obstacles on the aircraft's approach glide path or runway at night. With the rapid development of light source technology, aircraft landing light systems are undergoing a technological revolution. LED lighting has gradually become the mainstream choice for aircraft landing lighting due to its high brightness, low power consumption, and long lifespan. This study followed the safety assessment method of SAE ARP 4761 and conducted a comprehensive study on the design, validation, and optimization of aircraft landing light systems. The research results indicate that by adopting advanced LED technology and reliability analysis methods, the reliability and safety of aircraft landing light systems can be significantly improved, providing new perspectives and methods for the design and maintenance of future civil aircraft landing light systems.

articleTitle: Research on Active Defense Technology for Transformers Based on Dissolved Gas Analysis in Oil and Partial Discharge Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Transformers, as core equipment in power systems, have their operational reliability directly related to the safety and stability of the entire power grid. Partial Discharge (PD) and Dissolved Gas Analysis (DGA) in oil are crucial means for assessing transformer insulation status and predicting potential faults. This paper reviews the research status of active defense technologies for transformers based on Dissolved Gas Analysis in oil and Partial Discharge detection. It analyzes the technical principles, monitoring methods, application examples, and future development directions of these technologies. By integrating Dissolved Gas Analysis in oil and Partial Discharge monitoring technologies, a design scheme for an active defense system for transformers is proposed. This system aims to achieve early warning and active defense against transformer faults, thereby enhancing the safety and reliability of the power grid.

articleTitle: Robust H∞ Consensus Control for Heterogeneous Multi-agent Systems Based on Time-delay and Switching Topology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This study proposes a consensus control strategy for heterogeneous multi-agent systems characterized by uncertain parameters and external disturbances, to address the intricate robust control challenges posed by time-varying delays and dynamic network topologies. A distributed control protocol is design to make the states of the heterogeneous multi-agent system be consistent. Then the stability of the control protocol is analyzed by Lyapunov-Krasovskii stability theory and integral inequality techniques, and the sufficient conditions for the system to achieve robust H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> consistency are obtained. Finally, the results of the simulations verify the accuracy of the theoretical analysis presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on burst signal acquisition algorithm of low earth orbit satellite
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Low-orbit satellites have attracted wide attention from scholars due to their advantages of high received signal strength and low propagation path loss. At the same time, the problems of large Doppler frequency shift, low signal-to-noise ratio and limited visual time of low-orbit satellites make the acquisition of signals difficult. In this paper, a acquisition algorithm combining folding matched filtering and FFT is designed in high dynamic environment to capture burst signals, and compensate for large Doppler frequency and code phase offset. Finally, Matlab simulation is used to realize the successful acquisition of signals with Doppler frequency shift of ± 40kHz.

Author Keywords: frequency compensation and pseudo-code phase compensation

articleTitle: Exploring the Progressive Optimization Technique within Response Surface Methodology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Response surface methodology(RSM) is a commonly used statistical method for studying and optimizing the influencing factors in the production process. By establishing mathematical models to describe the relationship between factors and responses, response surface methodology can help us identify and optimize the settings of influencing factors to achieve optimal production results. The results can be demonstrated by graphing in a three-dimensional space. An example involving tourists satisfaction is introduced to this research, which involves how to use this approach and explains the results. In this study, response surface methodology is applied to explore and optimize the key influencing factors in the production and service process using Python. By collecting experimental data and establishing appropriate mathematical models, we assess the impact of various factors on the production and service process and achieve optimal results by optimizing factor levels. Additionally, we conduct further analysis on interaction effects to gain a deeper understanding of how the interactions between influencing factors affect production and service outcomes.

articleTitle: The Predictive Analysis of Sea Surface Temperature (SST) from the Great Barrier Reef in Australia Based on EMD-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The escalating sea surface temperature (SST) poses a significant threat to coral reef ecosystems globally, making SST prediction a pivotal research area in operational oceanography. This study compiles and analyzes SST data from the Great Barrier Reef in Australia. We explore SST prediction using the Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network and a hybrid Empirical Mode Decomposition (EMD)-LSTM approach, Results indicate that both models accurately forecast SST, by comparing the RMSE, MAPE, and MAE metrics, it can be concluded that the EMD-LSTM model outperforms the LSTM model in prediction effectiveness. This underscores the potential of the EMD-LSTM approach in enhancing coral reef conservation efforts by providing more precise SST forecasts, thereby mitigating the adverse impacts of temperature stress on these fragile ecosystems.

Author Keywords: the Great Barrier Reef in Australia

articleTitle: Design of Temperature Control System Based on STM32 and Tuned PID Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The design of this paper is to solve the problems of poor stability and low control accuracy of traditional temperature control system in industry, agriculture and even daily life. This paper is a design of temperature control system based on STM32 microcontroller and self-tuning PID (proportional-integral-differential) algorithm. The system mainly includes temperature acquisition module, mode adjustment module, display module and temperature control module. The temperature acquisition module uses a temperature sensor to monitor the ambient temperature in real time, which is converted into a digital signal by ADC and fed back to the main control chip. The temperature control module processes the temperature signal through the PID algorithm designed by the target set value and the actual ambient temperature, calculates the control quantity according to the set target temperature, and outputs it to the execution module through the PWM signal, so as to realize the precise control of the heater and the temperature control. The results show that the temperature control system based on STM32 and tuning PID algorithm can quickly respond to temperature changes, has high control accuracy and stability, can maintain the target temperature under different environmental conditions, and is suitable for various application scenarios that need accurate temperature control.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of 3 DEXPERIENCE in Multi-Disciplinary Cross-Platform Collaborative Design for Satellite
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: To address the issues of frequent data conversion, serial processes, and lack of effective technical status control during multi-disciplinary cross-platform satellite collaboration, this paper investigates the integrated collaborative design model based on the 3D Experience platform. It explores how to achieve concurrent collaborative design and joint simulation analysis of multi-disciplinary CAD models from different platforms in a unified environment. An integrated collaborative environment is constructed, allowing seamless integration of CAD data from various sources within the same platform, enabling real-time collaborative workflows and precise iteration control. The research methodology covers the entire process from heterogeneous CAD model integration, data management, real-time collaboration, to joint simulation analysis. This approach optimizes the design process and ensures data validity, real-time collaboration, and accuracy of modifications. Additionally, this study demonstrates the potential of the 3DEXPERIENCE platform in improving design efficiency, reducing design conflicts, and enhancing design quality.

articleTitle: A Military Image Stitching Method with Key Targets Constraints Based on Semantic Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: compared with commercial images, military images usually have large parallax and depth of field due to the complex battlefield environment. As a result, key targets in the image, such as fighters, weapons, vehicles, military facilities, etc., tend to occupy a smaller percentage of pixels. Correspondingly, blur or ghosting will occur after image stitching which may lead to misdetection and misjudgment to commanders in a war. Therefore, a novel method for military images with key targets constraints is proposed based on semantic segmentation. First, the whole image is distinguished to several regions according to the kind of the military targets by a semantic segmentation. Second, the homographies of all the local regions of targets are calculated and added to the background homography as constraints to obtain the global homography of the whole image. Finally, a new image is obtained by stitthing the two images transformed by the global homography.
