Experiments show that the proposed method can improve the articulation of key objects in military images which can provide accurate information for the commanders in the complex battlefield environment.

articleTitle: Design of Smart Bin Control System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With all kinds of smart home products increasingly penetrating into people's daily life nowadays, smart bins make people's life more convenient and healthy. The smart bin system designed in this thesis realizes the functions of automatic opening, remote control by mobile phone, real-time notification of the status of the bin, early warning of fire risk, voice interactive experience and remote control. Based on the implementation of the functions, the overall design block diagram is determined, and the infrared sensing unit, voice recognition unit, Bluetooth unit, smoke sensing unit and LCD unit are designed. At the same time, this thesis carries out the corresponding hardware design and software design for each unit to ensure the normal operation of each module, and finally through the installation and debugging of the physical object, to ensure the normal use of the functions of the intelligent rubbish bin.

articleTitle: Algorithm for division of process area in hybrid additive-subtractive manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Hybrid additive-subtractive manufacturing technology is a secondary development of traditional CNC machine tools, building upon additive manufacturing technology. By integrating the high precision and excellent surface quality of subtractive manufacturing, it compensates for the low accuracy of additive manufacturing processes, offering a novel hybrid processing method. Research on process area division in hybrid additive-subtractive manufacturing provides a foundation for mixed production process planning. However, existing division methods cannot fully eliminate tool interference during subtractive manufacturing. To address this, this paper proposes a reachable area division method based on Gaussian mapping. After processing the three-dimensional workpiece model, the reachable area is calculated using the generated processing data, and the processing area is then divided accordingly.

articleTitle: A Highly Selective Wideband Filtering Stacked DDPA
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In this paper, a compact and highly selective stacked filtering dense dielectric patch (DDP) antenna (DDPA) is proposed. By placing a pair of thin DDP with high dielectric constant along the y axis on the DDP with low dielectric constant, the resonant frequency of the TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</inf> mode is adjusted to approach low frequency and form a passband with the TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf> mode. By loading a U-shaped microstrip feeding line on the microstrip feeding line, the bandwidth can be further broadened and the TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf>, TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11 + δ</inf> and TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</inf> modes can be successfully excited in the passband. The radiation nulls are generated by the U-shaped microstrip line and non-radiative TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</inf> mode, respectively. By adjusting the length of the U-shaped microstrip line and the size of DDP with high dielectric constant, the independent adjustment of radiation nulls can be achieved. Finally, the proposed filtering antenna achieves a relative bandwidth of 11.66 % (4.04-4.54 GHz). The average realized gain and peak gain are 6.89 dBi and 7.1 dBi, respectively. The realized gain in the passband is very flat, and the fluctuation is less than 0.7 dBi. The proposed antenna has the advantages of compactness, high selectivity and flat gain, and it can be applied to modern satellite communication and wireless communication systems.

articleTitle: Square Submarine Searching Strategy for Unmanned Surface Vessel Based on Dipping Sonar
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the unmanned surface vessel equipped with a dipping sonar searches submarines, the searching probability of the unmanned surface vessel with the square searching strategy is studied. Firstly, it is designed of the square searching strategy model for the unmanned surface vessel. Considering the different situations of the submarine ’ s evasion, such as constant course and speed, changing course with constant speed, changing speed in the same course, and changing course and speed simultaneously, the simulation experiments of searching submarine are carried out. The results show the relationship between the searching probability and the submarines’ evasion, which can provide reference for the unmanned surface vessel equipped with a dipping sonar to search submarines.

articleTitle: Research on one-stop traditional Chinese medicine service system based on character recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In recent years, China has introduced numerous policies aimed at fostering the growth of the traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) industry. Concurrently, the enrichment of TCM healthcare resources has s purred an increase in demand for TCM services. To address the needs of TCM practitioners and to offer the public more high-quality, precise, and intelligent TCM services, we have designed a comprehensive WeChat applet for TCM services that incorporates text recognition technology. This applet leverages text recognition to analyze the ingredients listed in prescriptions and employs a cold extraction method to prepare Chinese patent medicines, thereby reducing the cost of TCM treatments for consumers. Developed using the WeChat developer tool, the applet boasts a user-friendly interface and a suite of integrated functionalities, presenting a valuable service model for the TCM sector.

articleTitle: Research on Power Communcaiton Optical Transmission Network Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the steady development and intelligent transformation of Electric Power Industry, a more stable and rapidly self-healing transmission communication network has become an indispensable foundation for daily operation and management. The transmission network architecture of the power industry, as the core of this system, carries the important task of serving as an information exchange channel for the entire process of power transmission, distribution, and related daily work. This article will start from four aspects: transmission network hardware, network construction, service protection methods, and access services. From macro planning to micro service connection methods, it will introduce the measures taken by the power industry to improve the stability and self-healing ability of transmission networks from two aspects.

articleTitle: ISPR: A rumor propagation model based on dual transmission modes of friends and recommendation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Previous rumor propagation models are mostly based on friend-to-friend mechanisms or solely focused on platform recommendation mechanisms, neglecting the coexistence of these two propagation patterns in real scenarios. Considering this issue, promotion nodes are introduced to construct an ISPR (Ignorant-Spreader-Promotion-Removed) model. First, the basic reproduction number R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> is calculated using the next-generation matrix and the stability of the model at the rumor-free equilibrium point is demonstrated. Then, through numerical simulations, the theoretical findings are validated and the factors influencing rumor propagation are analyzed. The results indicate that incorporating a recommendation mechanism significantly accelerates the spread of rumors, increases the peak of rumor propagation, and expands the influence of rumors compared to traditional friend-to-friend propagation models.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Power Tax Data Query Tool Based on Private Information Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Design and implementation of a power tax data query tool based on Private Information Retrieval (PIR) technology is presented in this paper, aimed at enabling power companies to securely obtain tax data without revealing the privacy of their queries, thereby more accurately estimating the electricity usage of enterprises. With the development of the digital economy and the instability of economic operations, the tax-electricity index, as a new government tool, is of great significance for monitoring the quality and efficiency of economic operations. By employing Secure Multi-Party Computation (MPC) technology, the MASCOT protocol, and PIR technology, this paper designs and implements a method that protects the security of tax-electricity private data while improving data utilization efficiency. Simulation results demonstrate that the tool can effectively assist power companies in using tax data to optimize enterprise electricity services, providing support for high-quality economic development.

articleTitle: Microgrid Battery Energy Storage Capacity Configuration Optimization Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the battery energy storage equipment in microgrid is too fast and the capacity configuration is too high, this paper establishes an optimal configuration model of battery energy storage capacity in microgrid considering life loss, and proposes a cost calculation method of battery energy storage life loss based on fixed daily cycle times. This method combines the idea of piecewise linearization and scene analysis method, which can effectively extend the life of battery energy storage by optimizing the discharge depth and daily cycle times of battery energy storage. Finally, the effectiveness of the new model under different uncertainties and different unit prices of battery energy storage is verified by an example.

articleTitle: Improved YOLO Model for Object Detection of Underwater Trash
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Accurate detection of underwater trash is crucial for effective marine conservation efforts. In this paper, we present an improved You Only Look Once (YOLO) model specifically tailored for object detection of underwater waste. In the network structure, the imbalance of feature information due to the splicing operation on the front side of the detection head is solved by integrating the ConvNeXt block into the YOLO model; in the backpropagation stage, the localization error of the prediction box is reduced by adopting EIoU Loss as the model loss function. our model demonstrates significant improvements in both detection accuracy and robustness compared to existing approaches. Experiments conducted on underwater trash images showcase the effectiveness of our model, achieving state-of-the-art performance.

articleTitle: Deep Reinforcement Learning-Based Resilient Resource Allocation for Smart Grid Network Slicing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the growing number of users and increasing business volume, network resource allocation and fault recovery in the smart grid have become critical challenges. However, existing approaches do not address both business requirements and fault recovery in dynamically changing network environments, impacting user experience and business continuity. We propose a deep reinforcement learning-based resilient resource allocation algorithm DRL-CRO for smart grid network slicing. DRL-CRO incorporates a business transfer module to ensure service recovery after node failures, enhancing system reliability and user experience. Simulation results demonstrate that, compared to the baseline algorithm, DRL-CRO reduces operational costs, improves the revenue-cost ratio, boosts the overall reliability of the smart grid, and shows strong robustness under fluctuating network loads.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Meta-heuristic Optimization Algorithm for Solving the Multi-objective Crew Allocation Problem
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The ship crew scheduling problem is a critical challenge to improve the organizational efficiency and safety. This paper conducts a systematic study on this problem and achieves innovative results in both theoretical modeling and algorithm. Firstly, a novel multi-objective optimization model for crew scheduling is proposed, comprehensively considering multiple optimization objectives. Secondly, an efficient hybrid meta-heuristic optimization algorithm is designed for solving the model. The algorithm integrates intelligent optimization strategies and makes targeted improvements in the algorithm framework, initial solution generation, neighborhood structure design, etc., improving the solving performance. Extensive simulation experiments demonstrate the model's applicability and the algorithm's superiority in solution quality and computational efficiency. The findings provide insights for improving human resource allocation in ship crew scheduling and human resource allocation. Extensive simulation experiments demonstrate the model's applicability superiority over classic methods in solution quality and computational efficiency.

articleTitle: Fast De-occlusion Neural Radiation Field
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) has demonstrated remarkable capabilities in the field of novel view synthesis, but most studies are limited to static scenes. However, in practical applications, outdoor scenes with transient objects are more common. In these scenes, the scene to be reconstructed is often not isolated, but accompanied by various transient objects, such as moving objects or occluders. Given that most current NeRF models mainly learn static objects through perceptual networks, they face challenges in dealing with transient objects. This paper proposes an optimization model that combines a transient MLP perceptron network specifically for learning transient objects. It also introduces a hybrid effective sampling and key sampling method and a cache structure based on a double-layer linear table to accelerate model rendering speed. The density information output by the transient MLP network can change with the change of the observation angle, and an additional uncertainty is output, thereby achieving effective learning and screening of transient objects. This helps reduce the impact of occluders on the reconstruction results.

articleTitle: Spatiotemporal Convolution Traffic Accident Risk Prediction based on Multi-graph Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Traffic accident risk prediction methods are usually based on static geographical attributes for spatial modeling, ignoring inter-regional functional semantic information, resulting in insufficient ability to capture semantic spatial correlation and dynamic spatio-temporal features. A spatiotemporal convolution traffic accident risk prediction model based on multi-graph fusion is proposed. Firstly, the model constructs spatial relationship maps from multiple perspectives to capture local geospatial dependencies and global semantic attributes. Secondly, the attention mechanism adaptively learns the dynamic representation of temporal and spatial features. Finally, the spatial dependence is captured by the graph convolutional network in the spatiotemporal convolution module, and the time dependence is captured by the gated unit with dilatation causal convolution. In addition, the weighted L2 loss function is used to mitigate the zero-inflation caused by sparse data. Through the validation on two datasets NYC and Chicago, the results show that the model has a large performance advantage in traffic accident risk prediction.

articleTitle: Research on Applying Large Language Models for Software Updates in Power Communication Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The widespread use of various software in power communication networks introduces more and more challenges, particularly in ensuring the security and stability of software updates. Large language models (LLMs) with their excellent capabilities in natural language processing and understanding complex systems offer a new solution. This paper examines basic workflow of software updates in power communication networks and discusses the application of LLMs to facilitate the software updates process. This applying of LLMs can provide a more efficient and insightful approach to manage the complexities and risks of software updates in power communication networks.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Environmental and Water Conservation Management Platform for Highway Projects in High Cold Regions
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In high cold regions, environmental and water conservation in highway construction projects are characterized by numerous sites, expansive coverage, and significant management challenges. Addressing the limitations of traditional environmental and water conservation management, such as the reliance on a singular management approach, inefficient management practices, and poor integration among various stages, we have developed an environmental and water conservation management platform for highway construction in high cold regions. By establishing a comprehensive data resource system for the entire environmental and water conservation management process and utilizing integrated of sky and ground data collection, a cloud-based collaborative service for the entire process of environmental and water conservation management has been constructed based on a GIS map. This platform can serve as a reference for the construction of environmental and water conservation management platforms for highway projects in high cold regions.

articleTitle: Research on Online Test of Fuel Cell Electrochemical Impedance Spectrum Based on Discrete Binary Sequence Signal
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The measurement of fuel cell internal resistance is crucial for evaluating battery performance, improving efficiency, and developing production. In this paper, the impedance of the fuel cell internal resistance is measured using EIS technology. The pulse-perturbation current sequence is optimized by shortening the wide-spectrum pulse injection time and improving the signal-to-noise ratio of specific frequencies. The impedance spectrum is obtained by wavelet transformation of the time series, and the probability density function of the impedance spectrum is estimated by maximum likelihood method. Finally, high-precision real-time monitoring of the wide-spectrum impedance spectrum is achieved.

articleTitle: Research on Three-Dimensional Passive Localization of Broadband Sound Source Based on Sparse Decomposition Theory
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: According to the sparse distribution of sound sources in spatial domain, a horizontal array and a vertical array are used to realize high-resolution three-dimensional passive localization of broadband sound sources under the conditions of few snapshots and low signal-to-noise ratio. Aiming at the deficiency of incoherent processing, this paper proposes a joint multi-frequency point block sparse processing method. This method makes use of the same sparse structure characteristics of the received data of each frequency point after sparse decomposition, and carries out joint multi-frequency point processing by stacking the sparse structures of blocks, which not only retains the high resolution of sparse solution, but also increases the robustness to noise. Simulation and experimental data processing verify the effectiveness and superiority of this method.

articleTitle: Multi-Agent-based Multi-source Information Fusion Processing Method for Pressure Equipment Operation and Maintenance
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This study addresses the challenges of real-time performance and processing efficiency in the acquisition of multi-source heterogeneous data for pressure equipment operation. The existing methods struggle to support the real-time intelligent control of the operation and maintenance processes of pressure equipment. To overcome these limitations, we propose a novel Multi-Agent-based approach for the acquisition and fusion processing of multi-source heterogeneous information. This method ensures a unified characterization of data during the operation of pressure equipment, providing reliable, timely, and accurate data support for intelligent control. The goal is to enhance the efficiency and safety of pressure equipment operation and maintenance.

articleTitle: A High-resolution Multi-snapshot Newtonized Orthogonal Matching Pursuit for Line Spectrum Estimation with Random Compressed Multiple Measurement Vectors
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: A new high-resolution multi-snapshot Newtonized orthogonal matching pursuit (MNOMP) algorithm is proposed to deal with the line spectrum estimation after random compression (RC-MNOMP) with multiple measurement vectors (MMVs) in this paper. RC-MNOMP has the low computation complexity and state-of-the-art estimation performance. Detecting a new sinusoid on an oversampled discrete Fourier transform (DFT) grid and refining the parameters of already detected sinusoids are two key steps of RC-MNOMP. A stopping criterion based on the overestimating probability of the model order is provided. Finally, numerical results are conducted to show the effectiveness and accuracy of RC-MNOMP.

articleTitle: Unsupervised Multi Focus Image Fusion based on Deep Image Prior
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Multi-focus image fusion is an effective method to eliminate the defocusing blur in the imaging process. At present, due to the lack of real supervised data, most multi-focus image fusion algorithms can only synthesize datasets through artificial blur, which may lead to the loss of detailed features. According to Deep Image Prior, utilizing the implicit prior information of neural networks can solve many standard inverse problems. Motivated by this idea, this paper proposes a new unsupervised MFIF method, which uses two deep prior networks to model the fused image and the focus map respectively, then use the edge reconstruction loss function to constrain the training process. The edge reconstruction loss can compensate for the shortcomings in generating deep image prior details. In order to verify the feasibility of the algorithm, four widely used objective evaluation metrics were selected for performance evaluation in the experimental verification stage.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of an Underwater Cleaning Robot
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at the limitations of existing underwater cleaning robots in terms of cleaning efficiency, motion stability, and adaptability, a new type of underwater cleaning robot was designed. Firstly, the model and structure of the robot were determined. Then, numerical simulations and analysis of the critical climbing state of the robot in the flow field were conducted to study its fluid dynamics and mechanical properties in the critical climbing state. The analysis showed that the robot has high stability and low resistance with good adsorption ability when moving underwater. Finally, the industrial virtual simulation to simulate wall climbing process was conducted through the Unity 3D engine platform. The simulation results showed that the design of the robot is reliable, which lays an important foundation for future practical applications.

articleTitle: Simulation of Microstructure Heat Transfer of Graphene Doped Epoxy Resin Matrix Composites
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Based on establishing the mathematical model of parallel heat transfer, considering the coupling effect of the flow field, temperature field, and stress field, the mathematical model of parallel heat transfer is solved, and the heat transfer characteristics such as temperature field and heat flux of graphene-doped composites are predicted. The equivalent heat transfer boundary conditions were simplified, and the equivalent heat transfer model of graphene-doped epoxy resin matrix composites was numerically solved to obtain the equivalent heat transfer characteristics of graphene-doped epoxy resin matrix composites. Compare the results of the heat transfer mathematical model and equivalent heat transfer model, such as temperature rise curve, heat flux distribution, and other heat transfer characteristics, analyze the relative error of the heat transfer mathematical model, and verify the correctness of the established mathematical model.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Intelligent Software Version Management Platform for Power Communication Network Based on Large Language Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the rapid development of power communication network, software version update have become a heavy task in network operation and maintenance. It’s necessary to manage software versions on an automated and intelligent platform to facilitate IT engineers updating software. In this paper, we propose a design and implementation of intelligent software version management platform based on Large Language Models (LLMs). Evaluation shows that LLMs can play an important role in software updating process and this intelligent platform can provide assistance to operations and maintenance of power communication network.

articleTitle: A security situation awareness method based on the change of network security attack and defense status
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the continuous development of cyber attack methods, traditional security situational awareness methods can no longer meet the needs of dynamic and complex network environments. This paper proposes a security situational awareness method based on changes in network security attack and defense status. By monitoring and analyzing attack behaviors and defensive measures in real-time within the network, it dynamically assesses the network security situation. Initially, this method establishes a multidimensional state change model, dividing attack and defense states into multiple layers such as attack source, attack target, and response measures. Subsequently, through data mining and machine learning techniques, it identifies correlations and change patterns between attack and defense states, enabling the prediction and early warning of potential threats. Experimental results demonstrate that this method exhibits significant advantages in enhancing situational awareness accuracy and response speed, providing more effective technical support for network security protection.

Author Keywords: Changes in offensive and defensive status

articleTitle: Research on Transmission Tower Tilt Prediction Algorithm Based on Multi source Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Safety production is an eternal theme for power enterprises. Once the power grid malfunctions, industrial and agricultural production in the affected areas will completely stop. The vast majority of power safety accidents are caused by tower collapse, disconnection, and other issues in the transmission network. To address this issue, the paper proposes a construction site control method based on multi-source data fusion, which transmits operational data of large buildings such as work sites and transmission towers back to achieve on-site construction quality, equipment and machinery monitoring; Secondly, based on the actual situation around the transmission line, the online prediction method of tilt angle based on dynamic sliding window is analyzed to further achieve the purpose of monitoring tower tilt and increase the reliability of the results.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Intelligent Monitoring Algorithm for Transmission Lines Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: As the main equipment supporting overhead transmission lines, power towers play an important role in the process of transmitting electricity from power plants to end-users through substations. The typical design service life of a tower is 50 years. The complex geological changes that occur around the tower can easily affect the stability of the tower's fixation, causing the tower to tilt and posing a threat to the safety of the power network. Therefore, in order to ensure the safe and stable operation of the tower, the article applies intelligent tilt monitoring technology to the tilt monitoring of the tower. This technology can effectively achieve real-time dynamic remote monitoring of tower status by management personnel. By real-time monitoring of the operation status of power towers and power networks, management personnel can detect and handle potential faults in advance, thereby fully ensuring the safe operation of the power network.

articleTitle: A Parallel Processing Method for Skyline Queries with Uncertain Preferences
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: A parallel processing method for Skyline queries with uncertain preferences is proposed to address the performance bottlenecks encountered by traditional centralized Skyline queries when handling large-scale, high-dimensional datasets. A probabilistic model is used to model uncertain preferences, and a parallel processing strategy based on prefix constraints and multi-layer absorption techniques is designed. By dividing the dataset into multiple disjoint subsets and executing the Skyline query algorithm independently on each subset, efficient parallel processing is achieved. Experiments show that this method can effectively reduce the computation load, improve query efficiency, and provide an efficient solution for Skyline queries under uncertain preferences.

articleTitle: Deep Analysis Technology of Real-Time Interaction Protocol of Power Grid Intelligent Terminal
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The real-time interaction protocol of smart terminals in the power grid is a key technology for achieving efficient communication and data exchange between devices in the power system. This protocol supports real-time monitoring, fault diagnosis, and data analysis through standardized data formats and interactive processes. With the development of smart grids, real-time interactive protocols are playing an increasingly important role in improving grid operation efficiency, optimizing resource allocation, and achieving automated management. This study proposes a deep analysis method for real-time interaction protocols of smart terminals in the power grid. The method models the field transition state of the protocol through FSM and describes the analysis steps between fields using scripting language, thereby achieving deep analysis of the protocol.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Seedling Environment Monitoring And Early-warning System Based on Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the rise of intelligent agriculture, the intelligent transformation of agriculture has been realised, bringing new development to agricultural production. However, in traditional agriculture, the regulation of seedling growth conditions mainly relies on manual management, and it is difficult to accurately predict and monitor complex ecological changes manually, which increases operational uncertainty and leads to economic losses brought about by low production efficiency. Therefore, this study is based on the machine learning-based environmental monitoring and warning system for seedlings, introducing the hardware design, technical framework, machine learning algorithms in the random forest and convolutional neural network applications. Through the experimental data, the speed and accuracy of the system in environmental abnormality detection are verified. The experimental results show that the system can effectively warn of environmental risks, provide scientific basis and reduce unnecessary losses. In the future, with the promotion and use of the system, it can greatly promote the effective combination of artificial intelligence and intelligent agriculture, and promote the sustainable development of agriculture.

articleTitle: A Flexible Decoding Software for Satellite Data Visualization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the continuous development of satellite remote sensing technology, the decoding software of satellite remote sensing data is constantly iterated and optimized. However, the current commercial decoding software is expensive, complex to operate and inflexible. To address this issue, this paper designs and implements a visual and highly flexible satellite data decoding software, which realizes the functions of real-time reception and processing of remote sensing data, post-processing data playback and storage. In terms of software architecture, the design idea of separating the parsing protocol from the running code and the tab-type interface layout are adopted, which greatly enhances the versatility, flexibility, and extensibility of the software. The test shows that the software runs stably and has fast parsing speed, with a complete parsing rate and accuracy of 100%.

articleTitle: Enhanced Pattern Search Combined with Filter Method for Solving Nonlinear Bilevel Programming Problems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper introduces an innovative approach that combines the traditional filter method with an enhanced pattern search method specifically designed to solve nonlinear bilevel programming problems (BLPP) with a convex lower-level problem. The enhanced pattern search method incorporates a novel mesh that utilizes Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) conditions of the lower-level problem to effectively navigate the solution space. In this approach, the KKT multiplier is treated as an auxiliary variable and is computed through parametric goal programming. Through several numerical experiments and detailed computational analysis, we demonstrate that the enhanced pattern search method provides more accurate estimations of constraint violations, leading to more effective and efficient attainment of optimal solutions with reduced computation time compared to existing methods.

articleTitle: Research on Retrieval-augmented Generation Algorithms for Large Language Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Large language model in the field of text generation shows excellent language skills, combined with the retrieval of generated algorithm is enhanced, the language model is more accurate and timely in a professional field. Therefore, retrieval enhanced generation (Retrieval Enhanced Generation, RAG) has become an important framework for building large language models, but the processing capacity of simple RAG is limited and highly dependent on the quality of retrieval. Therefore, this paper proposes an optimized RAG, adding additional processing steps in the whole process to improve the relevance and overall quality of optimized replies. Our validation shows that the improved RAG has a significant increase in its ability to perform on large models, and by comparing it with fine-tuning techniques, verifies that the combination of RAG and fine-tuning is better than what can be achieved with simple RAG or fine-tuning.

articleTitle: Research on Reactive Power Optimization of Distribution Network with Distributed Generation Based on Quantum Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the rise of distributed generation system, the proportion of DG access to distribution network is increasing. A large number of DG access to distribution network will not only change the power flow direction of distribution network, but also cause voltage fluctuation and reduce power quality. Therefore, a reactive power optimization model with the minimum active power loss and voltage deviation of the distribution network is established, and the quantum particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to solve the problem. Finally, the example simulation is carried out in the IEEE33 node distribution system. The example proves that the quantum particle swarm optimization algorithm is superior to the standard particle swarm optimization algorithm in terms of optimization accuracy and speed. The results verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Data Governance of Electrical Material Properties Based on EBGA-HSA
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Many electrical materials are used in the design of power equipment in the power system. However, the existing database systems for electrical materials are not only vast and complex but also contain erroneous information and missing data, which significantly hinders practical application. This paper proposes a method for data governance in the electrical material system by combining the Elite Breakthrough Genetic Algorithm and the Hybrid Similarity Algorithm (EBGA-HSA). The proposed algorithm introduces a hybrid strategy, where multiple independent single-similarity functions are integrated into a hybrid similarity function to enhance the algorithm's adaptability to the characteristics of the electrical material database. Subsequently, an elite breakthrough strategy is proposed and the genetic algorithm is incorporated to determine the optimal solution for similarity weights. Ultimately, the EBGA-HSA is utilized for filling in missing data and correcting errors in the electrical material database of power systems. The algorithm's effectiveness is validated by establishing a predictive model and comparing it with the cosine similarity algorithm, Jaccard similarity algorithm, hybrid similarity algorithm, genetic-hybrid similarity algorithm, and Elite Breakthrough Genetic Algorithm-Hybrid Similarity Algorithm. Experimental results demonstrate that EBGA-HSA improves the ability to discriminate attributes within the electrical material data system and outperforms existing methods in data governance, thereby enhancing prediction accuracy. Therefore, the proposed algorithm demonstrates practicality and feasibility in the data governance of electrical material systems.

articleTitle: Research on scheduling algorithm for unmanned trucks in open-pit coal mines
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Aiming at the multi-objective traffic flow allocation and scheduling problem of unmanned trucks in open-pit mines, a traditional multi-objective traffic flow allocation and scheduling model for open-pit mine trucks was established from three aspects: revenue, cost, and ore quality, with the objective functions of minimizing transportation costs, minimizing total queue time of unmanned trucks, and minimizing grade deviation. Combining multi-objective genetic algorithm and decomposition based multi-objective optimization algorithm adaptability and characteristics, a new decomposition based constrained dominance principle NSGA-II (DBCDP-NSGA-II) optimization algorithm based on decomposition constrained dominance was proposed, which combines Pareto dominance and decomposition with constraint dominance. And the algorithm was applied to solve the multi-objective traffic flow allocation and scheduling model of unmanned trucks in open-pit mines. The results showed that the traffic flow allocation and scheduling algorithm reduced the transportation cost in open-pit mining, reduced the queuing time of unmanned trucks, and effectively controlled the fluctuation of grade.

articleTitle: Research on abnormal behavior identification method of power network facing unknown attacks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the widespread application of smart grids, power grids are facing increasingly severe security threats, especially unknown attacks. These attacks often cannot be identified through traditional protective measures, posing serious risks to the safe operation of power systems. This paper proposes a method for identifying abnormal behaviors in power grids when facing unknown attacks. This method utilizes machine learning and data mining technologies to monitor the operational data of power grids in real time. By learning normal behavior patterns, this method can effectively identify abnormal behaviors that deviate from the normal state. Specifically, we use unsupervised learning algorithms to construct an anomaly detection model and design a real-time monitoring system to quickly respond to potential threats. The system can quickly complete anomaly detection and response, demonstrating good real-time performance and adaptability. This study provides an innovative solution for power grid security protection, significantly improving the defense capability against unknown attacks. Future research will continue to explore the application of advanced technologies such as deep learning in the screening of abnormal behaviors, in order to further enhance the security of power grids.

articleTitle: Implementation of Socket-based Industrial Hybrid Communication System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In industrial automation scenarios, communication mostly relies on serial communication, such as RS-485 and other common standards. The traditional communication method usually adopts the active communication mode, although this method can realize stable communication between devices, but due to the limitations of the polling period and device response, it may result in the device status not being discovered in time, thus affecting the real-time and response speed of the system. To address this problem, this paper adds an active reporting mechanism on the basis of the original polling communication, so that the device can actively report important information when it detects abnormal data. Through testing and verification, the method significantly improves the timeliness of equipment status, reduces the risk of delayed detection of status changes, has a wide range of application prospects and good universality, and can provide a more efficient solution for the management of industrial field equipment.

articleTitle: Research on coal mine safety evaluation based on SCA-BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Traditional coal mine safety management methods often rely on manual experience, making it difficult to accurately predict potential safety risks and accidents. Therefore, how to achieve effective evaluation of coal mine safety through scientific methods has become a key issue in mine management. In this study, an improved BP neural network model (SCA-BP) using the Sine Cosine Algorithm (SCA) is proposed to evaluate and predict the safety of the coal industry. The results of training and simulation experiments of this model using MATLAB Neural Network Toolkit show that this model is highly practical and has good performance and can be widely used in the safety assessment process of coal industry.

articleTitle: Application object detection technology in intelligent inspection of substations
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Object detection technology is one of the typical application scenarios of artificial intelligence in the field of power production technology. The research and application of object detection technology in intelligent inspection of substations is of great significance to the construction of intelligent substations. This article first explains the object detection technology, then introduces the application of object detection technology in intelligent inspection of substations, and compares and analyzes various object detection algorithms; finally, the shortcomings and development trends of object detection technology in intelligent inspection of substations are discussed.

articleTitle: The Influence of PID Parameters on Ultra-low Frequency Oscillation in Speed-governor Control System of Hydro Turbine based on PSASP
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Regional power grid interconnection brings a series of economic benefits such as power grid staggering peak, hydropower and thermal power complementary, power emergency support and so on. Hydropower plays an increasingly important role in maintaining the stability of the regional power grid with abundant water resources. When the hydropower unit is running, the system power oscillation or even ultra-low frequency oscillation may occur due to the parameter setting of the speed governor control system and the advanced phase operation. In this paper, the 7-type or 8-type hydro turbine governor in PSASP is analyzed, considering the PID control parameters of the speed-governor. The influence of the change of the speed-governor parameters on the ultra-low frequency oscillation of the system is analyzed by the average system frequency response model. Then, by changing the parameter value of the PID regulation module of the hydropower unit, the minimum damping ratio of the characteristic value corresponding to the turbine state variable is compared under different values. The PID parameters are optimized. Finally, the suppression effect of DC frequency modulation parameters on ultra-low frequency oscillation is analyzed.

articleTitle: High-Order Modulation Recognition based on Complex-valued Residual Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence technologies, deep learning methods are widely used in the field of modulation recognition of communication signals due to their superior performance. However, most real-valued deep neural networks ignore the phase-related features in the complex signals, resulting in poor performance in higher-order modulation recognition. To address the above problems, we propose a higher-order modulation recognition method based on complex-valued residual network (CV-ResNet). The network can directly extract the amplitude-related features and phase-related features in the complex signals, so it can better recognize the higher-order modulations which are more difficult to distinguish in the time domain. The experimental results on a public signal dataset containing 12 higher-order modulations show that, the complex-valued residual network achieves the best recognition accuracy for the higher-order modulations compared to the complex-valued convolutional neural network and the real-valued residual network. Moreover, the recognition accuracy of the complex-valued residual network continuously improves with an increase of the signal-to-noise ratios (SNRs) and tends to be stable when the SNRs exceed 18 dB.

articleTitle: AcST: Adaptive Human Motion Prediction Approach Based on Spatio-temporal Transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In response to increasing demand for accuracy and real-time applications in human pose prediction tasks, recent advancements in HMP (Human Motion Prediction) field have achieved precise short-term future pose sequence prediction and the generation of kinetically plausible sequences over longer time horizons. However, with increasing model complexity and expanding datasets sizes, generating future pose sequences in real-time remains a critical challenge for enhancing user experience. We propose a transformer-based model to generatively model pose sequences, incorporating a novel sparse Adaptive of components Spatio-temporal Transformer block (AcST). Aoc Block enables the model to adaptively adjust the complexity in the context of large-scale and complex parameters, maintaining relatively stable pose sequence generation speeds. It also addresses the issue of linear error accumulation inherent in autoregressive models, allowing for the real-time generation of accurate future predictions. Our method has been validated on benchmark datasets, demonstrating superior performance in comparison to existing approaches.

articleTitle: A Sorting Method of Retired Lead-Acid Battery For Electric Power Based on Combined Density Clustering
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The inconsistency among single-cell retired valve-regulated lead-acid (VRLA) battery for power systems is a primary challenge that restricts their echelon utilization in groups. This paper proposes a method for sorting retired battery based on a combination of density clustering techniques. Firstly, a feature vector is established by leveraging both the dynamic and static characteristics of battery performance, with criteria importance assessed through the intercriteria correlation (CRITIC) method to assign weights to the dimensions. Secondly, the density-based spatial clustering of applications with noise (DBSCAN) algorithm, optimized via the elbow method for its distance threshold, effectively filters out outliers. Finally, the density peaks clustering (DPC) algorithm is employed to generate clustering results. A sorting experiment involving 190 retired batteries utilized for electric power was conducted using this method, and comparative analysis was performed on the results to validate its effectiveness.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Route Planning Algorithm for UAV Autonomous Inspection on Insulators
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to improve the route planning efficiency of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) when inspecting insulators on power transmission lines, a new algorithm is proposed to carry out intelligent route planning for UAVs to perform patrol tasks. In the first place, a single recommended UAV hover point can be calculated by the proposed algorithm, taking into account the shooting posture, distance, height and range constraints of UAV hover points. Then, after all the recommended hover points are determined by calculations, the points can thus be connected into a set of lines to finally form an entire UAV patrol route. Compared with manually controlled UAV inspection, the efficiency of the proposed method has been greatly improved, which can be applied to large-scale inspection tasks of insulators on power transmission lines.

articleTitle: Prediction of the Groundwater Levels Based on Random Forest Regression Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Random forest regression is a widely used machine learning algorithm. In this study, random forest regression is employed to predict groundwater levels. Five influencing factors are considered: river flow, temperature, saturation deficit, precipitation, and evaporation capacity. Each factor is regarded as a feature. Twenty-four sets of data were collected: eighteen sets for training and six for testing. The groundwater levels predicted using the proposed approach agree well with the corresponding true values. The relative errors are less than 5%, which satisfies the requirements of engineering precision. A feature importance analysis is also conducted. The precipitation has the most significant influence on the groundwater levels, with a degree of more than 50%, and the saturation deficit has the least influence, less than 10%. The results of this study not only provide an effective approach for groundwater level prediction but also demonstrate the encouraging prospects of machine learning algorithms in hydrological engineering applications.

articleTitle: Intelligent Adaptive Routing Based on Multi-attribute QoS in Hybrid SDNs
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the emergence of new technologies and services, large-scale enterprise networks have strict and varied requirements for quality of service (QoS). In this paper, we design an intelligent routing switching scheme, named DIRH, to meet the diverse needs of multi-type traffic. In hybrid software defined networking (SDN) networks we use both centralized and distributed routing protocols coexist and communicate to various extents. Specifically, firstly, when a node is connected to a controller, we collect information such as delay, bandwidth, jitter, etc., and set weights to compute the link QoS. secondly, we use deep reinforcement learning (DRL) and graph neural networks (GNN) to capture the network topology and realize an efficient and adaptive routing policy. Then, when a node is disconnected from the controller, we implement distributed routing based on OLSR. The purpose is to guarantee the basic communication capability between nodes and reduce the delay caused by route discovery. We perform simulations using ONOS controller and Mininet. Extensive results show that DIRH achieves lower delay and jitter, as well as higher average throughput, compared to OLSR and DROM. As the number of nodes increases, the intelligence and effectiveness of routing can be better guaranteed.

articleTitle: Research on Robot Assembly Traceability System based on Fabric
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The nature of the blockchain technology in information traceability and tamper resistance provides great insights about the study of improving product quality and enhancing production service capacity in the equipment manufacturing field, which draws the focus of the researchers at home and abroad. This research aims to design and implement a system for information recording and assembly traceability in the process of robot assembly. The IBM Fabric is introduced as a software and the smart contracts of robot assembly subsystem and parts is configured to realize the synchronous input of information into the database and blockchain. This research designs and develops, the program, the database and the traceability system. And all functions of the system are verified. The research shows that the traceability system applying the blockchain technology in the robot manufacturing field can effectively reduce the centralization of the traceability system and improve the security of the data.

articleTitle: Temperature Time Series Prediction Using Convolutional Bidirectional LSTM Optimized by FPA
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: As global climate change intensifies, accurate temperature predictions have become increasingly important across various fields, including agriculture, meteorology, and environmental protection. This paper proposes a temperature time series prediction model that integrates a convolutional neural network (CNN) with a bidirectional long short-term memory network (BiLSTM), utilizing the flower pollination algorithm (FPA) for hyperparameter optimization. The model effectively captures bidirectional dependencies within sequence data and enhances prediction accuracy through the global optimization capabilities of the FPA algorithm. In a case study focused on temperature prediction in Beijing, the model exhibited superior prediction accuracy and faster convergence compared to traditional deep learning models. The findings offer a novel perspective on regional temperature prediction and highlight the model's potential for practical applications.

articleTitle: A comparison of in-memory databases in Java application
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The performance of an information system is composed by several attributes, including proper database selection. In this article, we compare the performance of different in-memory databases running a Java application in some software test scenarios, to identify the most suitable in-memory database for unit testing and integration testing, considering the metrics: execution time, memory allocation and usage of the central processing unit. For evaluation, four popular in memory databases were selected for this comparison: H2, HSQL, Apache Derby, and SQLite. Choosing in-memory databases was based on its widespread adoption in the Java community. Extensive performance tests and analyzes have been conducted, based on Data Manipulation Language (DML) statements, to provide insights into appropriate choosing of in-memory database on Java application. It was possible to carry out a comprehensive comparative analysis and the results obtained allowed the identification of differences in the performance of each in-memory database.

articleTitle: Research on Cloud-Fog Computing Task Scheduling Based on Classification Mining
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the Fog Computing environment, it is necessary to study the task scheduling problem of Cloud-fog in order to meet the resource requirements of task scheduling, reduce data transmission during task scheduling, and improve the throughput of Fog Computing systems. By improving and optimizing the classification mining algorithm, the classification mining algorithm is integrated into the Cloud and Fog task scheduling model, integrating the characteristics of Fog and Cloud. A Cloud-Fog fusion task scheduling model based on classification mining and CFCM task scheduling algorithm are proposed in the paper. The algorithm first schedules the corresponding tasks directly to the Fog layer or Cloud layer based on the generated classification rules, and then transfers the tasks to specific computing nodes of Cloud layers or Fog layer. Simulation experiments showed that the CFCM algorithm has better performance in reducing task execution time and average waiting time compared to similar algorithms.

articleTitle: A Grading and Scheduling Method for Internal Data Flow in a Data Center
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to achieve real-time and effective scheduling of the internal network traffic flow in data centers and ensure network service quality, this paper proposes a method for grading and regulating internal traffic flow in data centers. The traffic grading comprehensively considers the size and deadline of the flow, and calculates and updates the priority of the flow periodically, achieving a more accurate and reasonable division of traffic priority. At the same time, the optimal transmission path for the flow is calculated and selected based on two network congestion indicators: link utilization and queue length in the switch, avoiding the problem of uneven resource utilization in flow scheduling.

articleTitle: Cooperative Capture of a Faster Free-Moving Target by Multiple USVs
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The problem of cooperative capture has always been one of the research focus in cooperative systems of multiple unmanned surface vehicles (USVs). In the cooperative capture problem, effectively capturing targets whose speed are faster than USVs has been a challenge. Most research has been limited by initializing USVs around the target which restricts the application scenarios of the methods and it is difficult to maintain the encirclement of the target throughout the process, leading to the potential escape of the target. Furthermore, the existing works impose constraints on the faster target, such as limited moving area and moving direction. To address these issues, a cooperative capture strategy in this article based on the Apollonius Circle model and particle swarm optimization is proposed to obtain the optimal motion position. Simulation experiments are conducted under different initial positions, and the results demonstrate that the method proposed can successfully capture the target with good success rate while ensuring a certain level of encirclement, thereby the effectiveness and adaptability of the strategy are verified.

articleTitle: Study on the value of "wind-light-fire" bundled coal electricity delivery in large clean energy base
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Although there is widespread shortage in northwest China, it has abundant wind, light and coal resources. It is an important way to solve the contradiction between new energy and load distribution to bundle "wind and fire" power through uHV channel. With the goal of abandoning wind and light, the optimization model of "wind, light-fire" coupling pre-day is built to determine the optimal output of coal power units in the process of "wind-light-fire" baling, and then calculate the economic value and environmental value of coal power units to promote the consumption of new energy. The results show that through the "wind-light-fire" baling delivery, the power generation is reduced, the benefits of new energy delivery is increased, and the carbon dioxide emissions of coal power units are reduced.

Author Keywords: multiple time scales and rolling optimization

articleTitle: Study on the Influence of Sensor Installation on Gas Flow Measurement by Clamp-on Ultrasonic Flowmeter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The clamp-on ultrasonic flowmeter has the advantages of small, easy to carry and non-invasive direct measurement, and has a good application prospect in the field of gas flow measurement. However, in the industrial field, the measurement of the clamp-on ultrasonic flowmeter often has a large error. In order to understand and improve the accuracy and consistency of the measurement results of the clamp-on ultrasonic flowmeter, this paper studies the sensor installation of the clamp-on ultrasonic flowmeter, and quantifies the influence of the sensor spacing on the measurement results through theoretical analysis and experimental verification. The relevant research can provide reference for improving the industrial application of clamp-on ultrasonic flowmeter.

articleTitle: Based on the emerging strategic industry of Higher Vocational Colleges 5G Communication Network and vehicle control system collaborative development research with TRIZ-T90N theory
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: A new approximate control method has been proposed for the joint development of 5G communication networks between vocational schools and vehicle control systems. The initial adaptive control of an automotive clutch is a set of correction rules that can be used to correct errors. It consists of accurate linear feedback and nonlinear time compensation, which limits the order of solving complex vector equations. The purpose is to obtain the optimal classification of vehicle traffic instructions, and the simulation example ultimately proves the effectiveness of the continuous method.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-modal Data Management System for Intelligent Connected Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The development of intelligent networked vehicle technology and the testing of related algorithms require a large number of datasets as the foundation. The existing datasets are mainly collected from foreign traffic scenarios, which are significantly different from the actual road traffic environment of China. Therefore, it is particularly important to construct local datasets and data management systems. This paper describes in detail the design of multi-modal data management system for Intelligent Connected Vehicle, covering the overall architecture of systems, hardware composition, the design of software function modules, database design, and key steps for data processing. Experiments and tests verified the reliability and effectiveness of the data management system.

articleTitle: Numerical Calculation of Steel Pipe Quenching Aims to Provide Support for AI Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: To provide data support for the quenching AI model, this paper employs modeling and numerical analysis to investigate the temperature field evolution during the quenching of steel pipes. A finite element model was established, and numerical calculations were conducted, focusing on the influence of the medium temperature and film coefficient. The results indicate that the developed model can effectively simulate the quenching process of steel pipes. The region with the fastest cooling of the steel pipe is located on the outer side of the transition zone. After the quenching process, the temperature of the nodes along the radial direction gradually decreases. As the medium temperature value increases, the temperature of the steel pipe rises correspondingly, exhibiting a nearly linear relationship. Higher film coefficient values result in a more pronounced temperature drop, with the trend gradually stabilizing. The findings of this study provide theoretical and data support for the quenching AI model and algorithms, and also offer valuable references for the intelligent transformation of heat treatment processes for other metallic materials.

articleTitle: Multi modal fusion human-machine interactive nursing bed system
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The present poor experience of using unimodal brain-computer interfaces is caused by their low accuracy and poor generalization ability. In this paper, we propose a novel system (BCI-GP) that integrates head posture, eye tracking and brain-computer interface. TCN network is selected for feature extraction of BCI signals, and the accuracy of the model as well as its generalization ability is improved by multi-domain feature fusion. Eye tracking is realized based on face feature points. The EfficiNetV2 network structure is selected for head posture, while multitasking is used to convert five classifications into two and three classifications, thus improving the classification accuracy and at the same time improving the generalization ability and robustness of the model. Adaptive weight fusion is used at the decision layer to achieve the BCI-GP nursing bed control. Six experimenters participated in the on-line experiments, and the experimental results show that, under the time window of 1s, the BCI-GP average control accuracy is as high as 95.17 1.69%, and the average ITR is as high as 98.87±5.88 bit/min; compared with SSVEP-BCI unimodal and GP unimodal, the average control accuracy is improved by 13.66% and 1.46%, and the average ITR is improved by 37.2 bit/s and 5.97 bit/s; BCI-GP system is more reliable.

articleTitle: Research on the routing planning of power communication service based on particle swarm algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the development of smart grid, the scale of power and optical communication network is increasing, and the business carrying is becoming more and more diversified. At the present stage, the shortest path algorithm is mainly used for service route planning, which leads to the problem of unbalanced service importance distribution in the power optical communication network, and the high risk of the local network. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a risk balancing routing algorithm based on particle swarm algorithm. The algorithm considers the service importance distribution, takes the overall network risk degree, network bandwidth, time delay and service channel availability as constraints, and aims to realize the risk balance of power optical communication network. The subnetwork environment is selected to verify the scheme, and the research results show that the algorithm can effectively reduce the risk degree of the power optical communication network, and provide a strong guarantee for the safe operation of the power grid.

articleTitle: Application of Metasurfaces in Civil Aircraft Lighting Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: As an ultra-thin electromagnetic artificial device that can modulate the amplitude, phase, and polarization of light at the wavelength scale, metasurfaces have gradually gained widespread attention. Their compact size and wavelength selectivity can effectively bring new solutions to some problems in current civil aircraft. This article proposes a novel solution to several common problems in current aircraft, using metasurfaces as the implementation carrier and the generalized Snell's law as the theoretical basis. The solution proposed in this article has the characteristics of light weight, small size, and flexible adjustability compared to traditional optical optimized methods, which has certain innovative guidance significance for optimizing civil aircraft lighting systems.

articleTitle: Modeling of Spatial Error Transmission and Precision Design for Heavy-duty Robot for Large Parts of Ship
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This article establishes a global sensitivity evaluation index of kinematics parameter errors based on the pose error sensitivity coefficient. Firstly, an error source screening scheme is proposed to improve the accuracy of error identification. Secondly, simulation analysis was conducted on the error sensitivity of robot D-H kinematic parameters and the results showed that the angle parameters have a more sensitive impact on the end effector pose of the robot, and they amplify with the accumulation of the number of series joints, while the linkage parameters mainly affect the end position and there is no cumulative amplification. Finally, the indicator is established according to the global pose error sensitivity, and the redundant parameter error is eliminated.

articleTitle: A Multiple Intertwined Deep Learning Model for Power Grid Data Verification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In recent years, the rapid development of artificial intelligence technology represented by deep learning has profoundly changed our way of life. Among them, the use of deep learning technology to check power grid data has also attracted more and more scholars' attention. In this paper, a deep learning model based on multiple intertwined networks is proposed for power grid data verification. Firstly, multiple groups of power grid data at different times are obtained, made into historical data sets and predicted data sets, and mapped into fixed length vectors to obtain the embedded matrix corresponding to the historical data and predicted data. Then, multiple intertwined networks is used to extract the features of the embedded matrix corresponding to the historical data and the predicted data, and the vector representation corresponding to the historical data and the predicted data is obtained. Finally, the cosine similarity is used to calculate the matching score between the historical data and the predicted data, so as to realize the data verification of the power grid. The experimental results show that the proposed deep learning model based on multiple intertwined networks is effective for power grid data verification.

articleTitle: Copper Electrolytic Short Sircuit Identification Intelligent Infrared Inspection System based on Opencv
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The short circuit of the plate in the production process of copper electrolysis will bring a series of problems such as current loss and the decrease of copper production, and the manual inspection method is used to locate and deal with the plate fault. In response to the urgent need to obtain the fault location of the plate in a timely and accurate manner, the intelligent inspection trolley is used to obtain infrared images, and the OpenCV image processing algorithm is used to process and extract the feature values of the pictures and compare them with the fault characteristic values, so as to improve the accuracy of inspection and the timeliness of fault location, effectively reduce the loss of copper resources, improve the efficiency of copper electrolysis, and help copper factories transform into smart factories.

articleTitle: Research on a WebGL-based 3D Intelligent Traffic Intersection Visualization System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Road traffic is an essential part of human society; as urbanization accelerates, traffic issues increasingly become a significant bottleneck for urban development. To facilitate traffic management, leveraging the advantages of the next-generation Web 3D graphics standard WebGL, combined with the flexible interface design of the Quasar framework and the GPU hardware-accelerated 3D graphics library Three.js, a WebGL-based 3D Intelligent Traffic Intersection Visualization System has been designed. The main functions of this system include digitizing the actual road traffic system to create a virtual model resembling reality, enabling arbitrary rotation and translation of the 3D intersection model on the Web, as well as scaling the model up and down. Additionally, selecting the information display of road infrastructure serves as the main interactive design, presenting data such as fault records, traffic light timing, and violation information in a more intuitive manner.

articleTitle: Research on Identification of Cryptographic Algorithms Based on BERT Model and BPNN
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the widespread adoption of Internet technology and advancements in computer application technology, information security issues in large-scale information networks, such as power networks, have become increasingly prevalent. To address the challenges posed by extensive user privacy data introduced by IoT terminals in power networks, this study focuses on the effective identification of passwords for power network information system terminals. By integrating the random forest algorithm with two machine learning algorithms, a novel feature recognition model for grouped passwords in power information systems is proposed.
