Experimental results indicate that the proposed grouped ciphertext feature recognition model achieves the highest accuracy in image classification and recognition, followed by normal text, with the lowest accuracy for random text. Nevertheless, the model’s classification accuracy for random text also exceeds 60%. Compared to the unimproved machine learning model, classification accuracy increased by 13% to 25%. Compared with other popular ciphertext feature recognition models, the proposed model demonstrates the best key sensitivity performance, with a maximum key sensitivity value of 1.6 and a minimum value of -0.9. Consequently, it is evident that the ciphertext feature recognition model developed in this research exhibits excellent key extraction and recognition performance, which can effectively enhance the information security of power network information systems.

articleTitle: Performance Test of A Vibration Frequency Sensing System of Double Equal Strength Cantilever Beam Fiber Grating
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper mainly conducts sensitivity test experiment, linearity analysis experiment, natural frequency test experiment and lateral anti-interference test on the designed FBG vibration frequency sensor. It is found that the sensor's sensitivity is 0.0240 pm/(m·s<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup>), natural frequency is 185 Hz, and it has good linearity and lateral anti-interference. The reliability of the sensor design is verified.

articleTitle: Construction of Maritime Route Networks for USVs in Complex Waterways Based on Geometric Element Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The construction of maritime route networks is crucial for the autonomous navigation of unmanned surface vehicles (USV), as it supports global coordination among multi-USV systems in narrow and interconnected waterways, thereby avoiding path conflicts and blockages. This paper proposes a method for constructing route networks based on geometric element analysis (RN-GEA). First, we simplify the complex geometric boundaries of waterways using point and line features. Next, an analysis of these geometric elements facilitates the identification of waterway intersections, which are designated as topological nodes. Finally, connectivity relationships between the nodes are established to create a global route network for complex waterways. By accurately characterizing the intersections of waterways, USV can select different routes at intersections, effectively alleviating path conflicts and blockage issues. The simulation results from specific areas of Qiandao Lake indicate that the route networks based on geometric element analysis (RN-GEA) can effectively construct maritime route networks in complex waterway conditions, offering support for the scheduling and management of multi-USV systems.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Jiangxi's New Integrated Clearing System for Power Trading Based on New Fuzzy Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the advancement of the construction of the electricity spot market, there is an urgent need to develop a market clearing mechanism and an integrated clearing system that adapts to the integration of spot trading and key technologies; A research team has developed a new type of electricity trading clearing system that meets the clearing requirements of the Jiangxi market. This article constructs a comprehensive evaluation system for the clearing system and uses an improved new fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method to conduct a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation of the system, indicating that the clearing system has great potential for application and development.

articleTitle: Tomato leaf diseases recognition model based on improved MobileVit
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that convolutional neural network is not effective in classifying tomato leaf diseases, a novel method for tomato leaf diseases recognition based on improved MobileViT network was proposed. Firstly, the Squeeze and Excitation module is used to optimize the local and global feature fusion. Secondly, the Global Attention Mechanism (GAM) is introduced after Layer1 and Layer2 of the model to enhance feature representation by capturing global context information, thus improving the expressiveness and robustness of the model. Finally, the ReLU6 activation function is replaced by Mish activation function, which further improves the accuracy of the model. The experimental results show that the improved MobileViT model can well recognize tomato leaf diseases, with an average recognition accuracy of 88.86%, 4.28 percentage points higher than that of the original model. Compared with other convolutional neural network models, the recognition accuracy is higher.

articleTitle: Simulation analysis of energy consumption sensitivity of typical electric vehicles in actual traffic scenarios
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In response to the significant impact of actual traffic scenarios on vehicle energy consumption, this paper proposes a vehicle energy consumption simulation method based on online map operating conditions. An operating condition construction algorithm is designed to construct the online map information into a simulation operating condition, and a simulation model is built. The temperature, road, weather and other information of the map are introduced into the simulation model to correct the rolling resistance, wind resistance, efficiency and other factors of the vehicle. The model is used to continuously analyze typical routes in a city for a long period of time, analyze the degree of influence of scene factors such as temperature, travel time, and average speed on vehicle energy consumption, and provide a basis for optimizing the actual operating condition energy consumption of the vehicle.

articleTitle: The Design of an Indoor Non-Line-of-Sight Wireless Optical Communication System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Wireless optical communication (WOC) technology represents a cutting-edge form of wireless communication. Nevertheless, conventional WOC technologies typically require line-of-sight (LOS) conditions, necessitating precise alignment between the transmitter and receiver, and these systems can be easily disrupted by physical obstructions. To overcome these limitations, this paper leverages the diffuse reflection properties of light off indoor surfaces to develop a novel WOC system. The proposed system consists of a transmitter, an LED array, a receiver, and the wireless channel. It employs Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) for data transmission and incorporates a carrier frequency of 100 kHz to minimize interference from ambient light sources. Experimental results demonstrate that, within a room of dimensions 5m × 5m × 3m, non-line-of-sight (NLOS) communication can achieve a bit error rate (BER) below 3×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−4</sup> when the distance between the receiver and transmitter is less than 2 meters. This finding highlights the potential of the proposed system to provide robust and reliable communication in indoor environments without the stringent requirement for direct line-of-sight.

articleTitle: Spatio-Temporal Multi-Embedded Attention Aware Transformer for Traffic Flow Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Traffic flow prediction is a crucial component of intelligent transportation systems, where accurate prediction facilitates traffic management and improves efficiency. Currently, there are numerous challenges in predicting traffic flow, such as heterogeneity and sudden fluctuations. With the advancement of research, more methods have been applied to traffic flow prediction, such as graph learning models and Transformer models. In particular, models based on the Transformer architecture have garnered widespread attention due to their unique attention mechanisms and outstanding performance across various domains. This paper proposes a Transformer model that performs temporal encoding at different time granularities, followed by temporal attention computation to capture time feature dependencies across different time spans. Additionally, a spatial attention layer is introduced to capture dependencies between road nodes. The proposed method is validated using real-world traffic datasets, and experimental results demonstrate that our model achieves superior performance.

articleTitle: Style Transfer Based on Discrete Space Modeling
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper is dedicated to exploring headline style transfer techniques, with the core objective of enhancing the appeal of headlines while preserving their semantics. A significant challenge is the lack of parallel training datasets. To address this issue, we propose an unsupervised headline style transfer model called the Discrete Headline Generation (DHG) model. This model decomposes the process of generating text with specific styles into two key steps: content feature extraction and style modeling. Two text encoders separately extract the content information and style information from the input text, while a text decoder integrates the knowledge from both encoders to generate content with a specific style.Given that style signals are more abstract compared to textual content, we propose constructing the style representation space as a discrete space, where each discrete point corresponds to a specific style category. Experimental results demonstrate that the DHG model exhibits state-of-the-art performance in comprehensive evaluations.

articleTitle: Operation Optimization of Micro-Grid with Electro-Thermal Combined System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the current environment of rapid development of energy Internet and increasingly close connection between electricity and heat, an operation optimization model of regional grid-connected microgrid based on joint dispatching of electricity and heat is proposed. Considering the characteristics of energy storage in the network, time-of-use electricity price, electric heating load and the timing characteristics of distributed power supply, the grid-connected microgrid including wind turbine, photovoltaic cell, cogeneration system, electric boiler, fuel cell and energy storage system is taken as an example. The simulation example shows that the model can provide reference for energy interconnection and planning operation between electricity and heat.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Energy Data Multi-party Privacy Query Scheme Based on Privacy Information Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the development of energy Internet, the privacy protection of energy data has become an important issue. In this paper a multi-party privacy query scheme for energy data based on privacy information retrieval (PIR) technology is proposed, aiming at solving the privacy leakage problem in the process of energy data sharing. By analyzing the current demand of energy data privacy protection, a complete business process is designed in this paper, including data collection, preprocessing, analysis model construction and output. For different privacy requirements, this paper discusses three PIR schemes based on oblivious transfer (OT), homomorphic encryption and keyword PIR, and compares their technical characteristics, communication overhead and computational overhead. Simulation experiments verify the feasibility of the proposed scheme. The results show that the proposed scheme can effectively protect query privacy. The research in this paper provides technical support for the sustainable development of new power systems and is of great significance to promote the safe sharing of energy data.

articleTitle: Locally Linear Embedding Based on Gannet Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The analysis and feature extraction of high-dimensional data can help people solve various problems in current industry applications, and manifold learning is a type of data dimensionality reduction method developed based on the concept of topological manifolds. Locally linear embedding (LLE) algorithm, as a classic manifold learning algorithm, has attracted much attention due to its low computational complexity and strong scalability. However, the objective function of LLE algorithm may contain absolute value terms and cannot be guaranteed to be convex. Traditional derivative dependent solving methods are difficult to obtain its optimal solution, making it impossible to achieve effective feature extraction of data. In this paper, an LLE based on gannet optimization algorithm (GOA) has been proposed, and it is supposed to be used as a derivative-free optimization method to effectively solve the problems of non-differentiable of non-convex objective function, premature convergence, and easy to fall into local optimum in the process of solving the objective function of LLE.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on the Intensity Scintillation Effect of Partially Coherent Light Transmission in Atmospheric Turbulence
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In this article, the scintillation effect of laser beams with different initial coherence in the atmosphere is studied, and the expression of scintillation factor of partially coherent beams in the Gaussian Schell beam model is given. We designed and produced a multi parameter high-precision controllable laser source to generate partially coherent laser beams, and used a reproducible atmospheric turbulence simulation device to simulate atmospheric turbulence. On this basis, experimental research was conducted on the intensity scintillation effect of laser beams with different coherence lengths transmitted in atmospheric turbulence. The results indicate that as turbulence weakens (i.e. the atmospheric coherence length increases), the intensity scintillation effect caused by it on laser beams of different coherence lengths shows a decreasing trend. In addition, as the coherence length of the beam decreases, it is less affected by atmospheric turbulence (i.e. its intensity scintillation factor decreases). For a laser beam with a coherence length of 3mm, its scintillation factor is about 0.038 when the atmospheric coherence length is 5cm, while the fully coherent light has reached more than 0.16, with a difference of more than 4 times. Compared with the fully coherent beam, the partially coherent beam is not only smaller than the fully coherent beam in terms of the scintillation factor, but also the intensity fluctuation of its scintillation is smaller than that of the fully coherent beam.

articleTitle: Detection-Tracking Guided Video Instance Matting
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Video matting and video instance segmentation cannot distinguish alpha mattes in a scenario featuring multiple instances. We propose a video instance matting method guided by detection and tracking combined with YOLOv8 and DeepSort.Then, we incorporate the Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) to enhance attention distribution in the channel and spatial dimensions. It enables accurate tracking of multiple instances, then integrated with a GhostNet-based semantic matting model to obtain matting results for multiple instances in the video. Experiments conducted on the VIM-NEW dataset demonstrate that the proposed algorithm effectively addresses occlusion issues among multiple targets, achieves high matting accuracy, and reduces the model's parameter size.

articleTitle: Research on Deep Learning-Based Liver Tumor Image Segmentation Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Early detection and accurate diagnosis of liver tumors are crucial for patient prognosis. In recent years, deep learning techniques have made significant advancements in the field of medical image processing, particularly in liver tumor image segmentation. This paper reviews the latest research progress on deep learning-based liver tumor image segmentation techniques, focusing on the application of various deep learning models, including Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), U-Net, and its variants. By comparing the performance and efficiency of different methods, the advantages and disadvantages of each model in liver tumor segmentation tasks are discussed. Additionally, this paper proposes a new data preprocessing method called Color Preprocessing (CP), which effectively improves the segmentation accuracy of processed data under the same methods. Finally, future research directions are envisioned, highlighting the importance of deep learning technologies in improving the accuracy of liver tumor image segmentation and their potential clinical applications.

articleTitle: Development of local terminal unit applied to the intelligent reconstruction of GIS control cabinet
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This article focuses on the problem of complex electrical interlocking circuit loop connections, large space occupied by relays, inconvenient installation and maintenance, and poor system flexibility in GIS control cabinet. A local terminal unit is developed, which integrates interlocking, measurement and control, intelligent terminals, merging units, and online monitoring functions. Hardware and software systems have been designed in this paper. It can optimize the interlocking circuit, elements, and secondary circuit loop, save the investment, and improves the reliability and digitization of the entire secondary circuit loop, so that can be promoted and applied in the GIS control cabinet intelligent reconstruction.

articleTitle: Research on text analysis of consumer reviews in the catering industry based on the BTM model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The catering industry, which plays a crucial role in China’s economy, is currently facing intense market competition and growth challenges. This study aims to explore the trends in consumer review texts within the Chinese catering sector and their influence on consumption decisions. Utilizing Python technology, we collected a substantial amount of user review data from the Dianping, Meituan, and Ele.me platforms. Employing the Bi-term Topic Model (BTM), we conducted a thorough topic mining and analysis of these comments, identifying five primary topics: taste quality, delivery speed, price concessions, service quality, and hygienic environment. These themes encapsulate the core concerns of consumers when selecting foodservice options. Further analysis indicates that these topics significantly influence consumers' purchasing decisions. The research findings not only offer catering operators targeted strategies for enhancing sales and service quality, but also provide a fresh perspective on understanding consumer behavior and optimizing the customer experience.

articleTitle: The Influence of Vertical Interference Source on Electromagnetic Scattering Characteristics of X-band Cylinder
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Multiple radiation sources irradiate the target in a complex electromagnetic environment, and its electromagnetic scattering characteristics are complicated. The electromagnetic scattering characteristics of objects are usually studied for the attributes of a single incident wave, and the influence of interference sources on the electromagnetic scattering characteristics of objects is rarely considered. Considering the interference source, the electromagnetic scattering characteristics of metal cylinders are studied from the angle and phase difference of the electromagnetic wave radiated by radar and interference source. The influence of the phase of the X-band interference source on the electromagnetic scattering characteristics of the target is calculated and obtained when the interference source is incident perpendicular to the side of the cylinder. The variation of the surface scattering characteristics in the vertical side direction of the cylinder is considered when the interference source is incident perpendicular to the top surface. The calculation results show that the forward scattering characteristics of the cylinder are apparent when the interference source irradiates the vertical side or the bottom side. It has little influence on the electromagnetic scattering characteristics of the cylinder side vertical plane and other directions without interference. The phase of the electromagnetic wave of the interference source and the radar radiation source also has a weak influence on the electromagnetic scattering characteristics of the target.

articleTitle: A High Performance Hardware Implementation of SHA-256 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: SHA-256 is a well-reported algorithm extensively utilized in security applications. This paper presents a high performance hardware implementation of SHA-256 algorithm. The SHA-256 algorithm is reconstructed based on 64-level high-speed full pipeline computing architecture design to improve the algorithm throughput. In addition, the timing path of the compression function of SHA-256 is optimized to break the critical path, which increase the operating frequency of SHA-256 and further improve the throughput. Finally, Carry-Save Adder (CSA) technology is employed in the message expansion to further improve the timing and related parameters. The proposed architecture of SHA-256 is implemented on Xilinx Virtex-7 FPGA device, and the experimental results indicate that the designed SHA-256 demonstrates a frequency of 429 MHz, a throughput of 219.65 Gbps, and an efficiency of 24.84 Mbps/slice.

articleTitle: A Real-time Sparse Semantic Segmentation Approach for Event-based Vision Sensors
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Event-based vision sensors are biomimetic devices designed to capture data asynchronously, discretely, and sparsely, thereby providing high temporal resolution. Because we need cumulative time to transform event data into frame images to adapt image-based semantic segmentation methods, these methods waste the high temporal resolution properties of the event data and affect the real-time performance of the semantic segmentation task. This work explores a sparse semantic segmentation approach for event data as the only input to address these issues. Firstly, the event stream is denoised by the proposed outlier degree approach. Besides, we characterize the event stream as a four-dimensional event cloud and enhance the SA layer of the PointNet++ network to bolster the geometric feature extraction, attaining a novel 92.2% F1 Score on the DVS-OUTLAB dataset.

articleTitle: Research on the Prediction Model of Cracking Furnace Outlet Temperature Based on CNN-LSTM-Attention
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The cracking temperature of the ethylene cracking furnace affects the ethylene yield and has a significant impact on the economic benefits of the cracking furnace. At the same time, the cracking furnace temperature has a great influence on the safe operation of the cracking furnace. Based on the operational data of the cracking furnace process, this article proposes a CNN-LSTM Attention based prediction model for the outlet temperature of an ethylene cracking furnace. Firstly, dynamic features of the data were extracted using convolutional neural networks (CNN). Then, a long short-term memory (LSTM) network was used to learn and train the extracted features. Finally, an attention mechanism was used to allocate different weights to the LSTM hidden layer, predict the outlet temperature of the ethylene cracking furnace, and compare the actual data. The results showed that the average absolute error (MAPE), root mean square error (RMSE), and coefficient of determination (R2) of the CNN-LSTM Attention model were 0.0044, 4.8895, and 0.9846, respectively, Meet the prediction accuracy requirements, with higher prediction accuracy compared to LSTM models. This further proves the rationality of the model prediction and can provide reference for the outlet temperature of the ethylene cracking furnace.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Effect of Consumer Confusion on Online Conformity Consumption in E-commerce
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In e-commerce, consumers often become confused when faced with massive, similar, and vague information, resulting in shopping delays, giving up, or following the crowd for consumption. What is the impact mechanism of online consumer confusion on their conformity consumption? Conducting in-depth research on it undoubtedly has important theoretical significance and practical value. On the basis of reviewing relevant literature on consumer confusion, cognitive dissonance, and conformity consumption, this study constructs a research model and proposes research hypotheses. Then, data was collected through a questionnaire survey and analyzed for reliability and validity using SPSS software. Model validation and hypothesis testing were conducted using LISREL structural equation modeling software. The research results indicate that consumer overload confusion has a significant positive impact on their cognitive dissonance, which in turn leads to their conformist consumption behavior. However, the impact of consumers' similarity confusion and ambiguity confusion on their cognitive dissonance is not significant. Interestingly, further analysis of moderating effects found that, compared to males, the impact of female consumers’ similarity confusion and ambiguity confusion on cognitive dissonance is relatively weak. This significant gender difference partially explains the insignificant impact of similarity confusion and ambiguity confusion on cognitive dissonance mentioned above. These research results contain rich theoretical and practical implications.

articleTitle: Big Data and AI in Financial Risk Assessment: The New Scorecard Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper presents a framework for assessing financial risk across industries by integrating rule-based modeling, the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP), and artificial intelligence (AI) techniques. The framework utilizes diverse data sources, including financial, tax, and judicial records, as well as financial reports from listed companies, to improve enterprise credit assessments.The process begins with data preparation, which involves collecting and preprocessing data to ensure its quality and consistency. A rule-based preprocessing algorithm is developed to standardize the data for scoring. In the second phase, scoring is done using rule-based modeling informed by expert advice and AHP, which prioritizes and weights factors impacting industrial risk. This generates a customized scorecard for each industry. The third phase focuses on training AI models on the dataset. These models automatically learn to assign weights to indicators and generate industry scores by identifying complex patterns between the data and industry performance. The framework concludes with cross-validation to confirm the accuracy and reliability of the results. This approach provides insights into industry-wide scoring, supports continuous monitoring of industry performance, and enhances financial risk management decision-making. The proposed framework offers a robust and reliable tool for assessing financial risk across various industries.

articleTitle: Intelligent ADHD Detection Using Explainable Multimodal Fusion Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Deep learning has been proved to diagnose Attention Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) accurately, but it has raised concerns about trustworthiness because of the lack of explainability. Fortunately, the development of explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) offers a solution to this problem. In this study, we employed a VR-based GO/NOGO task with distractions, capturing participants' eye movement, head movement, and electroencephalography (EEG) data. We used the collected data to train an explainable multimodal fusion model. Besides classifying between ADHD and normal children, the proposed model also generates explanation heatmaps. The heatmaps provide the importance of specific variables and timestamps in the EEG data to help us analyze the patterns captured by the model. According to our observations, the model identified specific time intervals that related to specific event-related potentials (ERPs) components. The heatmaps also demonstrate that the impacts of distractions vary between not only the GO and NOGO events but also ADHD and normal children.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Digital Archive Management Based on Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, digital archives management has become an important direction in the field of archives management. However, the traditional digital archives management systems primarily rely on manual entry and simple database query methods, which are difficult to meet the needs of efficient management and intelligent application of archives information in the era of big data. Based on this, this paper explores the core technologies of intelligent digital archives management, summarizes the application effects of knowledge graphs in digital archives management, and proposes the design and implementation methods of intelligent digital archives systems based on knowledge graphs, aiming to enhance the efficiency and intelligence level of digital archives management, achieve the intelligent transformation of archives management, and provide innovative solutions and technical support for archives management in the era of big data.

articleTitle: Research on Security Risk Analysis and Sensitive Data Identification in Electricity Data Sharing and Distribution
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper addresses the problems of unclear power data sharing and distribution scenarios, data sharing and distribution scope, and data sharing and distribution content, based on the company's business needs, firstly, it studies the data sharing and distribution scenarios and processes, then it analyses the management and technical security risks corresponding to the data sharing and distribution scenarios, and finally, based on the data sharing and distribution scenarios, it proposes data sharing and distribution scenarios oriented protection strategies based on the analysis of the security risks.

articleTitle: Secure Data Disposal Algorithm for Edge Computing-Enhanced Cloud Platforms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: To address the issue of reduced data transmission efficiency in cloud platforms due to microservice failures, this paper proposes a data transmission algorithm based on edge computing. Initially, data cleaning, deduplication, and anonymization preprocessing are performed at edge nodes to reduce the volume of transmitted data and protect privacy. A secure data transmission mechanism is then implemented using SSL/TLS protocols to ensure data integrity and security throughout the transmission process. Furthermore, a rapid fault recovery mechanism is designed to enable prompt restoration of data and services on the cloud platform in the event of edge node failures, ensuring high availability of the platform. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method significantly improves data processing and transmission efficiency, reduces system response latency, and enhances the stability and reliability of the cloud platform.

Index Terms: Difference In The Number Of Participants

articleTitle: Research on GMM-Based Approach Pattern Recognition and Quantitative Analysis Algorithm for Flight in Airport Terminal Areas
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the rapid growth in demand for air transportation, the efficiency evaluation of aircraft approaches in airport terminal areas has become an increasingly critical focus. This study aims to develop an efficiency evaluation algorithm for aircraft approaches in airport terminal areas based on flight big data. Initially, the study constructs a multidimensional evaluation index system that includes fuel efficiency, time efficiency, and distance efficiency using Quick Access Recorder (QAR) data. Based on this index system, a detailed analysis of Boeing 777 flights at three typical international airports—Beijing Capital, Guangzhou Baiyun, and London Heathrow—is conducted. Subsequently, a hierarchical evaluation model and a quantitative scoring algorithm based on the Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) are innovatively proposed. This method demonstrates advantages in capturing the diversity and complexity of aircraft approach patterns and has been validated with approach phase data for Boeing 737 flights at several international and domestic airports. The findings reveal that, despite having a higher overall fuel consumption, Heathrow Airport exhibits higher efficiency in descent profile management in the Boeing 777 analysis. In contrast, Beijing Capital Airport, with lower total fuel consumption, shows room for optimization in its descent profile due to longer level flight phases. The application of the GMM model further confirms this finding and provides a quantitative basis for evaluating efficiency across different airports. This study offers new perspectives and methodologies for evaluating and optimizing operational efficiency in airport terminal areas, with significant practical implications for improving air traffic management.

articleTitle: Large Energy Base Multi-objective Planning Optimization Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Under the previous development situation of the large energy base, it is necessary to take into account the economic, high efficiency, environmental protection and reliability operation of the system, and optimize the provisioning capacity allocation of the Large energy base. It can help to improve the economic performance of system operation during the life cycle, maximize the benefits of each type of equipment, and achieve the goal benefits of multiple goals. For this reason, this paper aims to construct an optimization model of integrated energy system planning on the supply side. The planning optimization method of wind-light-fire reservoir combined system is proposed first. Secondly, from the two aspects of the cost and the economic benefits of the wind-light-fire storage combined system, the economic benefits of the system are analyzed, and the absorption capacity of the new energy source is explored, and the concept of the combined benefit rate of the new energy source is introduced. Construct a new energy source energy dissipation physical model; Finally, the optimization model of system planning is constructed by considering the related factors and taking economic benefits and new energy sources as the optimization objective. The method of particle subgroup is chosen as the model solving method, and the planning optimization process of wind-light-fire storage system is designed.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-time Scale Optimal Operation Strategy of Customer-side Integrated Energy System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the traditional power demand response, users can help the power system to complete peak and frequency modulation while reducing their own electricity costs by means of reduction and translation. For the customer-side integrated energy system (CIES), the load demand of users becomes diversified, and scientific and reasonable optimal operation strategy is particularly critical. Based on the constructed CIES internal equipment model and the static and dynamic characteristics of its flexible resources, this paper proposes an optimal operation strategy for participating in the demand side response of the power grid at multiple time scales. A day-ahead and intra-day two-stage optimal scheduling model is constructed, and an example is used to verify the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Acceleration of Sparse Matrix Solution Based on GLU
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Optimal Power Flow (OPF) is an important analytical tool that considers both the safety and economy of the power system. Developing an efficient and accurate optimal power flow calculation scheme has become an important research topic in order to meet the demand for computing speed in real-time scenarios such as power system regulation and operation. In recent years, GPUs have become a research hotspot in high-performance computing due to their advantages in floating-point computing speed and storage bandwidth. They have also been successfully applied in the field of power systems, making larger scale and more efficient power system analysis and computing applications possible. This article optimizes the GPU based sparse matrix solver GLU to improve its speed in solving sparse matrices. Our contributions are as follows: 1) We optimized the symbol decomposition method in GLU and determined the symbol pattern of each column by depth first searching for non-zero data in each column, significantly improving the symbol decomposition speed of GLU; 2) We have utilized a large number of threads for parallel execution, improving the process of reassembling non-zero data in matrices based on GLU symbol decomposition, and accelerating the speed of data reassembly; 3) We have validated the effectiveness of our proposed optimization method on multiple publicly available power flow calculation data. The experimental results show that the proposed improvement method can significantly improve the speed of GLU solving.

articleTitle: Traffic Flow Detection Based on Improved YOLOv5 and DeepSORT
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) are vital for managing traffic in high-flow areas like high-ways and city centers. Our approach to ITS involves real-time road monitoring using cameras and periodic video saving, followed by object detection and tracking with an improved YOLOv5 and DeepSORT algorithm. This combination provides high precision in traffic flow detection, essential for effective traffic management. The YOLOv5 algorithm is renowned for its speed and accuracy in object detection, while DeepSORT excels in tracking objects over time, even when they temporarily disappear from view. Our enhancements to YOLOv5 focus on its suitability for real-time traffic monitoring, ensuring high precision without excessive computational demands. Our experiments on the UA-DETRAC dataset, which offers a realistic and challenging environment, demonstrated a 70.1% mean Average Precision(mAP) at a 50% Intersection over Union(IoU) threshold. This achievement highlights the effectiveness of our algorithm in real-time object detection. The lightweight design of our algorithm is crucial, as it allows for deployment across various devices without compromising performance. This is particularly important for real-time applications, where quick data processing and analysis are necessary for timely insights. The high precision of our traffic flow detection algorithm is a significant advantage, providing valuable data for traffic management decisions. It can aid in adjusting traffic signals, implementing congestion pricing, or deploying emergency services in response to accidents. In summary, our algorithm represents a significant advancement in ITS, offering a high-precision, real-time, and light-weight solution for traffic flow detection. Its successful application on the UA-DETRAC dataset shows its potential for real-world deployment, making it a promising tool for enhancing traffic efficiency and safety in urban environments. As traffic demands grow, the integration of such intelligent systems will be key to shaping the future of transportation.

articleTitle: Object Detection Algorithm for Power Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With extensive research in the field of deep learning, significant progress has been made in object detection. As a result, they have been applied in the power industry, such as identifying violations by workers, re identifying worker identities, detecting equipment defects and environmental hazards, and tracking personnel movement trajectories. With the rapid development of technology, an increasing number of edge embedded devices are being deployed in the power sector to efficiently perform data collection and processing tasks. However, these devices generally face challenges of limited computing resources and insufficient storage capacity. Due to the large parameters, computationally intensive nature, and high memory usage of most neural network models, their direct deployment on edge devices is severely constrained, hindering the widespread adoption of the technology in practical applications. This article proposes a drone detection algorithm based on YOLOv8. We (1) combine attention mechanisms to help the network focus on key regions and features, thereby improving performance with minimal additional computation; (2) Redesign the neck of the network based on data features to improve accuracy while maintaining the lightweight nature of the model. Our model can be effectively deployed on resource constrained embedded devices, providing robust detection results.

articleTitle: Research on Credit Evaluation Model of Railway Supervision Enterprises Based on Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation Method
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: To address issues such as an imperfect indicator system, difficulty in determining indicator weights, and the inability of credit ratings to reflect the true credit levels of railway supervision enterprises, this study constructs an evaluation indicator system based on three main factors affecting the credit levels of supervision enterprises: corporate quality, supervision management, and reward-penalty records. Both subjective and objective factors are considered, and a combined weighting method using the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) and Entropy Method is employed to determine the weights of evaluation indicators. Based on the Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation, the credit scores of enterprises are calculated. Additionally, Grey Relational Analysis (GRA) is used to determine the membership degree of evaluation indicators for credit ratings, thereby forming a credit evaluation model for railway supervision enterprises. To validate the effectiveness of the model, the credit scores of railway supervision enterprises are calculated based on actual data, demonstrating that the proposed model can provide a reasonable evaluation of the credit levels of railway supervision enterprises.

articleTitle: Balancing Accuracy and Beyond-Accuracy Indicators in Course Recommendation through Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: It is crucial to balance accuracy and beyond-accuracy indicators in recommendations through multi-objective optimization (MOO) methods. Existing multi-objective recommendation methods have several issues: they cannot dynamically model users' long-term and short-term preferences; they fail to solve non-convex problems and are prone to getting stuck in local optima; they neglect the issues of diversity and novelty in recommendations, etc. Therefore, this paper proposes using multi-objective reinforcement learning (MORL) to address the trade-off between accuracy, diversity, and novelty in course recommendation. First, dynamic modeling of users' long-term and short-term interest preferences is conducted using user feature information, course feature information, and users' historical course features. Second, the Actor-Critic network is applied to course recommendation, and a multi-layer reward function and Q-value function are introduced to learn multiple objectives simultaneously. Diversity and novelty assessment indicators are also added to measure the effectiveness of course recommendations Finally, experiments are conducted on three real MOOC datasets, proving the superior performance of the proposed course recommendation model in dynamically modeling user preferences and balancing accuracy and non-accuracy aspects.

articleTitle: Discrete Emotions Detection on Social Media: A Systematic Review and Comparative Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Despite a growing corpus of work delving into social media communication, gauging discrete emotions on such sites remains challenging, especially for researchers with constrained computational expertise. By synthesizing insights from nearly 2,000 studies, we seek to address this gap through an extensive review and comparative analysis that pinpoints the most prevalent and user-friendly tools for emotional detection and verifies their effectiveness against a validated human-annotated benchmark. While each identified tool captures a spectrum of affective expressions in line with established psychological frameworks, considerable disparity emerges when examining their efficacy. Lexicon-based approaches, such as NRC EmoLex and Text2Emotion, though frequently utilized in the reviewed studies, yield merely adequate precision, with LIWC-22 providing a marginally enhanced outcome. IBM NLU, however, leveraging advanced deep learning techniques, demonstrates superior performance across both sentimental and nuanced emotional assessments. ChatGPT-4, notably, unlike some studies praising its extensive applicability, may falter in this context, particularly noted for its reduced recall. Amid the rapid advancements in social media communication, such findings may provide a foundational exploration for discerning discrete emotions online, paving the way for the development of refined navigational tools in the complex emotional landscape of the digital realm.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies of Remote Capacity Verification System for Communication Batteries
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: For the application of communication power supply system, firstly, a design scheme of an autonomous and controllable remote battery capacity verification device is proposed, which has the functions of reliable starting, intelligent analysis, and business communication security encryption; Secondly, design a battery online monitoring and protection unit that integrates the measurement of battery cell characterization parameters and emergency protection for circuit breakers, while providing charging and discharging balance applications; Finally, based on the requirements of online nuclear capacity charging and discharging process, a multi-dimensional intelligent control mechanism for the health status of battery packs is established to achieve collaborative estimation of the State of Charge (SOC) and State of Health (SOH) of battery packs. Through 100 nuclear capacity tests and analysis, it was found that compared to traditional strategies, multi-dimensional intelligent control solutions can delay the decay of the available charge capacity of battery packs. The average internal resistance of battery packs only increases by 10%, and the average voltage deviation at the float charging end is reduced by 0.13V.

articleTitle: Homomorphic Encryption based stem cell assay data sharing study
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the rapid development of the biomedical field, stem cell therapy has received widespread attention as an innovative therapy with great potential. However, privacy protection and secure sharing of stem cell testing data are still major challenges. In this paper, we propose a homomorphic encryption-based data sharing scheme for stem cell testing, which achieves efficient and secure data sharing with data privacy by designing a system architecture covering data acquisition, encryption, transmission, decryption and analysis. Experimental results show that the scheme can not only effectively protect data privacy, but also support efficient data processing with less impact on system performance. The main contributions of this paper include designing and implementing a stem cell detection data sharing system based on homomorphic encryption, proposing a homomorphic encryption algorithm optimised for the high-dimensional characteristics of stem cell data, and experimentally verifying the security and effectiveness of the system. Future research directions include optimising homomorphic encryption algorithms, expanding application scenarios, integrating multiple privacy protection techniques, and optimising system performance.

articleTitle: Research on Global Performance Evaluation Method for Metering Devices Based on Customer Load Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the context of power systems, the daily load curve from substations serves as a tool for classifying and synthesizing load characteristics. The typical daily load curve data, after being acquired and processed by the SCADA system, forms the foundation for load classification studies. To tackle the issue of original curve pattern overlapping, a signal processing technique grounded in Variational Mode Decomposition has been introduced. Additionally, addressing the specific challenge of feature weighting in the Euclidean distance within the Fuzzy C-Means clustering algorithm, a feature-weighted fuzzy clustering approach was employed to develop a feature-weighted VMD-FCM clustering algorithm. Demonstrations reveal that the VMD algorithm can efficiently break down the inherent modes of signals, enhancing both the convergence rate and clustering precision of the FCM function; the introduction of a weight factor based on Euclidean distance boosts the practicality and accuracy of the FCM algorithm. The findings indicate that this enhanced method can effectively differentiate between various load categories, offering guidance for load forecasting, setting pricing criteria, and influencing marketing strategies.

articleTitle: A high precision resolution network MGS-HigherHRnet for human pose estimation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Bottom-up human pose estimation models perform well in complex scenarios, but such models are complex and computationally expensive. To address the above problems, this paper proposes a bottom-up human pose estimation network model MGS-HigherHRnet based on HigherHRnet. The MGS-HigherHRnet was transformed from the HigherHRnet. The standard convolution unit in Bottleneck module and Basicblock module of the HighrtHRnet model was replaced by MBConv unit and GhostConv unit, respectively. After the replacement of Bottleneck module and Basicblock module, they were called MGSneck moudule and MGSblock module respectively in this paper. Furthermore, the SE attention mechanism unit has been added to both MGSneck module and MGSblock module. This replacement utilized of the high efficiency of the Ghost convolution unit in generating redundant features. It also leveraged the low computational effort of the MBConv depth-separable convolutions. Additionally, feature extraction was enhanced by the SE attention mechanism. As a result, it effectively reduced the computational complexity while maintaining the overall prediction performance of the model. The model in this paper was validated on the COCO dataset. The experimental results showed that, compared to HigherHRNet, the MGS HigherHRnet network model not only reduced computational complexity slightly, but also effectively improves prediction accuracy. The parameter count of MGS-HigherHRnet is basically the same as that of HigherHRnet. The computational cost of MGS-HigherHRnet is reduced by 14.8%. The prediction accuracy of key points has improved by 1.9 pp. Especially, the prediction accuracy of key points in large scale persons improved by 3.9 pp.

articleTitle: Integrated High-gain Feedback Control and Deep Reinforcement Learning Control of a Flexible Link With End-effector
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Achieving precise trajectory tracking control of the end-effector of the flexible link is challenging due to the complexity of its dynamic equations. To address this challenge, this paper proposes a hybrid control method that combines a high-gain feedback control (HGFC) algorithm based on Lagrangian dynamics equations with a deep reinforcement learning algorithm based on Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) to form the HGFC-SAC framework. The HGFC-SAC method aims to track the reference trajectory of the end-effector accurately without perceiving its own flexible deformations while suppressing the vibration issues caused by its flexibility. Simulation results show that, compared with the HGFC and SAC methods, the HGFC-SAC method has better control performances in terms of trajectory tracking and vibration suppression.

articleTitle: Research On Key Technologies For Power Outage Reporting In The Electricity Information Acquisition System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The timely reporting of outage information and the identification of power outage subjects for electricity users and station area are the key to power grid operation and maintenance. This paper analyzes the shortcomings for the generation mechanism of the existing electric energy meter and the acquisition terminal power outage event and proposes an optimization strategy to solve the problem of false alarm about power outage event caused by grid switching and voltage shaking. At the same time, an optimization strategy based on four-level filtering and two- level response mechanism was proposed for the electric energy meter’s power outage events reporting which solved the frequent reporting of electric energy meter power outages. In addition, the optimization strategy is proposed from two aspects: abnormal self-monitoring of the acquisition terminal program and battery operation monitoring, which solves the problems of repeated reporting about power outage events due to abnormal programs and omissions and non-reporting the power outage event caused by insufficient battery capacity, and realizes the stability and reliability of the power outage and power recovery events reported by the acquisition terminal. Finally, this paper proposes a five-level power outage judgment strategy for the master station to accurately locate the scope of fault power outage and provide guidance for timely investigation of fault power outage.

Author Keywords: four-level filtering and two-level response mechanism

articleTitle: Small Sample Image Classification Based on Lightweight Inverted Residual Network Hybrid Prototypical Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Small sample image classification is an important issue in the field of computer vision, and it has a wide application prospect in resource-limited edge devices. Therefore, this paper proposes a hybrid model based on lightweight inverted residual network and ProtoNet to realize efficient small sample image classification. First, we design a lightweight inverted residual network as a feature extractor. By using optimization techniques such as point-by-point convolution and depth separable convolution, the complexity and computation of the model are greatly reduced, while maintaining good feature expression ability. Next, we fuse the lightweight inverted residual network with the Prototypical Networks (ProtoNet) classifier. ProtoNet is a small sample classification algorithm based on metric learning. It can use a small number of training samples to efficiently learn category prototype vectors and perform well in small sample scenarios. By combining a lightweight feature extractor with a ProtoNet classifier, our hybrid model can significantly reduce model complexity and inference time while ensuring classification performance, making it ideal for deployment on resource-constrained edge devices. We have conducted extensive experimental evaluation of the model on the public small sample image classification dataset, and the results show that the hybrid model is superior to other mainstream small sample classification methods in classification accuracy, reasoning speed, parameter quantity and other indicators. In general, the hybrid model based on lightweight inverted residual network and ProtoNet proposed in this paper provides an efficient and feasible solution to the small sample image classification problem, which is of great significance to edge devices and practical applications to reduce computational complexity.

articleTitle: Identify the brain abnormalities from resting-state fMRI data for classification of schizophrenia
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Due to the lack of effective biological markers, the development of diagnosis and treatment methods for schizophrenia and other related brain diseases has been slow in the past decades. Based on resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging, this study simultaneously searched for brain abnormalities in patients with schizophrenia from two aspects of spontaneous neural activity in local brain regions and brain network topology. Based on this, an automatic computer diagnosis algorithm was designed to classify patients with schizophrenia and normal controls. The results showed that the spontaneous neural activity of patients in thalamus, postcentral gyrus and other regions was significantly reduced; The results showed that the global efficiency of brain network was significantly increased, the small world was slightly reduced but not significantly, and the local topological properties of parahippocampal gyrus, temporal pole: middle temporal gyrus were significantly changed. The features extracted from abnormal brain regions could effectively distinguish patients from normal controls, and the highest classification accuracy was 80.17%. The findings of this study can help to identify effective biomarkers for clinical diagnosis and provide insights into the neurophysiological mechanisms of schizophrenia. The proposed classification algorithm can also be used to assist the diagnosis of schizophrenia.

articleTitle: Safety Risk Analysis of Small and Medium-sized Airports Based on Improved Bayesian Network Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In 2023, China has 259 transportation airports (excluding Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan), with 221 being small and medium-sized, handling less than 10 million passengers annually. These airports face shortages of personnel and equipment, complex operating environments, and limited management capabilities, making them vulnerable in civil aviation. This paper analyzes unsafe events at these airports from 2019 to 2023, focusing on factors such as timing, causes, and types of events. Utilizing Bayesian networks, the study infers uncertain information, predicting variable probability distributions under incomplete data. An improved Bayesian model assesses risk, tests correlations between various influencing factors, such as event types and consequences, and predicts various scenarios. Based on these findings, targeted safety suggestions are proposed for small and medium-sized airports, aiming to enhance their safety management and providing valuable insights for future improvements.

articleTitle: Research on the Modeling Method of the Equipment Utilization Based on Supernetwork
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This paper analyzes the theory of equipment utilization based on supernetwork, studies the mapping of "entity-capability-entity" equipment utilization relationship, puts forward the idea of supernetwork modeling, analyzes the relationship between entity nodes and edges, and constructs a mathematical model of equipment utilization based on supernetwork through the unified representation of heterogeneous equipment capabilities, realizing the quantitative expression of equipment utilization strategy based on kill chain structure, providing quantitative model input for the subsequent formation of equipment utilization optimization scheme.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Application Characteristics of Multi-Beam Lens Antennas in Space TT&C Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Traditional multi-beam antennas, such as parabolic and phased array antennas, often suffer from limitations like low beam steering flexibility, restricted coverage angles, significant beam discrepancies, and complex, costly phase shift networks. With the future trend of space telemetry, tracking and command systems moving towards full spatial coverage and multi-target capabilities, this paper explores and analyzes the application characteristics of novel multi-beam lens antennas in space TT&C systems. The study examines the relationship between the aperture and radiation efficiency, weight, flexibility, and applicable frequency bands of multi-beam lens antennas. Additionally, it proposes typical TT&C application scenarios for lens antennas, offering theoretical and technical references to support the continuous tracking of a large number of targets under conditions of full spatial coverage in future systems.

articleTitle: Research on the Aircraft Stands Assignment Based on Two-Stage Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the rapid development of the civil aviation industry, aircraft stands are playing a more and more vital role as a core resource in airport operations, so an efficient assignment of stands is crucial for improving airport efficiency. This paper first determines the flight transit time. As the factors influencing flight departure time are identified to predict departure time through the GRU network, the flight transit time can be determined based on arrival time and expected departure time. Then the U-shaped apron structure is analyzed and an aircraft stands assignment model is established based on the characteristics of U-shaped aprons. Finally, based on the flight transit time and the U-shaped apron aircraft stands assignment model, a two-stage genetic algorithm is used. It first calculates the airport gate rate and then optimizes the variance of idle time of stands under the condition that the airport gate rate is constant to obtain the aircraft stands assignment results. The experimental results show that the method improves the airport gate rate by 7.07% and reduces the idle time of stands by 61.94%. It further ensures the efficiency of airport operations by improving the airport gate rate while reducing the idle time of stands.

articleTitle: Research on the Impact of Logistics Service Quality of Tourism Commodity on Customer Satisfaction in Tourism E-business
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Currently, tourism e-commerce is developing rapidly. Tourism commodity in tourism e-business are like a rainbow bridge connecting scenery and tourists, not only making distant beauty within reach, but also allowing travel memories to continue and be cherished. The significance of studying the impact of logistics service quality of tourism products on customer satisfaction in tourism e-business lies in revealing how logistics services become a bridge connecting goods and customer emotions, thereby enhancing customer satisfaction and promoting the sustainable and healthy development of the tourism e-commerce industry. Based on a review of relevant literature, this study constructs a research model and proposes research hypotheses. Then, data was collected through a questionnaire survey and analyzed using SPSS. Finally, the structural equation modeling software AMOS was used to validate the model and test hypotheses. Research has found that the responsiveness, informativeness, reliability, economy, and tangibility of tourism commodity logistics service quality in tourism e-commerce have a significant positive impact on customers' value experience, and thus significantly positively affect customer satisfaction. The research findings contain rich theoretical and practical implications.

articleTitle: A model for Measuring the Trustworthiness of Component Software System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to provide a new empirical evidence on software trustworthiness in the software engineering, a topic of great interest in the academic literature in recent years. This paper chooses the trustworthiness of componentized software system as the investigated subject. To this end, this paper creates a model for software system trustworthiness measurement on the footing of the attributes of components, the weights of these components, and their combination modes. This paper considers four kinds of component software subsystems, which are confirmed to satisfy five algebraic properties: monotonicity, non-negativity, cohesiveness, sensitivity, and substitutability. The empirical results show that the trustworthiness value for the whole food-ordering system including four component-based subsystems is 0.918, and, concerning its four subsystems, credibility value is at 0.846 in the case of subsystem 1, 0.942 in the case of subsystem 2 featuring branching composition, 1.0 for subsystem 3 characterized by parallel structure and 0.883 in the case of subsystem 4. The proposed model is proved to be accurate and robust in software trustworthiness measurement and can be applied into exploration of issues related to credibility in the software engineering. The paper concludes with pointing out the direction of future research.

articleTitle: A Study on a PCBA Short Circuit Detection Method Based on the Hall Effect
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Artificial intelligence is currently applied extensively across various fields, including healthcare, transportation, and finance. PCBA (Printed Circuit Board Assembly) short circuits can have a broad impact on AI systems, affecting hardware, software, system performance, and reliability. Conventional needle bed ICT technology in PCBA fault diagnostics can detect short circuits but is unable to pinpoint specific short circuit locations, nor does it provide any valuable information for repair personnel. FCT and AOI methods also have limitations and are unable to offer rapid and effective short circuit localization. This study proposes using the Hall effect to detect magnetic field characteristics produced by the PCBA under specific excitation, utilizing the low impedance property of short circuit points. By examining the magnetic field intensity at the short circuit location under specific excitation, this method aims to achieve quick and accurate localization of PCBA short circuit faults.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Agent Technology and Applications Based on Large Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the rapid growth of available data, the continuous improvement of computing power, and the increasing maturity of large model technology, AI Agents based on large models are gradually becoming the core of AI research and applications. AI Agents possess characteristics such as learning ability, decision-making capability, adaptability, and initiative, enabling them to automatically make choices and take actions to achieve specified goals. Moreover, by integrating large-scale pre-trained model technology, AI Agents can continuously improve their performance based on interactions. This paper will review the background, concepts, and characteristics of AI Agents, focusing on the analysis of the core capabilities and implementation paradigms of large model-based intelligent agents. In line with industry demands, it constructs an electromagnetic target analysis and recognition intelligent agent application framework based on multi-modal large models, providing a reference for readers interested in the research and development of large model intelligence agents.

articleTitle: Research on Enhancing Open-Set Generalizability for Active Jamming Recognition on Measured Dataset
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: With the rapid development of radar interference technology, the diversity of active jamming and the variety of interference strategies increase continuously. As a consequence, active jamming recognition (AJR) in the real world is gradually becoming an open-set classification problem. Thus, the generalizability of AJR methods based on deep learning is challenged severely. In this paper, a dataset is constructed with real-world outfield signals to reflect the generalization capability of AJR methods. A convolutional neural network (CNN) based time-frequency domain AJR method is established as the research baseline, whose recognition and generalizability are evaluated on the dataset. To enhance the recognition and rejection abilities on test datasets containing unforeseen jamming patterns, a data augmentation strategy based on chirp characteristics and a metric learning loss optimizing feature clustering is designed. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed methods possess superior recognition and rejection accuracy on the test dataset to those of the baseline method.

articleTitle: Research on MES Production Scheduling Algorithm Based on Simulated Automotive Production Line Final Assembly Process
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: This study delves into the importance of the final assembly process for automotive production lines and the application of MES production scheduling algorithms. Firstly, the process of automotive production line assembly technology and the implementation of flexible production were outlined. Secondly, a detailed study was conducted on the architecture and functions of the MES system, and a production scheduling algorithm was designed for simulating the assembly process of automotive production lines. The algorithm was also optimized and analyzed. Through experimental verification, this study evaluated the performance and optimization effect of the algorithm, and compared and analyzed it with other algorithms, verifying the superiority of this study. Finally, the main achievements of the research were summarized, and the application prospects of MES production scheduling algorithm in the final assembly process of automotive production lines were discussed.

articleTitle: Intelligent Detection of Skin Diseases Based on The Optimized YOLO V8
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: In the realm of dermatological diagnostics, the advent of artificial intelligence (AI) has heralded a transformative era, particularly with the application of advanced object detection models like YOLO V8. This study delves into the nuanced capabilities of YOLO V8 in discerning and classifying nine distinct dermatological conditions, a task previously fraught with challenges due to the varied and complex nature of skin diseases. Our research harnesses the robust architecture of YOLO V8, meticulously trained on a diverse dataset comprising both public and private sources, augmented through sophisticated image processing techniques. The model's performance was rigorously evaluated, demonstrating remarkable accuracy and efficiency in real-time detection scenarios. This not only underscores the potential of AI in enhancing diagnostic precision but also paves the way for more accessible and timely dermatological care. As we stand on the precipice of a new horizon in medical technology, the implications of such advancements are both profound and promising, potentially revolutionizing the landscape of dermatological treatment and patient care.

articleTitle: Research on Expert Intelligent PID Temperature Control Method for Super-large Climatic Laboratory based on Heat Load Feedforward
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Precise control of the temperature field in a super-large climatic laboratory is an essential requirement of various climatic and environmental experiments. Given the characteristics of considerable time delay and much interference in the laboratory, this paper establishes a laboratory temperature control process model based on the technological flow of laboratory temperature regulation. A large-space temperature field controller with expert intelligent proportional-integral-derivative (PID) based on heat load feedforward is designed. The controller compensates for the temperature change brought by the simulated environmental thermal load in the test process by introducing the thermal load interference in the test process as a feedforward link, and adjusts the outer loop PID controller parameters in real-time based on expert knowledge. The experimental results show that this method can effectively suppress the thermal load interference of the climatic test and improve the response speed of the control process. The rise and drop in the temperature target curve can be accurately tracked, improving the control accuracy of the temperature field in a super-large space climatic laboratory.

articleTitle: A Model Integrating Wavelet Convolution and Linear Attention Mechanism for Inventory Management in Power Warehouses
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
abstract: Accurate inventory management in power warehouses is crucial for maintaining consistency between records and actual stock levels. However, the complex storage layout and the diversity of stored materials often lead to human errors during manual inventory checks, resulting in inefficiencies. To address these challenges, we collected 2,000 images from power warehouse environments and created a binary classification dataset containing images of correctly and incorrectly placed items. We propose a novel network, CWAMNet, specifically designed for visual inventory management in complex power warehouse environments. CWAMNet integrates wavelet convolution and a linear attention mechanism to overcome the limitations of traditional convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and standard attention mechanisms, achieving a balance between model capacity and computational efficiency.

articleTitle: Based on Improved Hierarchical Analysis Method and Improved Entropy Weight Method of Assembly Concrete Research on Evaluation of Greenness of Building Construction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 4th International Conference on Information Technology, Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (ICIBA)
